From sultry spices and smoky oud to rich cognac and decadent florals, this collection offers a versatile array of fragrances designed to transition seamlessly from moody, intimate evenings to daring daytime adventures. Whether you're exploring new depths of scent or adding a provocative twist to your fragrance wardrobe, this kit is your gateway to unapologetic expression Contents: DGAF Eau de Parfum (2ml) Drunk Lovers Eau de Parfum (2ml) Nanatopia Eau de Parfum (2ml) Drunk Saffron Eau de Parfum (2ml) Mad Honey Eau de Parfum (2ml) Mary Jane Eau de Parfum (2ml) Filthy Musk Eau de Parfum (2ml) L'Animal Eau de Parfum (2ml)

listings.rawTitle: Frédéric Malle Acne Studios 10ml
listings.description: The Acne Studios Par Frédéric Malle (10ml) Eau de Parfum is a collaboration that meets at the intersection between fashion, perfumery and art. Boasting a vibrant, magnetic and radical scent profile, this scent opens with aldehydes reminiscent of fresh laundry, before leading into an olfactive twist with a sweet heart of florals. Think: roses, violets and orange blossoms mingled with fruity peach notes. It then warms into a creamy base of sandalwood, vanilla and musk.

listings.rawTitle: Sol de Janeiro Cheirosa 39 Perfume Mist 240ml
listings.description: Transport your senses to the vibrant coast of Brazil with Sol de Janeiro’s Cheirosa '39 Perfume Mist (240ml). This luscious fragrance opens with a smooth, decadent note of coconut cream, evoking images of balmy sunsets and beachside breezes. The heart reveals rich vanilla intertwined with tropical orchid, wrapping you in a warm, luscious embrace that’s both sweet and sensual. A base of toasted praline, sun-kissed sandalwood and a hint of nuttiness creates a woody, gourmand aroma that lingers beautifully on the skin. Light and irresistible, this mist is perfect for adding a touch of tropical magic to your everyday routine or for special moments where a little Brazil-inspired glamour is needed.

listings.rawTitle: D.S. & Durga Rose Atlantic Pocket Perfume Spray 10ml
listings.description: Transport the senses to days spent by the sea with D.S & Durga’s Rose Atlantic Eau de Parfum (10ml). This evocative scent will take you back to summer, where salt spray combines with a heady floral aroma to create the perfect bouquet. Top notes of bergamot, lemon oil, and petals make a vivid first impression. At its heart, rose accord, linden and dune grass evoke memories of perfect summer days. Finally, base notes of muscone, salt water and white moss afford a lasting aroma.

listings.rawTitle: Molton Brown Re-Charge Black Pepper Eau De Parfum
listings.description: Awaken your senses with Molton Brown's Re-Charge Black Pepper Eau de Parfum (30ml), a bold and invigorating scent inspired by Madagascar's vibrant landscapes. It opens with energetic top notes of black pepper, lemon and ginger, creating an immediate feeling of freshness and vitality. The heart reveals a lush herbal blend of coriander, basil and violet leaf, adding depth and botanical richness. The fragrance settles into a warm, earthy base of vetiver, oakmoss and ambergris, evoking the rugged terrain and spice-toned earth of Madagascar's mountains and savannahs. Perfect for adventurous spirits, this confident scent captures the essence of exploration and wanderlust, making it an unforgettable olfactory journey.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Kurky Eau de Parfum 35ml
listings.description: Named after Maison Francis Kurkdijan's childhood nickname, Kurky Eau de Parfum (35ml) captured the freedom of youth in all its vitality. Encouraging you to embrace childlike wonder once again, the scent combines rich gourmands and sweetened fruits. Reminiscent of childhood treats, tutti frutti accord blends together a sweet cocktail of orange, raspberry, pear and peach. Clean white musks compliment creamy vanilla in a mouthwatering display of gourmands. This fragrance is for the adults who "dare to dream like kids".

listings.rawTitle: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Kurky Eau Parfumée 70ml
listings.description: Named after Maison Francis Kurkdijan's childhood nickname, Kurky Eau de Parfum (70ml) captured the freedom of youth in all its vitality. Encouraging you to embrace childlike wonder once again, the scent combines rich gourmands and sweetened fruits. Reminiscent of childhood treats, tutti frutti accord blends together a sweet cocktail of orange, raspberry, pear and peach. Clean white musks compliment creamy vanilla in a mouthwatering display of gourmands. This fragrance is for the adults who "dare to dream like kids".

listings.rawTitle: Acqua Di Parma Cedro Virtuoso Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Ignite a spark of creativity with Acqua di Parma’s Cedro Virtuoso Eau de Parfum (50ml). This gourmand, woody fragrance captures the moment an idea takes shape. It opens with a burst of fresh Calabrian bergamot and creamy hazelnut, before unfolding like a warm embrace into a heart of cedarwoods to reveal a spiced, refined leathery scent. As the fragrance settles into your skin, it deepens into an enveloping base of smooth sandalwood, tonka bean, and ambrox.

listings.rawTitle: KAYALI Sweet Diamond Pink Pepper 25 10ml
listings.description: Playing the warmth of spices such as pink pepper and saffron against floral notes of Bulgarian rose and royal lily, KAYALI Sweet Diamond Pink Pepper | 25 is an electric scent that speaks of spontaneity and sensuality. Designed to be layered with other beguiling scents from the KAYALI collection, Huda and Mona Kattan worked with world-renowned French perfume house, Firmenich to create this lavish eau de parfum, which can be layered and combined to create a truly unique scent, perfect for the modern woman. Painstakingly perfected – the number 25 indicates the 25 rounds of modifications before it struck the right notes – the KAYALI Sweet Diamond Pink Pepper | 25 is a floral fragrance with a twist; the top notes of pink pepper, bergamot, royal lily and saffron marry sweetness and spice, which is amplified by middle notes of rose, magnolia and vanilla orchid, only to be intriguingly contrasted with a woody base of patchouli, musk, amber and sandalwood. Consider it a major contender for your next signature scent...

listings.rawTitle: HUDA BEAUTY Easy Bake Intense EDP - 50ml
listings.description: Unleash your inner glow with Huda Beauty's Easy Bake Intense Eau de Parfum (50ml) a bold floral gourmand that's as rich and unapologetically sexy as you are. This fragrance takes inspiration from the brand's iconic Easy Bake Loose Powder's scent. Opening with juicy wild cherry, it deepens into a seductive blend of white florals layered with warm cinnamon bark and creamy caramel milk, culminating in a luscious vanilla bourbon base. This intensified fragrance leaves an addictive, all-day trail that's impossible to ignore. Perfect for those who want to make a statement, it's a scent that's sophisticated, unforgettable and perfectly suited for every glam moment.

listings.rawTitle: Le Labo Eau de Parfum Discovery Set 3x7ml
listings.description: Le Labo’s Discovery Set (3 x 7ml) is a beautifully crafted set featuring three iconic Eau de Parfums: Another 13, Santal 33 and Thé Noir 29. Ideal for on-the-go spritzing or layered wear, these scents will soon become a staple in your fragrance wardrobe. Immerse yourself in the fresh, musky allure of Another 13, the warm, woody-spicy sophistication of Santal 33 and the rich, smoky elegance of Thé Noir 29. Each fragrance embodies the brand’s commitment to artisanal craftsmanship and unique scent stories. Whether you’re expanding your collection or searching for a signature scent, this set offers a luxurious, personalised sensory experience, delivering iconic scents that become part of your everyday signature. Contents: Another 13 Eau de Parfum (7ml) Santal 33 Eau de Parfum (7ml) Thé Noir 29 Eau de Parfum (7ml)

listings.rawTitle: KAYALI Eden Plush Pear 23 Eau de Parfum 10ml
listings.description: Step into a world of dreamy nostalgia with KAYALI’s Eden Plush Pear | 23 Eau de Parfum (10ml) a unique scent that captures the warmth of sunlit, carefree days. Juicy plush pear opens the fragrance with a sweet, luminous burst, complemented by bright mandarin and airy floral notes of gardenia and freesia. As it settles, decadent vanilla caviar and soft woods wrap you in a comforting, velvety embrace, evoking feelings of golden memories and tranquil moments. Encased in a pink-lacquered bottle inspired by Middle Eastern opulence, this fragrance is a celebration of innocent joy and effortless elegance. A perfect reminder that life’s sweetest moments are just a spray away.

listings.rawTitle: Byredo Bal D'Afrique Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: A celebration of African culture, art, music and dance, BYREDO's iconic Bal d'Afrique Eau de Parfum drenches you in rich history, euphoria and, nostalgic longing. One of the brand's earliest fragrances, it perfectly bottles the founder's memories and translates them into scent, transporting you on a whimsical journey to Africa... With unique top notes of earthy bucchu, spicy-musky African marigold, lemon and neroli, the fragrance's sweet heart of jasmine petals and violet is perfectly counterbalanced. Dancing atop a heady base of black amber, Moroccan cedarwood, musk and vetiver, the decadent yet fresh Bal d'Afrique Eau de Parfum is a romantic love letter to Africa .

listings.rawTitle: Kilian Angels' Share Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Kilian Angels' Share Eau de Parfum (100ml) is Kilian Hennessy's most personal fragrance yet, a sumptuous, intoxicating blend that celebrates the rich heritage of cognac-making. Introducing a first-time collaboration with renowned French perfumer Benoit Lapouza, the scent delivers a luxurious symphony of cognac oil, cinnamon, oak, tonka bean and praline. It envelops the wearer in a halo of scent that feels both opulent and comforting, with layers of woody and spicy notes slowly unfolding, taking you deep into the founder's mind and memory: the ethereal realm known as la part des anges or the angels' share. A signature fragrance for the true connoisseur.

listings.rawTitle: Creed Absolu Aventus 100ml
listings.description: A rich reimagining of the original Aventus, Absolu Aventus draws on nature's distinct dualities: shadows and light, moon and sun, uniting the freshness of citrus against the rugged strength of woods. Opening with a citrusy symphony of grapefruit, zesty lemon and aromatic bergamot, this sensuous scent is layered with golden hints of pineapple and winding tendrils of smoky Haitian vetiver. An essence made for muses; it's entwined around a heart of earthy wood, heady patchouli and sensual pink pepper, all rooted in a fiery base of cinnamon, ginger and tantalising cardamon. Both daring and delicate, it's the compelling spirit of Aventus body redefined.

listings.rawTitle: Creed Absolu Aventus 50ml
listings.description: A rich reimagining of the original Aventus, Absolu Aventus draws on nature's distinct dualities: shadows and light, moon and sun, uniting the freshness of citrus against the rugged strength of woods. Opening with a citrusy symphony of grapefruit, zesty lemon and aromatic bergamot, this sensuous scent is layered with golden hints of pineapple and winding tendrils of smoky Haitian vetiver. An essence made for muses; it's entwined around a heart of earthy wood, heady patchouli and sensual pink pepper, all rooted in a fiery base of cinnamon, ginger and tantalising cardamon. Both daring and delicate, it's the compelling spirit of Aventus body redefined.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Christmas Kist Advent Calendar (Worth £595)
listings.description: Unwrap a daily treat with the Jo Malone London 25 Day Luxury Fragrance Advent Calendar. The keepsake trunk houses 25 scented surprises, from iconic colognes to travel-sized bath and body products, to elevate the festive season. Perfect as a gift or a treat for yourself, each reveal introduces a different facet of the Jo Malone London collections, letting you explore new favourites and rediscover classic scents throughout the countdown to Christmas. Exclusive Saving: Worth £595, Yours for £375. listings.rawTitle: HUDA BEAUTY Easy Bake Intense EDP - 10ml Travel Spray
listings.description: Unleash your inner glow with Huda Beauty's Easy Bake Intense Eau de Parfum (10ml) a bold floral gourmand that's as rich and unapologetically sexy as you are. This fragrance takes inspiration from the brand's iconic Easy Bake Loose Powder's scent. Opening with juicy wild cherry, it deepens into a seductive blend of white florals layered with warm cinnamon bark and creamy caramel milk, culminating in a luscious vanilla bourbon base.
