Perfect for those who want to make a statement, it's a scent that's sophisticated, unforgettable and perfectly suited for every glam moment.

listings.rawTitle: Discothèque Heathens, Cowboys and the Santa Ana Winds 50ml
listings.description: Discothèque's Heathens, Cowboys and the Santa Ana Winds Eau de Parfum (50ml) is an homage to an age of decadent debauchery; conjuring whisky and warm amber sunsets, whispered advances and sandalwood embers. With its 'no holds barred' attitude (and strict 'no photos' policy) Helena's offered a place to escape; a haven for heathens that simmered with sex and excess. A perfume that oozes seduction, it opens with a burst of palmarosa, smoky amyris, sweet grass and tea leaf, then leads you astray via cardamom, cedar and sandalwood, down to a decadent den of suede, amber and musk. Think: sundrenched skin and diamond bracelets; scarlet nails and spilled champagne - and let's not forget the irreverent 'disco ball' lid, designed to reflect you as much as your signature scent does.

listings.rawTitle: Le Labo Another 13 Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: For those wanting a fragrance that will have everyone asking what you're wearing, the Another 13 Eau De Parfum (100ml) from Le Labo ticks all the right boxes. Originally created in creative collaboration between Le Labo and Jefferson Hack, (Editor-in-Chief of An0ther Magazine), this velvety scent dances across skin and melds with the wearer's natural pheromones. It opens with refreshing notes of pear and apple, only to blend into sensual accords of ambrette, moss and subtly sweet jasmine. The result? An irresistible balance between refreshing citrusy accords and earthy musk notes...

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Peony & Blush Suede Cologne 9ml
listings.description: Meet your new olfactory obsession, Jo Malone London's Peony and Blush Suede Cologne (9ml). Think: flirtatious, decadent and bursting with delicate floral notes. Evoking an English ballroom dressed with decadent peonies, Jo Malone London has bottled the flirtatious hint of a night full of expectation. It's laced with red apples amidst jasmine, rose and gillyflower, before landing on a sensual and soft blush suede. Wear yours solo, or try layering it with another fragrance to create your own unique blend.

listings.rawTitle: NEST New York Madagascar Vanilla Eau de Parfum Travel Spray 8ml
listings.description: NEST New York's Madagascar Vanilla Eau de Parfum (8ml) is a warm, inviting scent that's pure vanilla bliss. Crafted with Madagascan vanilla, one of the world's most luxurious and labour-intensive ingredients, this fragrance is a true labour of love. The vanilla orchid is hand pollinated, then cured and dried over a year, creating a rich, creamy aroma that feels both indulgent and sophisticated. With hints of warm woods and a touch of sweetness, it's perfect for cozying up or elevating your everyday. This bottle is a little luxury that supports local villages and celebrates the art of true craftsmanship.

listings.rawTitle: Fugazzi Fragrances Passionfroudh Extrait de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Meet Fugazzi Fragrances' Passionfroudh Extrait de Parfum (50ml), a unique synthesis of addictive, intense oudh with juicy tropical fruits. Discover a burst of energetic passionfruit, juicy mango, and zingy ginger balanced with the bitter warmth of toasted black tea. Inspired by the energy and soul of Brazilian beaches, it's heart of sharp black pepper and crisp gurjun balsam brings a sense of intrigue and sophistication to the vibrant flesh. Finally, A strong dose of rare Oudh Assafi dances with earthy cypriol for a burning, seductive foundation. You'll be the girl from Ipanema walking with just one spritz.

listings.rawTitle: Discothèque Next to Me or Nothing 50ml
listings.description: The clink of cocktails, scratched records spinning low, silhouettes shimmering in indigo light — beneath Kyoto’s neon-lit streets, a hidden clubland of shadow and allure awakens, set alive by Next to Me or Nothing Eau de Parfum (50ml) . A series of near misses and quick kisses; faded leather and ripped velvet; secrets whispered in winding tendrils of smoke and starry nights that stretch until dawn. This intimate scent unfolds in layers — a bloom of heady star jasmine and creamy nigori, entwined around a heart of Iso E Super, a note that wears differently on every skin, evoking the thrill of bodies moving in feverish disarray, yet always as one. Think opalescent lips and navy nails; honeyed Coltrane jazz and scribbled love letters — and let's not forget the scent's beautiful, cubic glass bottle and glittering 'disco ball' lid.

listings.rawTitle: Charlotte Tilbury Collection of Emotions Joyphoria 10ml
listings.description: Transport yourself to a tropical, sun-lit beach with Charlotte Tilbury's Collection of Emotions Joyphoria Eau de Parfum (10ml). Like a ray of golden sunshine, this fragrance opens with notes of refreshing coconut water, uplifting neroli and citrus petitgrain. At the heart, it bursts into a floral explosion of intoxicating tuberose, warm jasmine and bright ylang ylang. As for the base? It stars a balancing blend of vanilla bean extract, velvety cashmere wood and powdery musk accords. It's a charming fragrance with an intense scent trail that'll no doubt make heads turn...

listings.rawTitle: Creed Carmina Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Exude warmth and sensuality with the Carmina Eau de Parfum from The House of Creed's impressive olfactive offering. Opening with electric top notes of plump black cherry, tangy pink pepper and spicy saffron, this fragrance has rose de mai (a special ingredient that's so delicate it can only be harvested during the month of May) at its heart. This creation is then balanced by sweet honey and powdery violet accords before it's enriched with the welcoming embrace of cashmere wood, amber and musk, adding to its irresistible allure.

listings.rawTitle: Creed Carmina Eau de Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Exude warmth and sensuality with the Carmina Eau de Parfum from The House of Creed's impressive olfactive offering. Opening with electric top notes of plump black cherry, tangy pink pepper and spicy saffron, this fragrance has rose de mai (a special ingredient that's so delicate it can only be harvested during the month of May) at its heart. This creation is then balanced by sweet honey and powdery violet accords before it's enriched with the welcoming embrace of cashmere wood, amber and musk, adding to its irresistible allure.

listings.rawTitle: Le Labo Travel Set Santal 33 4 x 90ml
listings.description: Elevate your travel game with the Le Labo Santal 33 Travel Set a curated collection that keeps you smelling divine wherever life takes you. Housed in a waxed canvas pouch inspired by lab aprons, this set features four travel essentials: Shower Gel, Body Lotion, Shampoo and Conditioner. Each product is infused with the iconic Santal 33 scent; rich with top notes of violet accord and cardamom, heart notes of iris, papyrus and ambrox and a warm, woody base of cedarwood, leather and sandalwood. Perfect for maintaining your signature scent on-the-go, this set offers a luxurious, layered experience that leaves skin and hair feeling fresh, nourished and irresistibly scented. Whether traveling or simply indulging in everyday luxury, this is your ultimate scent companion. Contents: Santal 33 Shower Gel (90ml) Santal 33 Body Lotion (90ml) Santal 33 Shampoo (90ml) Santal 33 Conditioner (90ml) Waxed Canvas Pouch

listings.rawTitle: Fenty Fragrance 10ml Eau de Parfum + Mini Body Crème (10% saving)
listings.description: Indulge in a sensory escape with the Fenty Fragrance Duo, an irresistible pairing that elevates your scent game and skincare routine. The Fenty Eau de Parfum invites you on an olfactive journey with warm, floral and spicy notes: beginning with vibrant tangerine, blueberry and patchouli, softened by Bulgarian rose and magnolia for a creamy, sweet twist. Perfect for any season, this fragrance exudes effortless confidence and allure. Complementing it, the Fenty Parfum Mini Body Crème envelops your skin in a luxurious, moisture-rich blend of conditioning oils, Barbados cherry and a scent that echoes the parfum’s magnetic notes. Skin feels replenished, radiant and irresistibly scented, ready for anything. Contents: Fenty Eau de Parfum (10ml) Fenty Parfum Mini Body Crème (50ml)

listings.rawTitle: Fascent Corn Star 30ml
listings.description: Feel an electric spark of joy with Fascent’s CORN STAR Eau de Parfum (30ml). This sweet, gourmand fragrance plunges you straight into the fast lane, opening with a splash of crisp pear and lightweight coconut water. Free-spirited and electric, at its heart, indulgent notes of warm popcorn and fluffy marshmallow deliver a sensory rush that sweeps you off your feet. As it settles, a base of irresistibly creamy tonka bean bottles all the excitement together, leaving you suspended in a beautiful chaos you’ll never want to leave.

listings.rawTitle: BYREDO La Tulipe Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Celebrate the arrival of spring with BYREDO’s La Tulipe Eau de Parfum (50ml), a vibrant floral scent that captures the essence of blooming gardens. Encased in the brand’s sleek, minimalist bottle, this fragrance opens with lively notes of cyclamen, freesia and rhubarb, evoking the crisp freshness of early spring. At its heart, the delicate tulip adds a soft floral depth, while warm blonde woods and vetiver ground the scent with a subtle, earthy allure. Featuring a gentle, enchanting presence, this scent radiates the joyful energy of spring’s first blooms, transforming every moment into a celebration of renewal.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Neroli Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Inspired by the sunlit blooms of Seville, Chloé's Atelier des Fleurs Neroli Eau de Parfum (50ml) treats the senses to a honeyed floral fragrance. Brightened with citrus accents of bergamot and pear petit grain oil, this refreshing blend radiates subtle luxury. Notes of orange blossom, freesia and neroli lead the way, sparkling amongst white musk nuances for a second skin-like freshness. Meanwhile, cashmere woods and cedarwood add warmth to the dry down, granting scent longevity and intensity with each spritz.

listings.rawTitle: Kilian Love, Don't Be Shy Extreme 50ml
listings.description: Pushing your senses to the limits of pleasure, Kilian’s Love, Don’t Be Shy Extreme heightens the fan-favourite original scents with an influx of Bulgarian rose. Adding a sublime crystallized floral aspect, this intense perfume demands to be noticed (and adored). Exhilarating and unforgettable, this seductive scent melds orange blossom absolute with an abundance of rose to create an aroma that no gourmand lover can resits. Just as two people can perfectly complement and complete each other, the formula is effortlessly and divinely finished with sweet marshmallow sugar accord and sharp neroli. The result is a gentle, sensual, addictive fragrance that lasts and lasts.

listings.rawTitle: NEST New York Wonder 8ml Eau de Parfum
listings.description: Experience the warm, spicy embrace of Wonder Eau de Parfum (8ml) from Nest New York. The scent journey begins with a bright, zesty opening of grapefruit and winter cranberry before unfolding into a nostalgic heart of woody fir balsam and patchouli, evoking the warmth of festive mornings. It features a beautiful, limited-edition bottle designed by artist Pierre Marie, capturing the essence of the holiday spirit.

listings.rawTitle: Discothèque Lola at Coat Check 8ml
listings.description: Eliciting the thrill of anticipation, Discothèque's Lola at Coat Check Eau de Parfum (8ml) is an insouciant blend of rose and grapefruit, caramel and sandalwood - as enigmatic as its namesake, and the club at which she reigned. With its velvet ropes and intimate atmosphere, Nell's became the go-to club for all the hottest names in arts and music - from LL Cool J to Basquiat, Debbie Harry to Andy Warhol - and DJs played a melting pot of genres to the unexpected guestlist. Punk, funk, house and hip-hop, this scent evokes the club's eclectic energy - opening with floral-citrus notes of baies, cardamom and grapefruit that evolve towards a heart of jasmine, lily, orris, caramel and smooth white chocolate. The base notes of sandal and cedarwoods, amber and vetiver then keep the late (late) night alive, leading you straight to the front of the glittering queue, where you're wordlessly ushered downstairs.

listings.rawTitle: Charlotte Tilbury Star Confidence
listings.description: Unleash your inner star with Charlotte Tilbury's Star Confidence Perfume (10ml), a captivating fragrance designed to make you feel unstoppable. Opening with juicy blackcurrant absolute, it sparks a vibrant, energetic mood. The heart reveals sophisticated jasmine sambac absolute, complemented by dewy jasmine accord and sensual davana oil, adding depth and allure. The warm, velvety base features addictive natural patchouli oil and vibrant oakmoss absolute, creating a rich, magnetic trail that lasts from day to night. This complex yet wearable scent combines crisp, fruity top notes with a velvety, sensual finish, empowering you to embrace your confidence and shine bright. Perfect for any occasion, star confidence is your secret weapon to feeling luminous, empowered and ready to reach for the stars.

listings.rawTitle: KAYALI Freedom Musk Bouquet 27 Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Designed for those who desire a vibrant yet sophisticated aura, KAYALI’s Freedom Musk Bouquet 27 EDP (100ml) offers a luxurious, floral musk experience that’s both captivating and effortless to wear. This luminous, floral fragrance combines radiant solar jasmine and ylang-ylang with the romantic warmth of Turkish rose and creamy vanilla musk. Accents of praline and sandalwood add a sweet, woody depth, creating a beautifully balanced scent full of elegance and sensuality. Perfect for day or night, it envelops you in a radiant, comforting embrace that exudes confidence and grace.

listings.rawTitle: Balenciaga Discovery Box 10x2ml
listings.description: Discover the 10 olfactive contrasts of Balenciaga with the Discovery Box (10 x 2ml). Perfect for trial or travel, the collection of individualistic perfumes evoke the clash between the mastery of French parfumerie and daring innovation. From minimalist florals to precious oud, each fragrance represents Balenciaga couture, bottled. Each is housed in a 2ml vial, designed for portability and exploration of the collection. Contents: No Comment Parfum (2ml) Getaria Parfum (2ml) Twenty Four Seven Parfum (2ml) To Be Confirmed Parfum (2ml) Muscara Parfum (2ml) Le Dix Parfum (2ml) 100% Parfum (2ml) Extra Parfum (2ml) Cristóbal Parfum (2ml) Incense Perfumum Parfum (2ml)

listings.rawTitle: Discothèque Baise Moi on the Dancefloor 50ml
listings.description: Paris. Les Bains Douches. 1979. Red-lipped and dancing to Prince as you sip crisp champagne from cut crystal, Discothèque's Baise Moi on the Dancefloor Eau de Parfum (50ml) pays homage to Moët and music and reckless abandon. A disused bathhouse-turned-hotbed for hedonists, Paris' Les Bains Douches has played host to cult party-goers - from Boy George to Mick Jagger, Kate Moss to Jean Paul Gaultier - not to mention the thousands of thrill-seeking revelers keen to get lost in the rapturous atmosphere. With its nostalgic character, thanks to powdery notes of violet leaf and orris root, Baise Moi on the Dancefloor boasts a twist of sharp cassis, a heady burst of jasmine and a creamy base of sandalwood and cashmere that is unapologetically seductive. This is scent made for muses - and let's not forget the chic bottle and 'disco ball' lid that's designed to reflect you as much as your perfume.

listings.rawTitle: Creed Millesime Imperial Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: The gift that keeps on giving (even if you buy it for yourself) the Millésime Imperial Eau de Parfum is the answer to your search for a new scent. Encased in a luxe gold bottle, this stylish, timeless scent is ideal for taking you from day to night. Why? You first inhale light notes of bergamot and blackcurrant, paired with sweet violet. But as the scent settles on your skin, it deepens, thanks to an iris heart and base notes of cedarwood, sandalwood and musk. Refined and sophisticated, the fragrance finishes with ambergris (pronounced amber-grease), a warm and spicy base layer. If you want to turn heads with your scent, this is it!

listings.rawTitle: Creed Millesime Imperial Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: The gift that keeps on giving (even if you buy it for yourself) the Millésime Imperial Eau de Parfum is the answer to your search for a new scent. Encased in a luxe gold bottle, this stylish, timeless scent is ideal for taking you from day to night. Why? You first inhale light notes of bergamot and blackcurrant, paired with sweet violet. But as the scent settles on your skin, it deepens, thanks to an iris heart and base notes of cedarwood, sandalwood and musk. Refined and sophisticated, the fragrance finishes with ambergris (pronounced amber-grease), a warm and spicy base layer. If you want to turn heads with your scent, this is it!

listings.rawTitle: Discothèque Heathens, Cowboys and the Santa Ana Winds 8ml
listings.description: Discothèque's Heathens, Cowboys and the Santa Ana Winds Eau de Parfum (8ml) is an homage to an age of decadent debauchery; conjuring whisky and warm amber sunsets, whispered advances and sandalwood embers. With its 'no holds barred' attitude (and strict 'no photos' policy) Helena's offered a place to escape; a haven for heathens that simmered with sex and excess. A perfume that oozes seduction, it opens with a burst of palmarosa, smoky amyris, sweet grass and tea leaf, then leads you astray via cardamom, cedar and sandalwood down to a decadent den of suede, amber and musk. Think: sundrenched skin and diamond bracelets; scarlet nails and spilled champagne - and let's not forget the irreverent 'disco ball' lid, designed to reflect you as much as your signature scent does.

listings.rawTitle: Frédéric Malle Carnal Flower 10ml
listings.description: Frédéric Malle's Carnal Flower Eau de Parfum (10ml) captures the mysterious allure of tuberose in a divine, highly concentrated absolute. Like petals dipped in poison, this seductive scent opens with the apparent innocence of fresh, verdant botanicals and watery fruits, before yielding to a darker, more animalic side - camphor, shadowy spices, and the soft warmth of white musk. At its heart, the duality of tuberose flowers bloom in their purest form, evoking a fragrance that is at once delicate, daring, and utterly unforgettable.

listings.rawTitle: TRUDON Nuit Rouge Parfum - 3 x 15ml Set
listings.description: Discover olfactory artistry with the TRUDON Nuit Rouge Parfum Set, featuring three 15ml fragrance in discovery-sized vials, perfect for trial or travel. Designed to intrigue, Midnight Omen presents a warm, spicy aura anchored by woody notes. 45 Degrees offers an ultra-addictive scent centred around vanilla, while Mystique entices with a fusion of velvety florals and glowing amber. Wear solo or layer for a unique and opulent scent experience. Contents: Midnight Omen Parfum (15ml) 45 Degrees Parfum (15ml) Mystique Parfum (15ml)

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Myrrh & Tonka All Over Body Spray 125ml
listings.description: A lighter, more effortless iteration of the original cologne, the Myrrh & Tonka All Over Body Spray (125ml) offers a fresh way to wear a classic. Encapsulating the majesty of the Omumbiri tree (the centuries-old provider of prized and precious myrhh), this featherlight mist magics you to the gold dunes of the Namib Desert in Africa. With its rich and resinous notes, it has an intoxicating warmth, heightened by smooth, sensual tonka and a hint of amber. Wear it solo for a subtle veil of scent, or layer with another spray to create a fragrance that's uniquely yours.

listings.rawTitle: D.S. & Durga Radio Bombay Pocket Perfume Spray 10ml
listings.description: Made to teleport you to the Bandra heat with one spritz, the D.S. & Durga Radio Bombay Eau de Parfum (10ml) is a warm and woody fragrance you want in your collection. Infused with notes of sandalwood, blooms of musk, peach, ambrette and coco accents, this transitional scent moves from gourmand to deep and mysterious. Blending sweetness with spice, this icon provides an inspiring twist on traditional note.

listings.rawTitle: Frédéric Malle Musc Ravageur 10ml
listings.description: For those who dare, Musc Ravageur Eau de Parfum (10ml) by Frédéric Malle ignites an irresistible, smouldering allure. A masterful creation by perfumer Maurice Roucel, this fiery amber blend simmers with an unapologetic, magnetic allure. Sparkling top notes of bergamot and mandarin open with radiant luminosity, framing a sensual, floral-free heart that melts into a captivating amber base. Warm vanilla, rich sandalwood, and sultry musk intertwine, conjuring a scent that is all at once confident, sophisticated and irresistibly seductive. Bold yet nuanced, it's an unforgettable olfactory statement.

listings.rawTitle: Creed Men's Discovery Set (Absolu Aventus, Aventus, Green Irish Tweed, Millesime Imperial, Silver Mountain Water)
listings.description: Discover the ultimate fragrance journey with The House of Creed’s Men’s 5-Piece 10ml Discovery Set, a curated collection of the brand’s most revered and iconic scents. This luxurious set includes Aventus, the Maison’s legendary signature, opens with citrusy notes of bergamot, lemon and blackcurrant, layered with pineapple and woody accords for a commanding presence. Silver Mountain Water captures crisp alpine freshness with zesty citrus and salty aquatic notes. Millésime Imperial exudes sophistication with bergamot, violet and warm woods. Finally, Green Irish Tweed offers a fresh, earthy scent inspired by lush Irish landscapes. Encased in an exquisite gift box, this set is the perfect way to elevate your fragrance game with legacy and artistry. Contents: Aventus Eau de Parfum (10ml) Silver Mountain Water Eau de Parfum (10ml) Millesime Imperial Eau de Parfum (10ml) Absolu Aventus Eau de Parfum (10ml) Green Irish Tweed Eau de Parfum (10ml)

listings.rawTitle: Commodity Juice+ Bold 100ml
listings.description: Make an entrance with Commodity's Juice+ Bold (100ml), a fragrance that feels like a comforting hug, this ready-to-spritz treat is designed to linger on the skin. Perfect for those who have a flare for the dramatics, this intensive rendition blends accents of raspberry pulp and strawberry notes. Traces of Bulgarian rose, rhubarb and sugary cyclamen begin to pull through after a few minutes. As for the base? You are met with warming accords of vetiver, patchouli and amberwood. Delish!

listings.rawTitle: Kilian Sunkissed Goddess 50ml
listings.description: Bottling the spirit of summer, Kilian's Sunkissed Goddess perfume spray (50ml) is a limited-edition fragrance inspired by the timeless Tahitian scent of monoi oil. A new take on the traditional Polynesian elixir, this creamy infusion stars a delicate blend of ylang-ylang and tiare flower, evoking a soft, sun-soaked sensuality. A warm blend of coconut and vanilla cocoon the floral medley in velvety sweetness, before the brand's olfactive signature of guaiac wood and cistus labdanum anchor the aroma with a vibrant appeal. Rich yet airy, this perfume invites the senses to enjoy each day as though basking on the sun-kissed beaches of Tahiti.

listings.rawTitle: The Nue Co. Otherwhere | Comfort Gourmand | Fragrance 50ml
listings.description: Experience a scent that feels like a warm, familiar embrace, modern yet rooted in the past, meet The Nue Co. Otherwhere Fragrance (50ml). It’s a luxurious, neuro-fragrance that blends sweet, woody and aromatic notes to evoke intimacy and comfort. Opening with vibrant pink pepper, juniper berry and spicy cardamom, it melts into a heart of violet, almond blossom and caramel, creating a gourmand warmth that’s both inviting and soothing. The base of frankincense, oud and sandalwood grounds the scent in earthy richness, crafting a deeply personal aura. Designed for day and night wear, it’s a sensory journey that reconnects you to your most comforting memories, wherever you are.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Forte Mandarine Basilic Eau de Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Composed by perfumer-explorers who travelled around the globe to take inspiration from nature to create an ode to its unique wonder, the Aqua Allegoria Forte collection celebrates the beauty of nature with sheer intensity inspired by raw ingredients and notes. Guerlain's mandarin-scented eau de parfum transports you to the sight of the mandarine basilic forte, a lively, tangy citrus soaking in the sunlight. The exquisite Italian fruit is paired with delicious vanilla tincture and warming sandalwood to create a truly lively and uplifting fragrance with notes of basil completing this Italian-inspired scent. A fragrance that's designed to last, once you've finished your first love affair with this fresh fragrance, you can top up your refillable and recyclable bottle time and time again.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Peony & Blush Suede Body & Hand Lotion 250ml
listings.description: You could gift Jo Malone London’s Peony and Blush Suede Body and Hand Lotion (250ml), but a formula this dreamy is hard to give away. Transporting you to an English ballroom decadently dressed with fragrant peonies, this evocative scent is laced with juicy red apples and a decadent mix of jasmine, rose and gillyflower. The base? A soft yet sensual blend of blush suede. Enriched with coconut oil and hyaluronic acid, this luxurious lotion instantly hydrates and conditions the skin, enveloping it in its addictive scent.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Margiela Replica on a Date Eau de Toilette 30ml
listings.description: Do sweaty palms, frequent breath checks and outfit adjustments all sound familiar to you? Here to evoke first date flutters, the pink-hued addition one of the most coveted fragrance line is the On A Date Eau De Toilette that instantly teleports you to a period in time when romance filled the air. Available in both 30ml and a whopping 100ml bottle, this excitable floral fusion boasts a flirtatious blend of pink pepper, patchouli and musk notes that are amplified by vetiver base accords that trigger the memory of that special person. Made to reignite forgotten — and even unadmitted — feelings, this olfactory formulation is jusssst as powerful as Cupid’s bow capturing the hearts and noses of all who are privileged enough to experience it. Now, this is what we call love at first spritz…

listings.rawTitle: Vyrao Ludatrix Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: The Vyrao Ludatrix Eau de Parfum (50ml) is a daring and empowering fragrance that fuses notes of lipstick and latex with soft rose, Sichuan pepper and inspiring orris. Tantalising ambrette ignites arousal, layered with voluptuous cedarwood, sandalwood and olibanum to evoke positivity and protection. A potent blend of ambrox and musk deepens the sensuality, making this scent both bold and irresistible. Designed to evoke bold desire and fearless self-expression, it's a provocative yet sophisticated fragrance that captures boundless confidence and allure in every spray.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Velvet Rose & Oud All Over Body Spray 125ml
listings.description: A lighter, more effortless iteration of the original cologne, the Velvet Rose & Oud All Over Body Spray (125ml) from Jo Malone London offers a fresh way to wear a classic. It opens with warm, spicy clove before unfolding into a heart of velvety Damask rose. At the base, rich and resinous oud lends a deep, smoky intensity, adding depth without weight. Wear it solo for a subtle veil of scent, or layer with another spray to create a fragrance that's uniquely yours.

listings.rawTitle: KAYALI Tutti Fruity Cotton Candy 50ml (Eden Sparkling Lychee | 39 + Vanilla Candy Rock Sugar | 42)
listings.description: Indulge in the playful sweetness of the KAYALI Tutti Fruity Cotton Candy 50ml Duo, a vibrant pairing that’s impossible to resist. This playful set features two luscious fragrances: Eden Sparkling Lychee, a sparkling burst of juicy lychee, blackcurrant and violet; it’s like biting into a fresh, fruity bloom. Paired with the Vanilla Candy Rock Sugar, a decadent gourmand blend of candied pear, marshmallow and caramel, reminiscent of a candy shop dream. Together, they create an irresistible sensory experience; bright, flirtatious and utterly indulgent. Perfect for layering or wearing solo, these fragrances add a fun, playful edge to your scent wardrobe, making every day feel like a sweet escape into paradise. Contents: Eden Sparkling Lychee|39 Eau de Parfum (50ml) Vanilla Candy Rock Sugar|42 Eau de Parfum (50ml)

listings.rawTitle: Creed Aventus Discovery Set
listings.description: The Aventus Discovery Set brings together three fragrances from the Aventus collection: the bold original creation, a fresher version and its most intense take. From dry woods and striking citrus to fresh fruits and smoky spices, the collection features a trio of 10ml discovery editions, perfectly sized for trial and travel. Contents: Aventus Eau de Parfum (10ml) Aventus Cologne Eau de Parfum (10ml) Absolu Aventus Eau de Parfum (10ml)

listings.rawTitle: D.S. & DURGA Coriander Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Fresh, but unique with its pungent green atmosphere, D.S. & Durga's Coriander scent is evocative of the grass, the expanse of fields and the sweeping sea. Evolving from their Brooklyn roots (it all started in D.S.’s Bushwick apartment…), today D.S. & Durga’s luxury line is lauded by tastemakers — or should we say, scent makers — and fragrance-ophiles around the world. Bottling a universe within each perfume and candle, each scent has a story, the brand's Coriander perfume pays homage to the cool yet pungent scent of your favourite herb. With top, opening notes of pepper and juniper needle that lead to a heart of clary sage before finishing with notes of magnolia and musk that linger on skin long after it's spritzed, this scent will garner a host of compliments and enquiries as to "what perfume are you wearing?"...

listings.rawTitle: Commodity Paper Expressive 100ml
listings.description: Discover the heartfelt scent of paper with Commodity's Paper Expressive (100ml), a combination of grounding woody notes evoking that cosy feeling of writing to a loved one. Created by Donna Ramanauskas, this fragrance is a cult classic brought back from the archives and captures the essence of writing a heartfelt letter. Earthy cedarwood, uplifting sandalwood and musky amber combine to evoke warmth and cosiness, before iso e super mingles in to interact with your natural skin chemistry, offering a scent that evolves and feels truly yours.

listings.rawTitle: Aesop Marrakech Intense Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Aesop’s Marrakech Intense Eau de Parfum (50ml) is a seductive blend of spices, woods and florals that transports you to sun-drenched souks and bustling medinas. Opening with vibrant notes of cardamom and bergamot, it unfolds into a heart of delicate jasmine, neroli and rose, each echoing the city’s vibrant life. A rich base of sandalwood, cedar and clove adds warmth and sensuality, echoing the timeless allure of Moroccan nights. Encased in a sleek amber bottle with a basalt-inspired textured cap, it celebrates contrasts; spice and serenity, tradition and modernity. An unforgettable scent for those who seek depth, character and a touch of exotic mystery.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Absolus Allegoria Ambre Samar Eau de Parfum 125ml
listings.description: Sweet, seductive and inspired by moonlit nights, the Guerlain Absolus Allegoria Ambre Samar Eau de Parfum (125ml) offers an alluring take on vanilla accents. Melding the worlds of mysterious frankincense, ambergris, illuminating amber accords with a touch of honey, this gourmand fragrance bursts with warmth. Sure to turn heads everywhere, this inviting perfume takes your senses on an adventure.

listings.rawTitle: Creed Aventus Cologne Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: On its way to become your new trademark scent is The House of Creed's Aventus Cologne. This effervescent fragrance opens with a fruity and aromatic burst of spicy ginger, zesty mandarin and tangy pink pepper. Its sweetness is then complemented by a succulent heart of rich patchouli that mingles with creamy sandalwood and smoky vetiver to create a fresh yet full-bodied scent. The leathery balsamic base of styrax, birch, musk and tonka only adds to the charm of this crisp aroma.

listings.rawTitle: Creed Aventus Cologne Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: On its way to become your new trademark scent is The House of Creed's Aventus Cologne. This effervescent fragrance opens with a fruity and aromatic burst of spicy ginger, zesty mandarin and tangy pink pepper. Its sweetness is then complemented by a succulent heart of rich patchouli that mingles with creamy sandalwood and smoky vetiver to create a fresh yet full-bodied scent. The leathery balsamic base of styrax, birch, musk and tonka only adds to the charm of this crisp aroma.

listings.rawTitle: D.S. & DURGA Debaser In Bloom 50ml
listings.description: The D.S. & DURGA Debaser In Bloom opens with a brighter, fresher take on a cult classic, reworked for warmer days. This fresh interpretation builds on the original's fig and creamy undertones, lifting them with white currant, rosemary flower and gardenia for a scent that feels airy yet grounded. Notes of coconut husk, musk and raspberry leaf keep things smooth as it settles. Easy to wear, it moves seamlessly from spring afternoons to summer evenings, echoing the nostalgia and ease that inspired it.

listings.rawTitle: BORNTOSTANDOUT® Dirty Heaven Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: the BORNTOSTANDOUT Dirty Heaven Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a nod to paradise found in the most unexpected places. The fragrance opens with delicate white florals, giving way to a rich heart of jasmine and neroli. As it settles, the warmth of tonka bean, saffron, and a hint of ambroxan create a seductive, unforgettable finish, while whispers of vanilla and white musks round out the olfactive experience. This floral perfume dares you to embrace hidden pleasures with slight defiance, where the thrill of the unknown takes over.

listings.rawTitle: BORNTOSTANDOUT® Dirty Rice 15ml
listings.description: Not your typical spritz, the Dirty Rice Eau De Parfum (15ml) rewrites the rules with this refined scent, reminiscent of an intimate evening spent cooking by candlelight. The wildcard in your fragrance wardrobe, this creamy perfume features an intricate blend of almond, peony and milk to open. Star note basmati rice follows, with its dominant, familiar culinary aroma to leave a lasting impression on the senses. Smoked tendrils of sandalwood, cetalox and musk round off the trail with raw warmth, mingling in the base with sweet, skin-like comfort. Authentic and alluring, this perfumes character is captured in its unique opaque flacon.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Margiela Replica on a Date Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Do sweaty palms, frequent breath checks and outfit adjustments all sound familiar to you? Here to evoke first date flutters, the pink-hued addition one of the most coveted fragrance line is the On A Date Eau De Toilette that instantly teleports you to a period in time when romance filled the air. Available in both 30ml and a whopping 100ml bottle, this excitable floral fusion boasts a flirtatious blend of pink pepper, patchouli and musk notes that are amplified by vetiver base accords that trigger the memory of that special person. Made to reignite forgotten — and even unadmitted — feelings, this olfactory formulation is jusssst as powerful as Cupid’s bow capturing the hearts and noses of all who are privileged enough to experience it. Now, this is what we call love at first spritz…

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Orange Marmalade Cologne 100ml
listings.description: Inspired by Paddington Bear's favourite treat, the Orange Marmalade Cologne (100ml) from Jo Malone London is a vibrant scent that'll whisk you back to your childhood. Taking you on an olfactive journey of the marmalade making process, this scent begins with the bright accord of orange peel, reminiscent of them simmering on the stove. The vibrant aroma is then twisted by the tart bite of bitter orange (also known as orange bigarade) to tantalise the senses. Finally, cashmere woods are blended to create a warming, comforting feel. We have a feeling your cravings will be curbed as soon as you spritz this sweet delight.

listings.rawTitle: NEST New York Vanilla Bourbon Travel Spray 8 mL/.27 fl oz.
Jo Malone London English Pear & Freesia Hand Care Collection
listings.description: Elevate your hand care routine with Jo Malone London's English Pear & Freesia Hand Care Collection. Featuring the brand's iconic hand cream, this kit is infused with hyaluronic acid and clary sage extract for intense hydration and moisture. Thanks to its lightweight formula it sinks in effortlessly with no sticky residue left behind. The icing on top? It'll leave your skin scented with luscious notes of golden pear and citrusy freesia. And what's better than one of this hero? Two! So, now you can have one with you for on-the-go nourishment and one by bed for a self care treat. Contents: English Pear & Freesia Hand Creams (2 x 30ml)

listings.rawTitle: Jo Loves Black Cashmeran and Tonka a Fragrance Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Rich and earthy, Jo Love's Black Cashmeran & Tonka Eau de Parfum (50ml) is inspired by Dubai's luxurious cityscape. A defining moment for the founder, this decadent aroma showcases the juxtaposition of comforting dark notes colliding with the warm, golden feeling of adventure. After opening with creamy sweet tonka, this opulent fragrance melds into undertones of ginger and cardamom for a hint of subtle warmth. Then, it follows through to a bed of alluring black cashmeran to add depth and musk. Designed to linger in the air *and* on the skin, this sultry scent makes a memorable impression wherever you go...

listings.rawTitle: Jo Loves Black Cashmeran and Tonka a Fragrance Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Rich and earthy, Jo Love's Black Cashmeran & Tonka Eau de Parfum (100ml) is inspired by Dubai's luxurious cityscape. A defining moment for the founder, this decadent aroma showcases the juxtaposition of comforting dark notes colliding with the warm, golden feeling of adventure. After opening with creamy sweet tonka, this opulent fragrance melds into undertones of ginger and cardamom for a hint of subtle warmth. Then, it follows through to a bed of alluring black cashmeran to add depth and musk. Designed to linger in the air *and* on the skin, this sultry scent makes a memorable impression wherever you go...

listings.rawTitle: Kilian Good Girl Gone Bad Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Fresh, floral, yet ever so alluring, the Good Girl Gone Bad Eau de Parfum encapsulates a summer spent surrounded by flowers and nature. , Beginning with the beguiling notes of apricot-tinged osmanthus, orange blossom and rose of May, the subtle scent is paired with a charming bouquet of syrupy tuberose, jasmine and narcissus. It's narrative? Imagine: you're in a royal garden, surrounded by startlingly high bushes and trees - peppered with bright blossoms and birds. A stream peeks between the shrubbery twinkling invitingly from a distance. You inhale a breath of fresh, perfumed, summery air, before scrambling through the flowers and winding, worn paths, on your bid to see every colour and petal in all its glory...

listings.rawTitle: Maison Francis Kurkdjian HOMME A LA ROSE Eau de Parfum 70ml
listings.description: Maison Francis Kurkdjian's Homme A La Rose Eau de Parfum (70ml) reimagines rose fragrances through a more modern, masculine lens. This floral-woody cologne opens with fresh notes of grapefruit and clary sage, capturing a clean, green essence. Damascena rose gives way to a rosy heart, warmed by amber woods to leave a sensual trail that settles on the skin with lasting depth and intensity. Revelling in the unexpected, this floral iteration for men breaks the boundaries of perfumery.

listings.rawTitle: Fugazzi Goudh Extrait de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Add a touch of elegance to your perfume collection with Fugazzi Fragrances' Goudh Eau de Parfum (100ml). Indulgence is just a spritz away thanks to sweet but sharp notes of mandarin and grapefruit. It gets better (or shall we say: deeper) with accents of sambac, jasmin, ambergris, musk and Indonesian patchouli. Expect its captivating, oud-meets-sandalwood base to draw your senses in further, making this fragrance a must have for your shelf.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Nomade Lumière d'Égypte Eau de Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Inspired by Chloé founder Gaby Aghion's birthplace, Nomade Lumière d'Égypte (75ml) evokes a journey along the Nile where blue lotus blooms. Blue lotus opens the scent, followed by soft jasmine, while pink berry and elemi add a richness and warmth. A base of kyphi accord with cinnamon, sandalwood and myrrh gives depth for a long-lasting olfactive trail. Encased in the Nomade bottle with golden accents and a dusky blue knot, the scent carries a light, aquatic floralcy.

listings.rawTitle: Juliette Has a Gun Ode To Dullness Eau de Parfum 7.5ml
listings.description: Embrace the beauty of simplicity with Juliette Has a Gun Ode To Dullness Eau de Parfum (7.5ml), a calming, floral musk scent. Inspired by the Asian philosophy of finding serenity in dullness, this fragrance blends velvety notes of badiane, cashmere flower and sandalwood, creating a serene, minimalistic aroma. Top notes of badiane and freesia introduce a delicate freshness, while the heart of cashmere flower and sandalwood offers enveloping warmth. Subtle musks and tonka bean in the base add a soft, soothing finish. Perfect for moments of introspection or quiet confidence, it celebrates the poetry in simplicity and the extraordinary within the ordinary.

listings.rawTitle: Le Labo Neroli 36 Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Did you know that neroli is another name for the essence of orange blossom? Bottling up this unique, tender scent is the Neroli 36 Eau de Parfum (50ml) from Le Labo. Boasting a quality that's characterised by wildflowers blended with a warm and sensual base, this distinctive perfume transports you to a summer surrounded by blooming florals. It opens with accords of orange blossom, mandarin and aldehydes, only to then be complemented by a blend of tonka beans, musk and vanilla. Whatever's on your perfumery wish list, this soul-lifting scent is sure to tick the box...

listings.rawTitle: Le Labo Santal 33 Liquid Balm 9ml
listings.description: Top up your signature scent wherever you go with Le Labo's Santal 33 Liquid Balm (9ml). Enriched with a blend of cardamom, iris and violet mingled with sandalwood, cedarwood and musky accords, this enchanting fragrance is sure to attract admirers. Plus, its formula features moisture-locking safflower oil to nourish the skin it meets. Take the rollerball with you and apply the perfume balm onto the body where fragrance is wanted. We suggest keeping it in your bag at all times.

listings.rawTitle: BORNTOSTANDOUT® Dirty Heaven 15ml
listings.description: the BORNTOSTANDOUT Dirty Heaven Eau De Parfum (15ml) is a nod to paradise found in the most unexpected places. The fragrance opens with delicate white florals, giving way to a rich heart of jasmine and neroli. As it settles, the warmth of tonka bean, saffron, and a hint of ambroxan create a seductive, unforgettable finish, while whispers of vanilla and white musks round out the olfactive experience. This floral perfume dares you to embrace hidden pleasures with slight defiance, where the thrill of the unknown takes over.

listings.rawTitle: BORNTOSTANDOUT® Indecent Cherry 15ml
listings.description: Cherry, but not as you know it. BORNTOSTANDOUT's Indecent Cherry Eau De Parfum (15ml) takes the fruit and flips it on its head. Sultry and unapologetic, it opens with a glossy cherry note that's equal parts juicy and mischievous, softened only slightly by whispers of almond and creamy vanilla. But just when you think you've figured it out, the scent deepens as amber, sandalwood and a hint of spice turn up the heat, revealing something a little darker. Audacious from first spritz, this is the cherry that bites back.

listings.rawTitle: BORNTOSTANDOUT Cola Addict Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Indulge in the icy, fizzy thrill of BORNTOSTANDOUT Cola Addict Eau de Parfum (50ml) is a unisex fragrance that captures the exhilarating rush of a perfectly poured cola. This scent is an addictive blend of citrus, spice and gourmand notes that evoke the crisp bubbles and sweet syrup of your favourite soda. Opening with sparkling cola foam, zesty lemon, lime and a hint of cinnamon, it’s instantly invigorating. As it develops, hints of rum, caffeine and nutmeg add depth and warmth, before settling into a seductive base of vanilla, caramel, sandalwood and moss. The result? An irresistible, totally crave-worthy scent that’s as refreshing as it is addictive, perfect for those who crave a bold, unconventional fragrance experience that’s both sweet and spicy.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Twilly d'Hermès Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Are you a fan of floral fragrances? Enter: Hermès' Twilly d'Hermès Eau de Parfum (50ml), which is just that but with a twist. Opening with a bright zesty spark, this fragrance stars ginger, bitter orange and bergamot top notes. It then blooms into a flowering heart of tuberose, orange blossom and jasmine to add a fresh-sweet touch. Finally, it mingles on a comforting bed of creamy sandalwood and vanilla. The cherry on top? It's housed in a lantern-shaped bottle finished with a hand-tied silk ribbon that makes for a playful aesthetic to this ensemble.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Noir Extreme All Over Body Spray 150ml
listings.description: Designed for all-over spritzing with 360° spray technology, the TOM FORD Extreme All Over Body Spray (150ml) offers a refreshing way to wear the bold and unmistakable Noir Extreme scent. This lightweight mist veils skin in spicy citrus, saffron and smooth sandalwood, while creamy Kulfi accord melts into warm notes of amber and nutmeg. Worn solo or layered with your Noir Extreme Eau de Parfum, it brings a more laid-back take on intensity.

listings.rawTitle: Sisley Paris Soir de Lune Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Feminine, elegant and deeply sensual, SISLEY-PARIS' Soir de Lune is inspired by the intimate world of art with an intense blend of zesty citrus, heady florals and earthy undertones. If you want to create more romance in your life, simply wear this. Available in 30ml, 50ml and 100ml, Soir de Lune is designed especially for women as a celebration of femininity and sensuality. It opens with top notes of bergamot, mandarin and lemon mixed with fresh herbs and spices, harmonised with a floral heart that stars jasmine, mimosa, May rose and peach. A woody and earthy base rounds it off beautifully with hints of honey, sandalwood and patchouli. Don't be surprised if you turn heads - and catch hearts - every time you wear it.

listings.rawTitle: Sisley Paris Soir de Lune Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Feminine, elegant and deeply sensual, SISLEY-PARIS' Soir de Lune is inspired by the intimate world of art with an intense blend of zesty citrus, heady florals and earthy undertones. If you want to create more romance in your life, simply wear this. Available in 30ml, 50ml and 100ml, Soir de Lune is designed especially for women as a celebration of femininity and sensuality. It opens with top notes of bergamot, mandarin and lemon mixed with fresh herbs and spices, harmonised with a floral heart that stars jasmine, mimosa, May rose and peach. A woody and earthy base rounds it off beautifully with hints of honey, sandalwood and patchouli. Don't be surprised if you turn heads - and catch hearts - every time you wear it.

listings.rawTitle: Sisley Paris Eau du Soir Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Inspired by the oriental gardens in Seville, SISLEY-PARIS' Eau du Soir - now available in 30ml, 50ml and 100ml - delights the senses with a fresh bouquet of florals and bittersweet citrus sliced with musky undertones. This evocative fragrance will make a timeless addition to your scent wardrobe. It captures the moment when the iconic syringa flower exhales its sweet scent at dusk in the gardens of the Real Alcázar Palace in Seville. Blending top notes of grapefruit and mandarin, it's designed to take you on a journey with undertones of rose and delicate jasmine, harmoniously mixed with ylang ylang and of course syringa. The final touch? Warming base notes of amber and patchouli. Don't be surprised if it becomes your new favourite - not just for the wanderlust-worthy scent, but also its sculptural bottle, which is topped with an 18kt gold-plated stopper designed by the famed Polish artist Bronislaw Krzysztof. A true delight in all senses.

listings.rawTitle: Sisley Paris Eau du Soir Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Inspired by the oriental gardens in Seville, SISLEY-PARIS' Eau du Soir - now available in 30ml, 50ml and 100ml - delights the senses with a fresh bouquet of florals and bittersweet citrus sliced with musky undertones. This evocative fragrance will make a timeless addition to your scent wardrobe. It captures the moment when the iconic syringa flower exhales its sweet scent at dusk in the gardens of the Real Alcázar Palace in Seville. Blending top notes of grapefruit and mandarin, it's designed to take you on a journey with undertones of rose and delicate jasmine, harmoniously mixed with ylang ylang and of course syringa. The final touch? Warming base notes of amber and patchouli. Don't be surprised if it becomes your new favourite - not just for the wanderlust-worthy scent, but also its sculptural bottle, which is topped with an 18kt gold-plated stopper designed by the famed Polish artist Bronislaw Krzysztof. A true delight in all senses.

listings.rawTitle: U Beauty PROEM Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: U Beauty's Proem Eau de Parfum (50ml) is a richly layered fragrance blending floral, fruity and earthy notes. It opens with a delicate bouquet of rose, magnolia and jasmine, awakening to tart rhubarb and juicy lychee, then settles into a warm base of smoky vetiver, pistachio and a hint of pink peppercorn. Designed as a complete scent experience, it's a versatile fragrance that evolves from morning to night, inspiring renewal with each wear. Housed in a handcrafted Italian bottle with a translucent resin cap engraved with the brand's logo, this perfume embodies elegance and craftsmanship. It's an inviting, multidimensional scent wardrobe in one bottle, perfect for those seeking a refined, dynamic fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Fascent Milky No Way - Vial Refills
listings.description: Surrender to the moment with Fascent MILKY NO WAY Eau de Parfum refills (20ml). Crafted to captivate from day to night, this fragrance sheds all inhibitions, taking you on a journey through deep mystery and limitless self-expression. Opening with warm black pepper and hazelnut milk for a kick of spice, as the night unfolds and secrets unravel, heart notes of whipped cream and tonka bean transition into a rich base of sandalwood and amber. Consider it an invitation to unleash your wildest, most carefree self with every spray. Contents: MILKY NO WAY Eau de Parfum refills x 3 (20ml)

listings.rawTitle: Fascent Crème Brûlante - Vial Refills
listings.description: Feel the heat rising with Fascent CRÈME BRÛLANTE Eau de Parfum refills (20ml). This addictive scent bottles the irresistible moment a warm oven is opened, filling the air with the golden, rising warmth of freshly baked pastries. Starting with a creamy duo of rich vanilla and almond balm, it takes you on a journey of indulgence, enhanced with a splash of rum to add sweetness. Base notes of golden amber and comforting benzoin deepen the warmth of this scent, inviting you to savour the smell of freshly baked pastries. Contents: CRÈME BRÛLANTE Eau de Parfum refills x 3 (20ml)

listings.rawTitle: Fascent L'Eau D'Or Dort - Vial Refills
listings.description: Fall into soft serenity with Fascent L'EAU D'OR DORT Eau de Parfum refills (20ml). This comforting fragrance radiates tranquillity and freshness. Opening with zesty bergamot and lemon before, it then settles into a heart of soft orange blossom and crisp, clean linen accord. Evoking memories of sun-warmed skin and fresh sheets drying in a warm breeze, accents of white musk leave a dreamy, calming trail. Wear it solo, or layered with other scents to create a fragrance that’s uniquely yours. Contents: L’EAU D’OR DORT Eau de Parfum refills x 3 (20ml)

listings.rawTitle: Fascent Red Flag - Vial Refills
listings.description: A fragrance of seduction, push beauty’s boundaries with Fascent RED FLAG Eau de Parfum refills (20ml). This striking fragrance settles into the skin with a spark of fresh ginger and warm cardamom. At its heart is dark iris entwined with smoky frankincense, creating a sophisticated, velvety finish. An addictive base is revealed with notes Palo Santo wood and creamy tonka bean. Don’t even try to resist the temptation of this all-alluring scent. Contents: RED FLAG Eau de Parfum refills x 3 (20ml)

listings.rawTitle: Fascent Sel À Vie - Vial Refills
listings.description: Bathe in the warmth of golden sunshine with Fascent’s SEL À VIE Eau de Parfum refills (20ml). Capturing the essence of an endless summer, this radiant fragrance opens with a zesty burst of sweet orange and mandarin, evoking the bliss of a refreshing dip in the Mediterranean Sea. As the scent settles, you are wrapped up in a heart of fresh sea salt and Ylang Ylang, echoing the rhythmic crash of waves against the shore. Then, with a base of comforting gourmand vanilla and driftwood, it leaves a romantic trail that lingers long after the sun has set. Contents: SEL À VIE Eau de Parfum refills x 3 (20ml)

listings.rawTitle: Le Labo Fleur D'O 27 Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: A labour of love, Le Labo's Fleur D'Oranger 27 Eau de Parfum (50ml) is the perfect signature scent for anyone that adores a floral-tinged citrus. Inspired by a field of blooming orange trees in morning sunshine, this zesty creation (that took three years to create) bottles the scent of fresh orange blossom on a summer day. Paired with zingy lemon and sunny bergamot, this uplifting fragrance is enhanced by sweet and floral petitgrain and rounded out with soft and powdery musk. Creating a light fragrance that will last all day, this ever-evolving aroma is set to become your new essential and sensual favourite.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Francis Kurkdjian BACCARAT ROUGE 540 Extrait de Parfum 3*11ml
listings.description: Introducing the Maison Francis Kurkdjian Baccarat Rouge 540 Extrait de Parfum (3 x 11ml), a trio of travel-size vials that let you carry the iconic, woody-amber fragrance wherever you go. This extrait layers luminous Grandiflorum jasmine over toasted bitter almond and ethyl maltol sweetness, while ambergris and soft woody musk linger beneath, allowing the scent to develop gradually on the skin. Perfect for testing, layering or keeping one in your bag, each 11ml vial slips easily into your travel routine. Housed inside the signature red box with gold lettering, this gift set adds the label's signature style to any shelf or vanity. Contents: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Baccarat Rouge 540 Extrait de Parfum (3 x 11ml)

listings.rawTitle: BORNTOSTANDOUT® DGAF Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Rebellion in scent form, BORNTOSTANDOUT DGAF Eau De Parfum (50ml) blends chaos with confidence. This fragrance kicks off with fresh Calabrian bergamot, citrus and sage, quickly followed by a surprising floral note of violet. As it settles, smoky sandalwood, spicy pepper and the richness of Bulgarian rose create a bold clash of contrasts. The base lingers with amber, tonka bean and musk, offering a warm, seductive finish. Untamed and unexpected, but somehow, it all works.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Loves Rose & Dates A Fragrance 100ml
listings.description: Experience romance in just a spritz with the Jo Loves Roses & Dates (100ml). Transporting the senses to sun-drenched city of Marrakesh, this aroma captures the warming sensuality of the 'Red City'. Rich and decadent, fresh dates tempt the senses with a sweetened nuance, blended with delicate rose petals for a softer touch. A spiced fusion of amber, jasmine and pink pepper imitate the scents experienced walking through Moroccan markets in the peak of the sun's rays.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Peony & Blush Suede Gift Set
listings.description: For those who favour floral, treat the skin and senses to Jo Malone London's Peony & Blush Suede Gift Set. Featuring a full-sized spray and body crème, this fragrant duo transports you to a peony-filled garden with its fresh and delicate disposition. Blended with juicy red apple and a bouquet of jasmine, rose and gillyflower, its soft scent descends into a sensual base of blush suede, adding a layer of luxurious depth. Sweep the rich crème on for plush moisture before spraying the cologne across the pulse points for a lasting trail. CONTENTS: Peony & Blush Suede Cologne (30ml) Peony & Blush Suede Body Crème (50ml)

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Terre d'Hermès Eau de Parfum Intense 100ml
listings.description: Ready to meet your new signature scent? Cue Hermès Terre d'Hermès Eau De Parfum Intense (100ml). Inspired by one's relationship with nature, this earthy fragrance was created by Christine Nagel, Hermès' perfumer, and combines fiery bergamot with burning wood, underpinned by the mineral notes of intense lava stone. What's more, this luxury scent deserves pride of place on your vanity thanks to its thoughtful design. At its base, the bottle rests on an 'H' leaving its imprint on the earth, while at the top the light is reflected by metal shoulders. Ready, set, spritz...

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Nerolia Vetiver Eau de Toilette Refill 200ml
listings.description: Part of the Aqua Allegoria collection, which celebrates the wonders of the world, the Neroli Vetiver fragrance is essentially a love letter to Italy... Just one spritz and you'll be hooked. "Nerolia Vetiver is, first and foremost, an infatuation with Calabrian Neroli. It is the love of Italy, its landscapes and its art of living. It's la dolce vita!" says Guerlain Perfumer Delphine Jelk. This olfactory signature combines the floral radiance of its namesake, accentuated by vetiver and refreshing basil, and finally fused with a delicious fig accord. It's formulated with up to 95% natural origin ingredients*, including French beetroot alcohol, which comes from a network committed to responsible farming. Choose between an array of sizes, including a refill so you never have to worry about running out. Whichever version you choose, keep it pride of place on your vanity. *90% to 95% ingredients of natural origin, in accordance with the ISO 16128, calculation including water.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Mon GUERLAIN Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Bottling the brand's passion for its craft (which spans almost two centuries!), the Mon Guerlain Eau de Parfum (30ml) is an oriental fragrance infused with just four raw ingredients; French lavender, sambac jasmine, sandalwood and vanilla Tahitensis. How to describe this addictive scent? Oriental. Audacious. Radiant. Sensual. Expect notes of French lavender (grown in Provence), enveloped in vanilla Tahitensis before revealing a flourish of sambac jasmine that's been gathered at sunrise (so dreamy). It's rounded off with sandalwood to express feelings of strength and preserve the mystery of eternal femininity. We'll be keeping ours pride of place on our vanity.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Scarlet Poppy Cologne Intense 50ml
listings.description: Meet your new olfactory obsession, Jo Malone London's Scarlet Poppy Cologne Intense (50ml). Think: moreish, velvety smooth and delightfully decadent. Expect to be whisked away to the wild steppes of southwest Asia, covered in the extravagant blooms of the great scarlet poppy. Opening with rare and cocooning ambrette, this floral aroma is enhanced with velvety iris and rounded off with sweet and addictive tonka bean. Wear yours solo, or try layering it with another fragrance to create your own unique blend.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Jasmine Sambac and Marigold Cologne Intense 50ml
listings.description: Find yourself surrounded by an array of blooming florals as dawn rises with Jo Malone London's Jasmine Sambac & Marigold Cologne (50ml). This potent fragrance invites you on an olfactory adventure with its contrasting tones of crispness and warmth. To create its heady rich aroma, it opens onto the fruity, green note of vibrant marigold, and then falls into accords of sophisticated Jasmine Sambac which adds luminosity to the scent. Benzoin resin closes the trail, with warm, vanilla-like undertones to dry down with a subtle, yet compelling, sweetness. If it's a unique and alluring fragrance you're looking for, then you've come to the right place.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Francis Kurkdjian AQUA CELESTIA COLOGNE FORTE Eau de Parfum 70ml
listings.description: Crisp, crystalline and captured through a lens of light, Maison Francis Kurkdijan's Aqua Celestia Cologne Forte Eau de Parfum (70ml) invigorates the senses with its citrus scent palette. Opening with a fresh blend of bergamot and mimosa, this radiant cologne captures the olfactive attention for its sunny yet sophisticated disposition. A fruity blackcurrant bud accord introduces an air of zesty depth, before gradually melting into the mellowness of warm musks to close with a second skin-like settlement.

listings.rawTitle: D.S. & DURGA Cowgirl Grass 50ml
listings.description: The D.S. & Durga Cowgirl Grass captures the spirit of the American West with a fresh, floral twist. Originally launched in 2008, this reimagined version features vibrant top notes of bergamot peel, pink geranium and lychee, opening to a heart of jasmine, flowering grass and peony. Its warm base notes of vetiver, crystal amber and soft musk evoke the rugged beauty of the landscape, blending modern femininity with Western heritage. Housed in a sleek oval glass bottle, Cowgirl Grass is a captivating scent that balances freshness and earthiness, making it perfect for those who want to embody a free-spirited, adventurous vibe.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Absolus Allegoria Florabloom Eau de Parfum 75ml
listings.description: A bouquet bathed in the deep hues of moonlight, GUERLAIN's Absolus Allegoria Florabloom Eau De Parfum (75ml) takes inspiration from fragrant nocturnal florals. A spellbinding scent in which tuberose takes the lead, this enchanting eau de parfum honours the opulence and subtle sensuality of its star note. Shimmering amongst the midnight tones is a four o'clock flower accord, accompanied by soft rose, ylang-ylang and tendrils of frankincense, all warmed by the woody comfort of sandalwood. Effortlessly confident and endlessly addictive, this luxurious fragrance is sure to stand proudly at the forefront of your collection.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Bergamote Calabria Eau de Toilette 75ml
listings.description: Composed by perfumer-explorers who travelled around the globe to take inspiration from nature to create an ode to its unique wonder, the Aqua Allegoria collection aims to inspire you to act for change. Guerlain's bergamot-scented eau de toilette (formulated with ingredients of up to 95% natural origin*) takes you on a journey to the sun-drenched shores of Southern Italy, celebrating the zesty, green floral citrus of this precious fruit. Known as Calabrian green gold, this exquisite fruit is paired with the zesty, botanical air of petitgrain lemon to create a truly lively and uplifting fragrance. Notes of spicy pink peppercorn, cardamom and ginger intertwine with heady white musks to complete this Italian-inspired scent. A fragrance that's designed to last, once you've finished your first love affair with this fresh fragrance, you can top up your refillable and recyclable bottle time and time again. *90% to 95% ingredients of natural origin, in accordance with the ISO 16128, calculation including water.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Flora Salvaggia Eau de Toilette Refill 200ml
listings.description: Composed by perfumer-explorers who travelled around the globe to take inspiration from nature to create an ode to its unique wonder, the Aqua Allegoria collection aims to inspire you to act for change. Guerlain's Aqua Allegoria Flora Salvaggia Eau de Toilette Refill (200ml) is a revitalising fragrance (formulated with ingredients of up to 95% natural origin*), infused with a blend of captivating florals and refreshing fruity notes to create a truly captivating scent. The central wildflower accord is refreshed and uplifted by a watermelon note, fused with the pull of orange blossom and jasmine. As this settles on your skin you'll breathe in the powdery facets of iris and violet which complete this poetic floral fragrance and transport you to a field filled with nature's finest flowers. Designed to top up your precious Aqua Allegoria bottle, you can use this with your fragrance and enjoy your scent for even longer. *90% to 95% ingredients of natural origin, in accordance with the ISO 16128, calculation including water.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Rosa Rossa Eau de Toilette 75ml
listings.description: Part of the Aqua Allegoria collection, which celebrates the wonders of the world, the Aqua Allegoria Rosa Rossa fragrance is described as a dancing rose by the brand. According to the brand's Master Perfumer, Thierry Wasser, the Aqua Allegoria Rosa Rossa is "a dancing rose". Combining its blooming namesake with a heart of fruity raspberry, blackcurrant and lychee accents, it's finished with a creamy, powdery and musky bed of sandalwood. This delicate scent is formulated with up to 95% natural origin ingredients*, including French beetroot alcohol, which comes from a network committed to responsible farming. Be sure to keep the pretty (and refillable) bottle pride of place on your vanity. *90% to 95% ingredients of natural origin, in accordance with the ISO 16128, calculation including water.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Forte Rosa Rossa Eau de Parfum Refill 200ml
listings.description: Part of the Aqua Allegoria collection, which celebrates the wonders of the world, the Aqua Allegoria Forte Rosa Rossa Eau de Parfum Refill is bursting with sweet floral notes, just as its name suggests. This addictive scent boasts majestically blooming roses bathed in light, and paired with a juicy white peach over a deliciously woody base. It's formulated with more than 90% natural origin ingredients*, including French beetroot alcohol, which comes from a network committed to responsible farming. The pretty pink bottle deserves pride of place on your vanity, and you'll never have to worry about running out thanks to its refillable design. *90% to 95% ingredients of natural origin, in accordance with the ISO 16128, calculation including water.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Absolus Allegoria Epices Exquises Eau de Parfum 125ml
listings.description: Inspired by the spicy aromas of cardamom-flavoured coffee, the Guerlain Absolus Allegoria Epices Exquises Eau de Parfum (125ml) is an imaginative scent made to awaken your senses. This fragrance revels in the freshness and warmth of black pepper, the alluring woody notes of oud, patchouli and sandalwood and an adventurous coffee blend. Filled with contrasts from crisp cardamom accents to a comforting base anchored in precious spices, this inviting scent takes you on a journey to the Middle East.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Les Légendaires Insolence Eau de Toilette 75ml
listings.description: Getting straight to the heart of an uncompromising love characterised by a bold, sensual personality, the Les Légendaires Insolence Eau de Toilette is floral and fruity, seductive and sensual all at the same time. Housed in an iconic bottle designed by Raymond Guerlain in 1912, this evocative fragrance is sultry and daring. The scent dives headfirst into floral notes of violet accord with accents of iris, alongside soft notes of orange blossom. Telling the tale of a brazen love story with a protagonist of undeniable irresistibility at its centre, Insolence inspires its wearer to be confident, spontaneous and unabashedly yourself.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN La Petite Robe Noire Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Inspired by inimitable Parisian style, La Petite Robe Noire Eau de Parfum (50ml) is a fruity-floral scent that provides a sensual trail built around the beauty and power of its hero ingredient: the rose. Opening with black cherry, this irresistible fragrance boasts an enigmatic blend of almond, berries and bergamot. The second twirl takes place as rose enters the stage. Finally, tonka bean appears, leading you into almond seduction, highlighted by black tea for a smoky concoction. Prepare to become obsessed as you celebrate la joie de vivre and irreverence.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Les Légendaires Samsara Eau de Toilette 75ml
listings.description: A fragrant trail like no other, the Les Légendaires Samsara Eau de Toilette encourages you to lean on your intuition and follow your senses onto a path paved with harmony, love and peace. Translating to "eternal rebirth" in Sanskrit, this notable scent serves as a reminder of the agape love that resides within you. Bursting with prevalent jasmine notes, ylang-ylang florals that become melded together with the comforting warmth of sandalwood, iris, tonka bean and vanilla, this radiance composition lingers on your skin with envy-inducing allure.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Herba Fresca Eau de Toilette 125ml
listings.description: Part of the Aqua Allegoria collection, which celebrates the wonders of the world, the Aqua Allegoria Herba Fresca Eau de Toilette evokes the feeling of walking barefoot through freshly cut grass. Dreamy! Discover the Aqua Allegoria Herba Fresca Eau de Toilette: it's brimming with notes of fresh herbs sparkling with dew and springtime flowers, energised by a bunch of spearmint leaves and connected by a green tea accord. Thierry Wasser, Guerlain's Master Perfumer, describes it as "a tonic and refreshing country walk through grass glistening with dew". It's formulated with up to 95% natural origin ingredients*, including French beetroot alcohol, which comes from a network committed to responsible farming. Don't be surprised if it becomes your new signature scent, just be sure to stock up on the refill. *90% to 95% ingredients of natural origin, in accordance with the ISO 16128, calculation including water.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Mandarine Basilic Eau de Toilette 75ml
listings.description: Part of the Aqua Allegoria collection, which celebrates the wonders of the world, the delectable Aqua Allegoria Mandarine Basilic Eau de Toilette Refill will make a joyful addition to any scent wardrobe. Discover the Aqua Allegoria Mandarine Basilic Eau de Toilette: bursting with juicy and tangy mandarin flesh that's transcended by the aromatic freshness of basil, then energised by green tea over a background of woody notes. "Mandarine Basilic is a joyful creation based on the fruitiest of the citruses: mandarin. It forms an unexpected sparkling duo with the basil," says Thierry Wasser, Guerlain's Master Perfumer. This delectable fragrance is formulated with up to 95% natural origin ingredients*, including French beetroot alcohol, which comes from a network committed to responsible farming. The pretty bottle deserves pride of place on your vanity and you'll never have to worry about running out thanks to its refillable design. *90% to 95% ingredients of natural origin, in accordance with the ISO 16128, calculation including water.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Mandarine Basilic Eau de Toilette 125ml
listings.description: Part of the Aqua Allegoria collection, which celebrates the wonders of the world, the delectable Aqua Allegoria Mandarine Basilic Eau de Toilette will make a joyful addition to any scent wardrobe.
