Escape the heat with the cooling freshness of this evergreen, accented by rustic leather, woody cedar and sweet labdanum, creating an awakening, complex fragrance that is rounded by woody musk and smoky frankincense. Refresh and rebalance with eucalyptus, as the whispers of a long day in the desert linger.

listings.rawTitle: BYREDO Mumbai Noise Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: A celebration of the city of Mumbai, BYREDO’s Mumbai Noise Eau de Parfum drenches you in rich history, euphoria, nostalgic longing and a touch of mystical allure. A tribute to the sensorial multitudes and multifaceted modernity of Mumbai, anchored in Ben Gorham’s memories of its past, this allows you to savour his experience. A scent crowded with contrasts: of rich, warm woods and amber blended with brightness; of plummy Davana positioned alongside leather; bitter coffee stirred with sweet tonka beans. The mesmerising abundance of Chembur’s streets – the smoky haze of incense interspersed with streetside coffee carts and cacophonous soundscapes – is explored through a contemporary lens. Mumbai Noise Eau de Parfum is a love letter to Mumbai, is completely oil and paraben-free and is composed using only the highest quality materials.

listings.rawTitle: BYREDO Mumbai Noise Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: A celebration of the city of Mumbai, BYREDO’s Mumbai Noise Eau de Parfum drenches you in rich history, euphoria, nostalgic longing and a touch of mystical allure. A tribute to the sensorial multitudes and multifaceted modernity of Mumbai, anchored in Ben Gorham’s memories of its past, this allows you to savour his experience. A scent crowded with contrasts: of rich, warm woods and amber blended with brightness; of plummy Davana positioned alongside leather; bitter coffee stirred with sweet tonka beans. The mesmerising abundance of Chembur’s streets – the smoky haze of incense interspersed with streetside coffee carts and cacophonous soundscapes – is explored through a contemporary lens. Mumbai Noise Eau de Parfum is a love letter to Mumbai, is completely oil and paraben-free and is composed using only the highest quality materials.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Les Légendaires L'Heure Bleue Eau de Toilette 75ml
listings.description: The Les Légendaires L'Heure Bleue Eau de Toilette is an olfactory palette inspired by deep blue where notes of iris and vanilla merge and contrast, leaving fresh and warm nuances in its wake. Housed in an iconic bottle designed by Raymond Guerlain in 1912, this evocative fragrance is graceful yet bewitching. The scent opens with intoxicating aniseed and fresh bergamot before blossoming into delicate notes of neroli and a carnation accord that settles into a warm amber base, all the more punctuated by hints of iris, gourmand vanilla, benzoin and tonka bean. Intended to capture the meeting of day and night, this fragrance exemplifies soft romance and bottles up fleeting moments lost in time.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Pamplelune Eau de Toilette Refill 200ml
listings.description: Part of the Aqua Allegoria collection, which celebrates the wonders of the world, the Aqua Allegoria Pamplelune fragrance is a tangy and oh-so delicious choice for any scent wardrobe. Designed to evoke an imaginary garden, the Aqua Allegoria Pamplelune fragrance is bursting with the radiant and tangy liveliness of grapefruit elevated by the vibrant, fruity note of blackcurrant bud. The patchouli imbues the scent with its intense sensuality. It's formulated with up to 95% natural origin ingredients*, including French beetroot alcohol, which comes from a network committed to responsible farming. Be sure to keep it pride of place on your vanity. *90% to 95% ingredients of natural origin, in accordance with the ISO 16128, calculation including water.

listings.rawTitle: Escentric Molecules Escentric 03 Travel Size Refill
listings.description: This hand-luggage friendly 30ml, Escentric 03 fits snugly in your aluminium travel case. The multi-faceted sister to Molecule 03, it has the same earthy, mossy verdancy – the distinctive, dark exoticism of vetiver – together with fresh, citrusy top notes and a warm heart of sandalwood, cedar and musk. Like a traditional chypre, the overall impression is spicy yet green with a residual warmth that’s mellow, seductive and endlessly alluring. It's not your typical rich floral fragrance, but far more intriguing – showcasing the dizzyingly wonderful things synthetic notes can do. Customers often comment that strangers ask what they’re wearing when they’ve spritzed on an Escentric Molecules perfume - proof that when it comes to alluring scent, less is definitely more.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Eau de Citron Noir Eau de Cologne Natural Spray 100ml
listings.description: Spritz Hermès' Eau de Citron Noir Eau de Cologne Natural Spray (100ml) to your heart's content and get ready to be transported far, far away. Inspired by a very flavourful ingredient often used in Middle Eastern cuisine, this fragrance's hero note is black lime (AKA dried lime), which adds a sour and even smoky tinge to the scent. This citrusy accord is then complemented by black tea and guaiac wood for a woody yet fresh perfume. The cherry on top? It's housed in an iconic lantern bottle, adorned with a radical deep blue hue.

listings.rawTitle: Ceremonia Perfume Mist de Guava 10ml
listings.description: If it was possible to bottle the scent of dewy palms and warm sea air on faraway islands, we imagine the Perfume de la Guava (10ml) would be it. This light-as-air mist, enriched with the brand's tropical Guava scent, stirs a citrusy symphony of lemon zest and juicy peach, entwined with jasmine petals, velvety violet, and a hint of brown sugar. Crafted with a proprietary blend to protect your scalp from pollution, it also harnesses the hydrating power of agave extract to nourish strands and enhance softness. Plus, if you have an eye for all that glitters, it's infused with mini pearls to illuminate with the perfect pinch of shimmer.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Loves A Fragrance - Jo by Jo Loves 100ml
listings.description: Uniting notes of grapefruit, bitter orange, lime and spearmint, this Jo by Jo Loves scent was blended especially for the creator, Jo, herself. With a bewitching blend of refreshing grapefruit-infused citrus that softens down to a spiced, warming vetiver, cedarwood and black pepper base, ‘Jo by Jo Loves’ is a light, unique scent that suits both men and women. The fragrance is housed in a classic Jo Loves red bottle with a beautiful red and white gift box, making a perfect present – to yourself or a loved one – that will earn you limitless brownie points. It’s available in two sizes – 50ml and 100ml, so you can ensure you’re never without your signature scent – keep one in your bag, one on your desk and one in pride of place on your dressing table.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Shalimar L'Essence Eau de Parfum Intense 50ml
listings.description: Celebrating its 100th anniversary, Guerlain's Shalimar L'Essence Eau de Parfum Intense (50ml) is crafted by perfumer Delphine Jelk as a tribute to its heritage. This refined fragrance deepens the signature notes of vanilla, blending Madagascan vanilla tincture with ethylvanillin to enhance its richness without losing its signature allure. Framed by subtle bergamot, the floral heart combines rose and iris with a warm, amber base infused with woody vanilla, leather and musk. Housed in a modernized Art Deco-inspired bottle featuring a bold golden logo, Shalimar L'Essence is perfect for those who seek depth and elegance in their scent.

listings.rawTitle: Kilian Woman in Gold Eau de Parfum
listings.description: Inspired by a glorious painting that goes by the same name, the Woman in Gold Eau de Parfum marries sophistication with complex emotion aiming to add to (not mask) the woman who wears it. A luxurious treat (fashion bloggers have been known to use the decadent packaging as a clutch, FYI), this scent offers an alluring and harmonious blend of multi-faceted rose, delicate vanilla, fruity-but-spicy tonka bean, tart bergamot, musky patchouli and peppery akigalawood. Inspired by the contrasting light and shadows within the famed Woman in Gold painting, each ingredient offsets the others diverging and dancing, for a classy result thats startlingly balanced and simultaneously complicated.

listings.rawTitle: TRUDON Joséphine (Bergamot & Sandalwood) 70g
listings.description: ‘These are my subjects. I try to make them happy’, is how passionate botanist Joséphine Bonaparte described her precious plants. The future Empress bought the Château de Malmaison in Paris in 1799 and, seduced by its surrounding landscape, she created a blooming labyrinth of romantic, feminine flowers from around the world. It is this botanical paradise that inspires Cire Trudon’s Joséphine candle, which captivates the senses with head notes of bergamot, makrut lime and spices, before blooming with heart notes of Chinese camellia, Egyptian jasmine and Turkish rose. All this is anchored by base notes of Indonesian sandalwood, iris and white musks to take you on a sensory tour of the globe from the comfort of your (blissfully scented) home. Now available in the original (270g) and a votive-like mini (70g), this olfactory bouquet makes the perfect gift for someone special (read: you...).

listings.rawTitle: BORNTOSTANDOUT Drunk Maple 50ml
listings.description: Indulge in the decadent allure of BORNTOSTANDOUT’s Drunk Maple Eau de Parfum (50ml), a seductive vanilla fragrance. It opens with a sensual burst of pink pepper, davana and rum, evoking a lush jungle at dusk. The heart reveals a rich blend of maple syrup, coffee and soft suede, creating a velvety, gourmand experience that’s both warm and inviting. As it settles, luscious vanilla, sandalwood, and benzoin add depth and longevity, wrapping you in a comforting, addictive aroma. Drunk Maple is a daring scent for those who crave an intoxicating balance of sweetness and spice, perfect for nights that turn into unforgettable adventures.

listings.rawTitle: NEST New York Bamboo Specialty 3-Wick 600g
listings.description: Clean, vibrant and bright, NEST New York's Bamboo 3 Wick Candle (600g) brings the verdant shades of nature into your home. Opening with the fresh, slightly aquatic aroma of white lotus, this crisp scent is entwined around a heart of lush green notes, brightened with hints of sparkling citrus. As it blooms, this candle reveals a delicate bouquet of hyacinth and honeyed jasmine, summoning the heady fragrance of white florals dancing in the air following a spell of rain. Housed in a finely crafted glass vessel, etched with frosted stripes, it adds an elegant charm to any space.

listings.rawTitle: Escentric Molecules M+ Patchouli ATOM.iser 25.5ml
listings.description: Joining the single aroma-molecule of Iso E Super with patchouli, the Escentric Molecules M+ Patchouli ATOM.iser (8.5ml) is a velvety-smooth fragrance that promises maximum impact in one spritz. An innovative reimagination of the classic patchouli scent, this travel-sized spray captures the spirit of stripped-back perfumery, with its soft, woody allure that's effortlessly cool. To achieve this, two extracts of patchouli are used: patchouli coeur and Indonesian patchouli oil, blending both sides of the star note to bottle up its most naturally aromatic qualities. Ideal for weekends away or to slot in your day-to-day bag, this sleek atomiser ensures you'll never be without the signature scent.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Loves A Fragrance – Golden Gardenia 100ml
listings.description: Surround yourself in a captivating scent that is Jo Loves' A Fragrance in Golden Gardenia (100ml). This perfume plays with heady petals of gardenia flower before sinking into warm depths of spice and woods. Meaning? The aroma blooms into a heart of musky suede blended with earthy, aromatic cardamom. As for the base? You're met with elemi (AKA an aromatic resin) that has a piney slash balsamic accord mixed with smoky grey woods. Plus, it's housed in the brand's classic bottle with a striking red and white gift box, making a spectacular present to a loved one (or yourself).

listings.rawTitle: Escentric Molecules Molecule 05
listings.description: The latest addition to Geza Schoen’s single-scent library, Molecule 05 celebrates Cashmeran which, as its name suggests, is subtly evocative of cosy cashmere sweaters with its smooth and musky character. Conceived in a laboratory during the late 1970s, Cashmeran has loaned its quirky, comforting aroma to a host of well-known scents since its creation, but never before has a perfumer showcased its idiosyncrasies, solo. A minimalist’s dream, this complex, multi-faceted fragrance marries musk and woody qualities – having both dry and creamy traits that make you long to nuzzle into it. Add the tang of pine and the resinous characteristics of amber into the mix and you get an idea of this molecule’s power to captivate. It’s as perfect for pairing with actual cashmere as jeans and a t-shirt.

listings.rawTitle: Sisley Paris Izia La Nuit Eau de Parfum Spray 50ml
listings.description: An ode to the mystery of the night, SISLEY-PARIS’ Izia La Nuit is quite simply temptation bottled — the glossy packaging is the artistic handiwork of Polish sculptor Bronislaw Krzysztof. Inside, expect a tantalising cocktail of forest fruits, florals and woody undertones. Available in 30ml, 50ml and 100ml, Izia La Nuit evokes the allure of hedonistic nights — designed for the bold and daring woman who leaves an air of mystery in her wake. It opens with juicy blackcurrant, mandarin and warming cardamom, balanced with middle notes of d’Ornano rose, freesia and magnolia. The base? Think: woody and sensual with musky ambrox, patchouli and sweet vanilla. Be sure to keep the bottle pride of place when the fragrance runs out — it’s a true work of art.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Loves A Fragrance Paintbrush - Cobalt Patchouli & Cedar 7ml
Jo Loves Pomelo Luxury Travel Collection
listings.description: Looking for a set of skin care saviours that boast a long-lasting citrusy scent? Cue the Pomelo Luxury Travel Collection from Jo Loves. Here to whisk you away to a tropical Caribbean shoreline, this kit includes Pomelo A Fragrance, a grapefruit-infused perfume that's sharp and refreshing yet softens down to a spiced vetiver and suede base. Luckily for you, this set also features the nourishing Pomelo A Bath & Shower Gel and Pomelo A Body Lotion brimming with the exact same aroma. And just so you can keep your goodies safe and sound, they're housed in a travel-friendly branded bag. Contents: Pomelo A Fragrance (50ml) Pomelo A Body Lotion (75ml) Pomelo A Bath & Shower Gel (75ml)

listings.rawTitle: Maison Francis Kurkdjian AMYRIS FEMME Eau de Parfum 70ml
listings.description: Be swept off your feet by Maison Francis Kurkdijan’s Amyris Femme Eau De Parfum (70ml), a fruity floral fragrance that celebrates the union of amyris and iris essence. Vibrant top notes of lemon blossom and pear mingle with a romantic heart of sweet peas and iris essence oil, before being whisked away by amyris and musky amber at the base. Add the French fragrance house’s creation to your scent lineup for a touch of playful elegance.

listings.rawTitle: Vyrao High Five Eau de Parfum Set
listings.description: Vyrao's High-Five Set includes five of the brand's most addictive scents: Free 00, I Am Verdant, Witchy Woo, Magnetic 70 and Georgette. We dare you to try and pick a favourite - it's near impossible because they're all so unique. Want to feel carefree and embrace your sensuality? Free 00 will transport you to summers gone by with notes of citrus, sweet vanilla and musky sandalwood. Nature lovers will immediately fall for I Am Verdant, a fresh and tantalising green cocktail that awakens the senses like a breath of fresh air. Spritzing Georgette is designed to feel like an act of self-love with its enlightening floral scent, while Magnetic 70 plays with the power of attraction with an olfactory journey that banishes negative emotions and promotes positivity and presence. Finally, Witchy Woo is a spellbinding choice intended to bring a little magic into your everyday - if you want to spark your creativity and confidence, this'll certainly do the trick.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Loves Rose A Luxury Travel Bag 2x75ml + 50ml
listings.description: Encased in a handy travel bag, the Jo Loves Rose Luxury Travel Collection immerses you from top to toe in sensual floral notes. Start by cleansing with the Rose Petal 25 Bath & Shower Gel, before moisturising skin with the Rose Petal 25 Body Lotion for a trail of rose de mai absolute, rose absolute and ambrette seed. Layer your bodycare with a spritz of the Rose & Dates Fragrance, an aroma that captures the sun-drenched city of Marrakesh through decadent dates, rose petals and spices. Contents: Rose & Dates A Fragrance 50ml Rose Petal 25 A Bath & Shower Gel 75ml Rose Petal 25 A Body Lotion 75ml

listings.rawTitle: Juliette Has a Gun Vanilla Vibes Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Unleash your wild side with Juliette Has a Gun Vanilla Vibes Eau de Parfum (100ml) a captivating fusion of warm vanilla and oceanic salt that embodies sensuality and freedom. This unique fragrance opens with a fresh, mineral top note of sea salt, instantly evoking the feeling of ocean breezes. The heart reveals a rich blend of natural vanilla absolute and orchid, creating an irresistibly creamy and floral core. Deepening the allure, base notes of sandalwood, tonka bean, musk and benzoin add warmth and earthiness, grounding the scent in sophisticated elegance. Housed in a stunning ombre bottle of blue and gold, Vanilla Vibes is a celebration of powerful femininity and adventure. Effortlessly intoxicating, it invites you to embrace your free spirit and make a bold statement.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Colonia Il Profumo 50ml
TOM FORD Black Orchid Reserve Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Indulge in the luxurious allure of TOM FORD Black Orchid Reserve (100ml), a captivating fragrance housed in a sleek bottle. This sophisticated scent features a complex blend of contrasting notes, starting with bright ylang ylang and citrusy timut pepper, layered over a rich foundation of roasted tonka bean and black truffle that evoke earthy, nutty aromas. Hints of patchouli and amber add warm, woody depth, creating a sensual and long-lasting signature scent perfect for special occasions or evening wear. With its elegant presentation, Black Orchid Reserve makes an exquisite gift for someone special, offering a bold, floral-chypre experience that embodies mystery, elegance and timeless sophistication.

listings.rawTitle: Laboratory Perfumes Helios Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Citrus notes flirt with wild woody undertones in this lazy Tuscan afternoon inspired fragrance Helios Eau de Toilette (100ml) by Laboratory Perfumes. Helios emits scent trails that transport wearers to Tuscany in moments. Smoky notes of citrus and bergamot contrast with base notes of wood, amber, cedar, moss and musk. While citrus, bergamot, orange, grapefruit, green entwine with heart notes of floral, rose, lily of the valley. A fully sensorial fragrance that evokes feelings of meandering through orange groves, forests, and rolling hills steeped in Italian tradition.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN La Petit Robe Noire Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Immerse in a tapestry of Centifolia rose, embroidered with citrus zest with the Guerlain La Petit Robe Noire Eau De Toilette (50ml). This love letter to the delicate rose embodies the dynamic facets of the fresh bloom. Balanced with tangy citrus and sparkling musk, heart notes of white amber and tart cherry flesh bring a feminine tenderness to the traditional rose. Bitter, fresh bergamot illuminates the greenness of the bloom, evoking a zesty effervescence. Inspired by cascading, romantic rose fields, this fine fragrance captures the ethereal, ephemeral life cycle of the rose: bringing rose essence, rose absolute, and Centifolia rose to life. The rare Centifolia rose of Grasse is the crown jewel of the composition, featuring robust and honeyed petals. Organically grown, this precious flower is cultivated from the Mas des Sources estate, a testament to its delicacy and potency. This is rose at its most captivating.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN L’Homme Idéal Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Guerlain's L'Homme Idéal Eau de Toilette (100ml) is inspired by the brand's original 'Jicky' fragrance, and is composed around just three accords. Prepare to fall in lust... Meet the three (delectable) accords that make up this charming scent: first, it opens with sparkling and perfectly fresh top notes of citrus, rosemary, and orange blossom before revealing a sensual 'amaretto' heart based on an almond and tonka bean duo. Finally, the woody base combines Indian vetiver, cedar and leather.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN L’Homme Idéal Eau de Toilette 150ml
listings.description: Guerlain's L'Homme Idéal Eau de Toilette (150ml) is inspired by the brand's original 'Jicky' fragrance, and is composed around just three accords. Prepare to fall in lust... Meet the three (delectable) accords that make up this charming scent: first, it opens with sparkling and perfectly fresh top notes of citrus, rosemary, and orange blossom before revealing a sensual 'amaretto' heart based on an almond and tonka bean duo. Finally, the woody base combines Indian vetiver, cedar and leather.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Rosa Verde Eau de Toilette 75ml
listings.description: The Guerlain Aqua Allegoria Rosa Verde Eau de Toilette (75ml) is a tribute to the verdant rose: brought to life with green vibrance and aquatic freshness. Discover the dewy, fresh rose: take a dive into this fine fragrance experience. Aldehyde-soaked petals, crisp with the sun's greeting, are plunged into gleaming waters with succulent cucumber. Mellow, juicy pear flesh caresses the rose, leading it to unfurl into the arms of balsamic wood. Alive just beneath the water's surface, the petals sip effervescent musk. Revel in this marine rose fragrance that features top notes of bergamot, mint and cucumber, heart notes of rose, pear and violet leaf, and base notes of iris, white musk and cyprus. Guerlain now explores the relationship between scent and emotion through the Science of the Emotions. At the heart of this approach, Rosa Verde offers a feeling of pleasure and relaxation.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN L'Instant De Guerlain Pour Homme Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Meet the luminous and woody aromas of the L'Instant de Pour Homme Eau de Toilette, designed to highlight a unique milestone moment: the one in which a person takes the initiative towards change and after which everything is different. One spritz of this addictive perfume reveals fresh notes of citrus and star anise before giving way to deeply sensual notes of patchouli and cocoa. Composed of contrasting aromas, this intense, woody, sparkling and seductive fragrance is both fresh and warm, sensual and sophisticated, gourmand and savoury. It is nothing less than surprising.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Les Légendaires Jardins De Bagatelle Eau de Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Be emboldened by this seductive scent that tells the tale of an independent and self-indulgent character. The Les Légendaires Jardin de Bagatelle Eau de Parfum exudes a sparkling neroli palette with accents of bewitching tuberose contrasted by the sweet nature of a floral bouquet. Housed in an iconic glass bottle designed by Raymond Guerlain in 1912, this evocative fragrance is bright and free yet dark and flirtatious. The scent bursts with the joyful multitude of white flowers (neroli, jasmine and gardenia) grounded by notes centred around the sweet, spicey and floral facets of poisonous tuberose flower (emphasis on 'centred around' ) and woody notes. Telling the tale of a pleasure-seeking love story, Jardin de Bagatelle strikes the right balance between joy, spontaneity and seduction in the pursuit of pleasure and joie de vivre .

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Les Légendaires Mitsouko Eau de Parfum 75ml
listings.description: The Les Légendaires Mitsouko Eau de Parfum straddles between modernity and storybook romance. Triggering your senses with an excitable blend of unexpected spices and zinginess, this balanced fragrance explores the depths of a forbidden union like no other. Speaking in volumes for the feelings left unsaid, this expressive aroma dances with pulse-quickening danger, smitten spices and scents for a truly complex fragrance. Oozing with surprisingly warm notes of spicy peach and earthy patchouli which become intertwined with notes of jasmine and rose, what's not to love? Subtly adrongynous, this notable perfume is sure to have everyone asking for your secret... or even professing their undying love for you. Whichever comes first...

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Rosa Rossa Eau de Toilette 125ml
listings.description: Part of the Aqua Allegoria collection, which celebrates the wonders of the world, the Aqua Allegoria Pera Granita fragrance is described as a dancing rose by the brand. According to the brand's Master Perfumer, Thierry Wasser, the Aqua Allegoria Rosa Rossa is "a dancing rose". Combining its blooming namesake with a heart of fruity raspberry, blackcurrant and lychee accents, it's finished with a creamy, powdery and musky bed of sandalwood. This delicate scent is formulated with up to 95% natural origin ingredients*, including French beetroot alcohol, which comes from a network committed to responsible farming. Be sure to keep the pretty (and refillable) bottle pride of place on your vanity. *90% to 95% ingredients of natural origin, in accordance with the ISO 16128, calculation including water.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Mandarine Basilic Eau de Toilette Refill 200ml
listings.description: Part of the Aqua Allegoria collection, which celebrates the wonders of the world, the delectable Mandarin Basilic fragrance will make a joyful addition to any scent wardrobe. Discover Mandarine Basilic: bursting with juicy and tangy mandarin flesh that's transcended by the aromatic freshness of basil, then energised by green tea over a background of woody notes. "Mandarine Basilic is a joyful creation based on the fruitiest of the citruses: mandarin. It forms an unexpected sparkling duo with the basil," says Thierry Wasser, Guerlain's Master Perfumer. This delectable fragrance is formulated with up to 95% natural origin ingredients*, including French beetroot alcohol, which comes from a network committed to responsible farming. Choose between a travel-ready or full-sized version, oh and you'll never have to worry about running out thanks to its refillable design. The pretty bottle deserves pride of place on your vanity. *90% to 95% ingredients of natural origin, in accordance with the ISO 16128, calculation including water.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Vétiver Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: In the 1950s, the Guerlain family decided to create a fragrance based on the surprising roots of vetiver. This iconic eau de toilette is the result. This woody, spicy and elegant scent is designed to capture the world's very first morning, creating something truly unique and sophisticated. It opens on the spontaneous, piquant freshness of citrus fruits with orange, bergamot and lemon, before revealing a heart brimming with nutmeg and pepper to intensify. All this gives way to vetiver, tobacco and tonka bean for a sensual finish. Don't be surprised if it becomes your new favourite.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Les Légendaires Jicky Eau de Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Mischievous and captivating, the Les Légendaires Jicky Eau de Parfum is a play on contrasting notes of lemon and lavender atop a palette of woody vanilla and warm amber. Housed in an iconic glass bottle designed by Raymond Guerlain in 1912, this evocative fragrance is exuberant yet delicate. The scent opens with aromatic lavender and fresh lemon against a background of a gourmand vanilla and a fougère accord composed of bergamot, lavender, rosemary and woody notes. A dance between warm and cold, this scent celebrates androgyny, making it a venerable favourite for anyone and everyone.

listings.rawTitle: NEST New York Balinese Coconut Perfume Oil 30ml / 1 fl oz.
listings.description: The Balinese Coconut Perfume Oil (30ml) from NEST New York instantly transports you to the sun-soaked beaches of Bali... The heart of the scent lies around the essence of fresh coconuts, harvested from the islands of Southeast Asia, using a special extraction method to ensure the whole coconut is used (AKA the rich milk and salty husk) before being balanced out by floral accords. Scent aside, this formula is blended with baobab oil which effortlessly melts into skin delivering indulgent nourishment. Plus, if you fancy showing of your mixologist skills, layer with other fragrances to unleash an olfactive experience like no other.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Grand Soir Eau de Parfum Travel Refills 3x11ml
listings.description: Paint the town amber with Maison Francis Kurkdijan’s Grand Soir Eau de Parfum Travel Refills (3 x 11ml), a refined fragrance that invites you to embrace your glamorous side. Inspired by dark nights enlivened by city life, this fragrance imitates the vibrant hues of streetlights against honeyed skies. From its very first impression, dazzling amber paints the skyline with vivacity and liveliness. A cocktail of lavandin and cinnamon leaf adds to its head-turning trail, while bezoin and vanilla facets sweeten its warmth in a scent-sational finish.

listings.rawTitle: NEST New York Seville Orange Perfume Oil 30ml / 1 fl oz.
listings.description: Bringing the Spanish city's soulful spirit alive (no matter where you are in the world), Seville Orange Perfume Oil (30ml) gives you that holiday feeling all year round. Paying homage to the destination's renowned vibrancy, the fragrance is bursting with zesty oranges that have been harvested and hand-picked specially by four generations of Spanish farmers. The scent's refreshing fusion of juicy mandarin and zingy pink grapefruit base notes, nods to the liveliness of the city famed for its flamenco dancing. What's more, the oil has been artfully blended with baobab oil for a long-lasting formula that will travel with every move. A jaleo, anyone?

listings.rawTitle: NEST New York Seville Orange Perfume Oil 6ml / 0.2 fl oz.
listings.description: Bringing the Spanish city's soulful spirit alive (no matter where you are in the world), Seville Orange Perfume Oil (6ml) gives you that holiday feeling all year round. Paying homage to the destination's renowned vibrancy, the fragrance is bursting with zesty oranges that have been harvested and hand-picked specially by four generations of Spanish farmers. The scent's refreshing fusion of juicy mandarin and zingy pink grapefruit base notes, nods to the liveliness of the city famed for its flamenco dancing. What's more, the oil has been artfully blended with baobab oil for a long-lasting formula that will travel with every move. A jaleo, anyone?

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Vetiver and Golden Vanilla Cologne Intense 50ml
listings.description: Transport your senses to the paradisial Madagascan coastline with the Vetiver & Golden Vanilla Cologne Intense (50ml) by Jo Malone London. Evoking the sense of being surrounded by an orchid-filled jungle and green fields of tall grass, this sensual scent emits a warm and earthy aroma. It opens with a blend of cardamom and grapefruit tea accords that then weaves into notes of vetiver bourbon to create a smoky yet elegant allure. Vanilla bourbon adds a sensuality to the scent, complementing the vetiver heart and enhancing the deep, delectable nuances. Wear yours solo or try layering it with another fragrance to create your own unique blend.

listings.rawTitle: Vyrao I Am Verdant Eau de Parfum 10ml
listings.description: Wild at heart? You'll love Vyrao's I Am Verdant Eau de Parfum (10ml), an aromatic fragrance that’s reminiscent of being at one with nature. An uplifting scent, it has top notes of zesty bergamot and floral cyclamen to evoke that joyful feeling you breathe in the fresh air of green landscapes. These light accords are mingled with illuminating frankincense and invigorating base notes of iris absolute and orange flower. Oh, and don't miss the supercharged Herkimer diamond sitting pretty within the bottle; it's been energised by the brand's healer, Louise Mita. Good vibrations, incoming.

listings.rawTitle: NEST New York Turkish Rose Perfume Oil 30ml / 1 fl oz.
listings.description: Taking you on a journey through Turkey's renowned rose fields, NEST New York's Turkish Rose Perfume Oil (30ml) envelops the skin in a scent to seduce. Notes of dewy rose, black plum and saffron are warmed by blonde woods, creating a sensorial discovery that evokes wanderlust. At the heart of the scent lies Rosa Damascena, sourced from family-owned Turkish farms. Harvested during May and June only, the rosebuds are hand-picked at dawn to capture the optimal intensity of the flower. Blended with baobab oil, the sensuous formula melts into the décolleté, arms and legs - anywhere you wish to indulge with nourishment. Available in a 30ml bottle with a dropper or in a 6ml rollerball, the Perfume Oil delivers a concentrated and long-lasting fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Hermes Un Jardin sur le Toit Eau de Toilette Spray 50ml
listings.description: Picture yourself in a hidden garden in the heart of Paris, and you have the inspiration for the Hermès Un Jardin Sur Le Toit Eau de Toilette (50ml). Created by Hermès perfumer Jean-Claude Ellena in 2011, this special scent pays homage to the secret garden on the Hermès' rooftop at 24 Rue du Faubourg-Saint-Honore (the address of the fashion house's flagship boutique in Paris). This picturesque garden scents the Parisian air with crisp apple tree, blended effortlessly with notes of juicy pear tree. Crafted by Hermès scarf designer Fred Rawyler, the bottle is inspired by the lines of horse-drawn carriage lanterns, with luminous green glass to symbolise the vibrancy of this enchanting garden.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Amber Labdanum Cologne Intense 100ml
listings.description: The Jo Malone London Amber Labdanum Cologne Intense (100ml) transports you to the sun-drenched hills of Andalusia, where wild cistus and warm amber notes fill the air. The scent is enriched with bitter orange, labdanum, vanilla and roasted oak, creating a rich, sensual aroma that’s both powerful and evocative. The woody core is lifted by the sweetness of vanilla and the depth of roasted oak, leaving a luxurious trail with every wear. This intense fragrance beautifully captures the warmth and vitality of sunlit fields, offering a bold yet sophisticated sensory experience. Crafted with signature expertise and high-quality ingredients, this is a modern, versatile scent that’s easy to love and perfect for making a lasting impression.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Mon GUERLAIN Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Bottling the brand's passion for its craft (which spans almost two centuries!), the Mon Guerlain Eau de Parfum (100ml) is an oriental fragrance infused with just four raw ingredients; French lavender, sambac jasmine, sandalwood and vanilla Tahitensis. How to describe this addictive scent? Oriental. Audacious. Radiant. Sensual. Expect notes of French lavender (grown in Provence), enveloped in vanilla Tahitensis before revealing a flourish of sambac jasmine that's been gathered at sunrise (so dreamy). It's rounded off with sandalwood to express feelings of strength and preserve the mystery of eternal femininity. We'll be keeping ours pride of place on our vanity.

listings.rawTitle: Creed Black 5ml Refillable Atomiser
listings.description: Perfect for busy days, the Creed Black Refillable Atomiser (5ml) keeps your go-to scents safe and secure in a luxurious leather casing. Crafted by hand with a detailed design to echo the brand's heritage, this elevated accessory helps you top up your fragrance through the day. In a classic black housing, this versatile travel essential slots itself in your carry-on seamlessly.

listings.rawTitle: Molton Brown Mesmerising Oudh Accord & Gold Aroma Reeds Refill
listings.description: The Molton Brown Mesmerising Oudh Accord & Gold Aroma Reed Diffuser Refill (150ml) transforms your space into a luxurious, aromatic retreat. Infused with an opulent blend of warm cinnamon, smoky black tea and rich oudh, it creates an inviting atmosphere filled with depth and sophistication. The scent opens with shimmering bergamot, gradually revealing a deep, resinous heart of heady oudh and honeyed resins, reminiscent of a steamy, spiced forest. Encased in a timeless, elegant design, the refill complements any interior style while enveloping your sanctuary in a heady, mesmerising aroma. Perfect for adding a touch of decadent luxury, it invites you to indulge in a refined, sensory escape.

listings.rawTitle: Commodity Exploration Kit
listings.description: Find your new signature scent with Commodity's Exploration Kit. This bestselling kit includes samples of all three scent space collections, so you can choose your ideal projection for each scent. Whether that's a close Personal one, uniquely Expressive or room-filling Bold version. Enjoy fruity renditions in Juice, musky accords in Milk, woody trances in Gold and so much more. Which will be your next favourite? Contents: Book- Personal (2ml) Book Expressive (2ml) Book+ Bold (2ml) Gold- Personal (2ml) Gold Expressive (2ml) Gold+ Bold (2ml) Moss- Personal (2ml) Moss Expressive (2ml) Moss+ Bold (2ml) Paper- Personal (2ml) Paper Expressive (2ml) Paper+ Bold (2ml) Milk- Personal (2ml) Milk Expressive (2ml) Milk+ Bold (2ml) Juice- Personal (2ml) Juice Expressive (2ml) Juice+ Bold (2ml)

listings.rawTitle: Maison Francis Kurkdjian GRAND SOIR Eau De Parfum 35ml
listings.description: Paint the town amber with Maison Francis Kurkdijan's Grand Soir Eau de Parfum (35ml), a refined fragrance that invites you to embrace your glamorous side. Inspired by dark nights enlivened by city life, this fragrance imitates the vibrant hues of streetlights against honeyed skies. From its very first impression, dazzling amber paints the skyline with vivacity and liveliness. A cocktail of lavandin and cinnamon leaf adds to its head-turning trail, while bezoin and vanilla facets sweeten its warmth in a scent-sational finish.

listings.rawTitle: KAYALI Freedom EDP Sampler Set 4x1.5ml
listings.description: Explore a wardrobe of scents with KAYALI's Freedom EDP Miniature Set (4x1.5ml). Each fragrance invites a different mood, from the floral nuances of Musk Bouquet to the creamy notes of Musk Latte. Musk Santal pairs soft florals with a hint of spice, while Musk Matcha blends green tea freshness with milky sweetness. Compact and collectible, these miniatures are perfect for layering or switching aromas to suit your day. Contents: Freedom Musk Bouquet | 27 (1.5ml) Freedom Musk Santal | 34 (1.5ml) Freedom Musk Matcha | 45 (1.5ml) Freedom Musk Latte | 41 (1.5ml)

listings.rawTitle: Juliette Has a Gun Not a Perfume Superdose Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Elevate your scent game with Juliette Has a Gun Not A Superdose (100ml) a more intense, powerful take on the iconic minimalist fragrance. This ultra-concentrated version (20%) amplifies the signature of the brands Not a Perfume, delivering an even more potent, long-lasting trail. Centred entirely around cetalox, a molecule that seamlessly adapts to your skin’s chemistry, it creates a clean, musky and woody aura that feels both modern and timeless. Perfect for those who love the original but crave an added dose of intensity, this exudes purity and sophistication on steroids. Its minimalist design conceals an explosive, unique scent that leaves a captivating, personalized impression with every wear.

listings.rawTitle: Liis Choux Choux 50ml
listings.description: Inspired by the creamy aromas of freshly baked choux à la crème pastry, the Choux Choux Eau de Parfum (50ml) by Liis delights the senses with each spritz. Wrapped in gourmand warmth, this enticing fragrance opens with citrus peel and vibrant vanilla, folded into fluffy fresh cream. Fleur de Sel Caramel, cocoa and mocha deliver rich, tantalising flavours, encased in sensual sandalwood for depth and dimension. Indulge in the moment and mist across the pulse points for a lingering, signature Liis trail.

listings.rawTitle: Laboratory Perfumes Amber Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: This warm, earthy fragrance combines layers of wood and ambergris with grassy, spicy top notes, to surround the wearer in a balmy haze. Incredibly long lasting, Laboratory Perfumes' Amber lingers on the skin for hours after first spritz, mellowing to a subtle, sexy base that positively smoulders. Like a YSL smoking jacket, Amber's velvety warmth has masculine origins, but works wonderfully on a woman of substance, bringing a smooth, sophisticated air that's impossible to resist.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Margiela Replica Afternoon Delight Eau de Toilette 30ml
listings.description: Fall for a fleeting moment of joyful escapism with Maison Margiela's Afternoon Delight Eau de Toilette (30ml). One of French literature's most ubiquitous metaphors, the madeleine cake was first immortalised by seminal writer Marcel Proust as a spark for feelings of wistful nostalgia and half-forgotten memories. Inspired by this poetic passage, this indulgent, gourmand fragrance is crafted around a heart of madeleine accord, entwined with creamy notes of sandalwood and velvety Madagascan Vanilla. Spritz and escape to the romanticism of Paris, hot chocolate and misty drizzle included.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Margiela Replica Jamming in Saint Germain:  Afternoon Delight 30ml + Jazz Club 7ml (Worth £76.00)
listings.description: Two scents, two moods – move between fragrance worlds with Maison Margiela Perfume’s most evocative and artistic scents. Paris on an Autumn’s afternoon – pearly mist, flurry of golden leaves and the scent of freshly baked madeleine cakes trailing the Seine, that’s Afternoon Delight Eau de Toilette. Crafted around a heart of madeleine accord, this indulgent, gourmand fragrance features notes of sandalwood and velvety Madagascan vanilla. A rich, sophisticated contrast – Jazz Club Eau de Toilette is a sultry composition of spicy pink pepper, warming rum and lingering wisps of tobacco leaf. Contents: Afternoon Delight Eau de Toilette (30ml) Jazz Club Eau de Toilette (7ml)

listings.rawTitle: Tom Ford Eau D'Ombre Leather Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Rich, resinous and strikingly radiant, the TOM FORD Eau D'Ombre Leather Eau de Toilette (100ml) marries a medley of mesmeric earthy notes. Inspired by the American West at dawn, this evocative fragrance begins with fresh ginger, coriander and cardamom. Warming notes of honeyed woods, amber and vanilla bring balance to black leather. Reflecting the layered scent, this luxury fragrance is housed in a textured lacquer and leather bottle.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Eau de Soleil Blanc Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Begin your day bathed in sunlight with the TOM FORD Eau D'Soleil Blanc Eau De Toilette (100ml), a citrusy scent that makes way to a smooth heart of pistachio and cardamom. The scent lingers like a evening breeze, uniting notes of tuberose, ylang ylang and orange blossom, gently softened by amber and a subtle hint of coco de mer. Balancing freshness and warmth, this sun-drenched fragrance is housed in a sleek, ribbed glass vessel with gold accents, radiating a luminous aura wherever you go.

listings.rawTitle: Escentric Molecules M+ Molecule 01 + Patchouli
listings.description: Arriving in time for the ‘Summer of Love ‘21’, Escentric Molecules M+ Molecule 01 + Patchouli harks back to the halcyon, polaroid days of the ‘60s and ‘70s – evoking the sexy, bohemian spirit of Woodstock and Bob Dylan, fringes and flares but without feeling overly retro. Romantic, nostalgic and perfect for those who still yearn for the days before wi-fi and mobiles, this scent shows the best of patchouli – blending two qualities of patchouli with the mystical, musky insouciance of Iso E Super to wrap you in warmth and enhance your allure. With a distinctive moody beauty, Schoen has successfully married Patchouli Coeur – a clean, soft patchouli oil fraction that’s had the top, camphor-like notes stripped away – with Indonesian patchouli oil to add a voluptuous edge that results in a smooth, languid character, perfect for those with a penchant for ponchos as well as those very much here in the ‘now’ who want something that’s comforting, mellow and ever-so sensuous. Choose from a full size 100ml, or more travel-friendly 30ml.

listings.rawTitle: Escentric Molecules M+ Champaca 100ml
listings.description: Discover the subtle magic of Escentric Molecules Molecule 01 + Champaca (100ml), a fragrance that’s as intriguing as it is effortless. This minimalist scent combines the velvety warmth of iso e super, a cedarwood-like, cocooning molecule with the rich complexity of Indian champaca absolute. The floral explosion of orange blossom, jasmine and a hint of tea unfolds into a lush, woody embrace. Perfect for those who love a scent that’s subtle yet endlessly fascinating, leaving a luminous trail that’s as elegant as it is understated.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Loves A Luxury Travel Collection - Amber, Lime & Bergamot
listings.description: Celebrating one of Jo Loves' most iconic and best-selling scents is the Amber, Lime & Bergamot Luxury Travel Collection. The trio includes A Fragrance Paintbrush™ (a unique scented gel that dries in seconds), a shower gel and a body lotion, each scented with bright citrus and warm amber notes. Perfectly sized for on the go, the trio arrives with a tortoise shell-printed cosmetics bag to store your essentials. Contents: Amber, Lime & Bergamot A Fragrance Paintbrush™ Gel (7ml) Amber, Lime & Bergamot A Bath & Shower Gel (75ml) Amber, Lime & Bergamot A Body Lotion (75ml)

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Rosa Verde Eau de Toilette 125ml
listings.description: The Guerlain Aqua Allegoria Rosa Verde Eau de Toilette (125ml) is a tribute to the verdant rose: brought to life with green vibrance and aquatic freshness. Discover the dewy, fresh rose: take a dive into this fine fragrance experience. Aldehyde-soaked petals, crisp with the sun's greeting, are plunged into gleaming waters with succulent cucumber. Mellow, juicy pear flesh caresses the rose, leading it to unfurl into the arms of balsamic wood. Alive just beneath the water's surface, the petals sip effervescent musk. Revel in this marine rose fragrance that features top notes of bergamot, mint and cucumber, heart notes of rose, pear and violet leaf, and base notes of iris, white musk and cyprus. Guerlain now explores the relationship between scent and emotion through the Science of the Emotions. At the heart of this approach, Rosa Verde offers a feeling of pleasure and relaxation.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Un Jardin Sur La Lagune Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Whisk your senses away to a secret garden on the water of Venice with Hermès' Un Jardin Sur La Lagune Eau de Toilette Natural Spray (50ml). Upon first spritz you'll be met with a salty opening of sea breeze accords, before blooming into a white-floral heart of sweet Madonna lily, citrusy magnolia and pittosporum. As for the base? It finishes with a soft, delicate and creamy woody cascade. Plus, the bottle showcases a Venetian ochre gradient of burnt orange to sheer yellow, like the walls that would surround this hidden garden.

listings.rawTitle: Escentric Molecules Molecule 03 Travel Size Refill
listings.description: As with its bestselling predecessors, Escentric Molecules’ Molecule 03 is an homage to the single scent ingredient, or aroma-chemical. Celebrated perfumer Geza Schoen has taken the niche fragrance line back to its roots – literally – with this understatedly sexy, woody scent that works for both men and women. As with all the Molecules fragrances, this subverts the traditional perfumery doctrine - it’s innovative, distinctive and contemporary, and adapts to the wearer, rather than surrounding them in a generic, one-scent-suits-all haze. A bespoke fragrance without the bespoke price-tag.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Les Légendaires Jardin De Bagatelle Eau de Toilette 75ml
listings.description: Be emboldened by this seductive scent that tells the tale of an independent and self-indulgent character. The Les Légendaires Jardin de Bagatelle Eau de Toilette exudes a sparkling neroli palette with accents of bewitching tuberose contrasted by the sweet nature of a floral bouquet. Housed in an iconic bottle designed by Raymond Guerlain in 1912, this evocative fragrance is bright and free yet dark and flirtatious. The scent bursts with the joyful multitude of white flowers (neroli, jasmine and gardenia) grounded by notes centred around the sweet, spicey and floral facets of poisonous tuberose flower (emphasis on 'centred around' ) and woody notes. Telling the tale of a pleasure-seeking love story, Jardin de Bagatelle strikes the right balance between joy, spontaneity and seduction in the pursuit of pleasure and joie de vivre .

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Les Légendaires Champs-Elysées Eau de Toilette 75ml
listings.description: Inspired by a chance encounter on the Champs Élysées, the Les Légendaires Champs-Elysées Eau de Toilette celebrates the scent of spirited mimosa infused with rose notes and woody accents. Housed in an iconic bottle designed by Raymond Guerlain in 1912, this evocative fragrance is intense yet delicately balanced. The scent opens with blackcurrent berries and almond wood to capture the senses before blossoming into notes of hibiscus and mimosa flowers. Just a spritz of this scent will transport you to the French location and dare you to live life with buoyancy and spontaneity.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Eau des Merveilles Bleue Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Hermès' Eau des Merveilles Bleue Eau de Toilette (100ml) is inspired by the Merveilles constellation, taking you on an olfactory adventure into space with its woody, warm accords. As the fourth instalment of the house's Merveilles collection, this mineral, woody eau de toilette blends bright juniper berry, warm patchouli and the salt-kissed earthiness of seashore pebbles to leave a fresh, but delicate, lasting fragrance. As for the bottle? Well, as we've come to expect from the brand, its star-spangled, magnifying-glass shape is designed with as much TLC as the scent inside it. It twinkles with a blue hue and boasts an engraved top for an extra touch of luxury.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Grapefruit Cologne 9ml
listings.description: Live out your Euro summer dreams with the Jo Malone London Grapefruit Cologne (9ml) by your side. Opening with notes of sun-drenched grapefruit, which intertwine with a herbal heart of rosemary, this sense-awakening fragrance teleports you to warmer landscapes. Anchored by a base of moss cushions and mint accents, this citrus-meets-earthy perfume develops through the day, becoming brighter and more inviting with time.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN La Petite Robe Noire Eau de Toilette 30ml
GUERLAIN Habit Rouge Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Guerlain's Habit Rouge Eau de Toilette (50ml) was originally created in 1965. The rest as they say is history... A tribute to Guerlain's passion for the dressage of horses, this dynamic eau de parfum creates an element of surprise by contrasting sweet and bold vanilla with woody and leather notes. It's a dynamic and audacious fragrance that blossoms with a spicy heart, nuanced with neroli and jasmine. An elegant and classic choice for any scent wardrobe.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Loves A Fragrance - Mango Thai Lime 50ml
listings.description: A celebration of Thailand’s mouth-watering flavours, Jo Loves A Fragrance – Mango Thai Lime is a zesty explosion of ripe, juicy mango with fresh makrut lime and the kick of black pepper to wrap you with sweet, sharp and zesty aromas. A genderless scent with a lingering base of fresh thyme and crisp vetiver, this vibrant aroma is bursting with fruity and tropical top notes that conjure the essence of Thailand’s bright, colourful scent-scape. A heart of smooth freesia and fresh mint are layered to balance the opening sweetness, creating a blend that is wonderfully wearable, chic and unique.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Habit Rouge Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Guerlain's Habit Rouge Eau de Toilette (100ml) was originally created in 1965. The rest as they say is history... A tribute to Guerlain's passion for the dressage of horses, this dynamic eau de parfum creates an element of surprise by contrasting sweet and bold vanilla with woody and leather notes. It's a dynamic and audacious fragrance that blossoms with a spicy heart, nuanced with neroli and jasmine. An elegant and classic choice for any scent wardrobe.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Habit Rouge Eau de Toilette 150ml
listings.description: Guerlain's Habit Rouge Eau de Toilette (150ml) was originally created in 1965. The rest as they say is history... A tribute to Guerlain's passion for the dressage of horses, this dynamic eau de parfum creates an element of surprise by contrasting sweet and bold vanilla with woody and leather notes. It's a dynamic and audacious fragrance that blossoms with a spicy heart, nuanced with neroli and jasmine. An elegant and classic choice for any scent wardrobe.

listings.rawTitle: KAYALI Vanilla Royale Sugared Patchouli 64 Eau de Parfum Intense 100ml
listings.description: If you love the Vanilla 28 fragrance (sold separately), you'll fall head over heels for the Vanilla Royale Sugared Patchouli 64 Eau de Parfum Intense (100ml), which graces its wearer with intensely rich and sultry notes. Opening with warm vanilla orchid, jasmine and golden rum, this captivating blend settles down into heart notes of vanilla infusion, vanilla surabsolute and gourmand crème brulée. With nuances of almond, musky leather and smoky tobacco balancing out its sweetness, this special scent is not one you'll forget in a hurry, with an overall warm and woody aroma. Base notes of brown sugar, sugared patchouli and musk complete this soft, sensual and rich fragrance, which will have friends and family desperate to know what you're wearing...

listings.rawTitle: Jo Loves Advent Calendar 2026 (Worth £865.00)
listings.description: Unwrap the magic of the holiday season with the Jo Loves Advent Calendar 2026, a luxurious countdown filled with surprise scents, skincare treats and a special £50 Jo Loves voucher. Behind each door, discover a selection of the brand’s iconic scents and skincare treasures (ranging from mini candles and body products to travel-sized fragrances) designed to indulge your senses. The highlight? A £50 voucher for you to spend with Jo Loves. Whether treating yourself or gifting a loved one, this limited-edition set offers a daily moment of joy and discovery, making every day leading up to Christmas a sensory celebration of luxury and elegance. Contents: Christmas Trees Votive Candle 70g Mango Thai Lime Votive Candle (70g) Nutmeg & Incense Votive Candle (70g) Amber, Lime & Bergamot Votive Candle (70g) With Love From London Body Lotion (70ml) With Love from London Shower Gel (75ml) Golden Gardenia Eau de Toilette (15ml) Cobalt Patchouli & Cedar Eau de Toilette (15ml) With Love from Capri Body Lotion (75ml) With Love from Capri Shower Gel (75ml) Mango Thai Lime Eau de Toilette (10ml) With Love from London Eau de Toilette (10ml) Nutmeg & Incense Eau de Toilette (10ml) Jo by Jo Loves Eau de Toilette (10ml) Pink Vetiver Eau de Toilette (10ml) Rose & Dates Paintbrush (7ml) Amber, Lime & Bergamot Paintbrush (7ml) No. 42 The Flowershop Paintbrush (7ml) Pomelo Paintbrush (7ml) Mango Thai Lime Hand Cream (30ml) Pomelo Soap (50g) Rose & Dates Body Lotion (75ml) Amber, Lime & Bergamot Shampoo (75ml) Amber, Lime & Bergamot Conditioner (75ml) £50 Jo Loves Voucher

listings.rawTitle: KAYALI Discovery Layering Set
listings.description: Unleash your creativity with the KAYALI Discovery Layering Set, a beautifully curated collection of ten versatile fragrances designed to inspire your signature scent. Perfect for layering or wearing solo, this limited-edition set features Mona's top picks, from decadent gourmands and lush florals to sensual musks and fresh fruits. Discover endless scent combinations with favourites like Vanilla |28, Yum Pistachio Gelato, Eden Juicy Apple and Fleur Majesty Rose Royale. Whether you want to craft a soft, romantic vibe or make a bold statement, this travel-friendly set makes experimenting effortless and fun. With ten luxe miniatures, it's the ultimate way to explore, customise and elevate your fragrance wardrobe; anytime, anywhere. Contents: Vanilla |28 Eau de Parfum (1.5ml) Yum Pistachio Gelato | 33 Eau de Parfum (1.5ml) Yum Boujee Marshmallow | 81 (1.5ml) Freedom Musk Santal | 34 Eau de Parfum (1.5ml) Eden Sparkling Lychee | 39 Eau de Parfum (1.5ml) Eden Juicy Apple | 01 Eau de Parfum (1.5ml) Eden Sweet Peach |35 Eau de Parfum (1.5ml) Eden Plush Pear | 23 Eau de Parfum (1.5ml) Fleur Majesty Rose Royale | 31 Eau de Parfum (1.5ml) Vanilla Candy Rock Sugar | 42 Eau de Parfum (1.5ml)

listings.rawTitle: Fascent Sel À Vie
listings.description: Bathe in the warmth of golden sunshine with Fascent SEL À VIE Eau de Parfum (30ml). Capturing the essence of an endless summer, this radiant fragrance opens with a zesty burst of sweet orange and mandarin, evoking the bliss of a refreshing dip in the Mediterranean Sea. As the scent settles, you are wrapped up in a heart of fresh sea salt and Ylang Ylang, echoing the rhythmic crash of waves against the shore. Then, with a base of comforting gourmand vanilla and driftwood, it leaves a romantic trail that lingers long after the sun has set.

listings.rawTitle: Juliette Has a Gun Not a Perfume Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Discover the art of minimalism with Juliette Has a Gun’s Not a Perfume (100ml), a uniquely pure and subtle scent crafted from a single molecule, Cetalox. Designed for those who appreciate understated luxury, it blends seamlessly with your skin, creating a personalized, fleeting aura that evolves uniquely on each wearer. Ideal for layering or wearing solo, it’s perfect for fragrance-sensitive souls seeking a hypoallergenic yet captivating scent. The minimalist white bottle embodies purity, making it a chic addition to your collection. Embrace the beauty of simplicity and let this iconic fragrance subtly enhance your natural allure.

listings.rawTitle: Summer Fridays Body Fragrance Mist 90ml - Vanilla
listings.description: Elevate your everyday with the Summer Fridays Vanilla Body Fragrance Mist (90ml) a delicately scented mist that effortlessly wraps your skin in warmth and gourmand comfort. Inspired by the brand’s bestselling Lip Butter Balm, this lightweight mist offers an irresistible, cozy aroma that’s like a delicious dessert in a bottle. Opening with hints of pink peppercorn, it blooms into luscious, sugared orchid and almond flower, before settling into a rich vanilla cake accord, tonka bean and Madagascar vanilla. The fine, airy spray diffuses evenly, leaving a soft, long-lasting scent without any sticky residue. Perfect to spritz after your shower, before heading out or layered with other scents to create your signature aroma, this mist transforms everyday moments into a sensuous experience.

listings.rawTitle: Escentric Molecules Molecule 02 (100ml)
listings.description: This beguiling concoction is based around the single synthetic note of Ambroxan, an aroma-molecule that harnesses all the sweet, earthy, musky characteristics of natural ambergris, a commonly-used ingredient in perfumery. Like its cousin Molecule 01, 02 waxes and wanes throughout the day, fading, only to resurface just when you've almost forgotten you're wearing it. As with everything else Geza Schoen does, no part of this is overdone or “gimmicky”. If you’re after a signature scent, this unisex mystifying and electrifying number ticks every box, melding with your natural pheromones for a truly unique olfactory outing.

listings.rawTitle: Escentric Molecules Escentric 02 (100ml)
listings.description: Like its sister scent Molecule 02, Escentric 02 is built around the synthetic note of ambroxan – a variation of the natural ingredient ambergris. It has a fresh, ‘mineral’ quality to it, perfect for anyone of any gender to wear throughout the day. Stripping back the bells and whistles of traditional perfumery, Escentric Molecules scents are unusual without being gimmicky, minimalist without being boring. In fact, it’s the subtle power of these concoctions that make them so alluring and surprisingly sexy. These aren’t “pretty perfumes” but far more intriguing – showcasing the dizzyingly wonderful things synthetic notes can do.

listings.rawTitle: Escentric Molecules Molecule 01 (100ml)
listings.description: If you’re after a unique signature scent, Molecule 01 from Escentric Molecules is just the beguiling concoction you’re looking for. This modern classic shook the industry when it launched – and it still has many fragrance fans (and a fair few celebrities) loyally spritzing it on. Maverick perfumer Geza Schoen created Molecule 01 to blend with the wearer’s natural pheromones and create a spellbinding effect that's unique to each person that applies it. There’s a chance you may not be able to smell this on yourself (we know that sounds curious) but, trust us, anybody that crosses your path will be enchanted – in fact, we’ve had more than a few reports of wearers being chased down the street by people wanting to know what perfume they’ve got on. listings.rawTitle: ESCENTRIC MOLECULES - ESCENTRIC 01 IN PRESENTATION CASE (30ML)
listings.description: If you’re a fan of unisex, unusual scents – as opposed to rich, heady floral numbers – we suggest making Escentric 01 your olfactory signature. Customers often comment that strangers always ask what they’re wearing when they’ve got it on - proof that when it comes to alluring scent, this hits it out of the ballpark. This travel size refill is perfect for topping up when you’re out and about, or have limited space in your carry-on.

listings.rawTitle: ESCENTRIC MOLECULES - Molecule 01 - Portable (30ml)
listings.description: Created from the unadulterated aroma-chemical Iso E Super – Escentric Molecules’ Molecule 01 is more an effect than a fragrance. This waxes and wanes throughout the day and can prove difficult to detect on yourself (hence none of that cloying, headache-inducing effect you can get with many, more ‘traditional’ fragrances) however, the effect it has on others is mesmerising… think Mowgli in his Kaa-induced hypnotic trance, and you’re close to the phenomenal scent-sation this fragrance provokes. listings.rawTitle: ESCENTRIC MOLECULES - ESCENTRIC 01 REFILL (30ML)
listings.description: Although EM’s nose Geza Schoen has used ‘traditional’ perfumery ingredients to create Escentric 01, the way he formulates his fragrances makes the entirety of the Escentric Molecules range (01, 02 and 03) so contemporary, distinctive and alluring. For the 01s (both Molecule and Escentric), it’s all in the Iso E Super, which is a molecule traditionally added to fragrances to make them more seductive… like a flash of seamed stocking or provocative bat of an eyelash. This is subtle but all the more attractive because it whispers rather than screams your arrival. A wonderfully fresh, more complex version for those who want their Molecule 01 with a little bit more complexity.

Like a tropical paradise, this is elevated with smooth middle notes of coconut milk and ylang ylang – balanced with fresh, earthy base notes of cedar and musk, with benzoin adding a cinnamon and vanilla-like hint. Coming in two different sizes – 100ml and an exclusive 30ml – you never have to be without your favourite fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Margiela Replica Sailing Day Eau de Toilette - 100ml
listings.description: It’s 2001 in Paros, Greece. Clad in swimming gear and accessorised with excited smiles, you and your friends hurtle towards the beach – kicking up sand and startling birds as you carelessly run. The sea reflects the bright blue of the sky, and fresh, salty spray gently kisses your skin. Armed with feelings of adventure, anticipation and youthful joy, you climb aboard your boat as a sharp breeze catches its sails – guiding you through the ocean’s vast expanse… The Replica Sailing Day Eau De Toilette is a snapshot in time – a bottled memory of the ‘aquatic deep sea’, made with unique top notes of aquatic accord and juniper pure jungle essence. Middle notes of coriander, iris absolute and rose superessence lend a sharp, green shift, while red seaweed pure jungle essence, ambergris accord and orcanox offer a sweet but earthy twist. Coming in two different sizes – 100ml and an exclusive 30ml – never be without your favourite fragrance and treasured memory.

Fresh middle notes of coriander essence and green tea extract delicately dance with fresh, woody, smooth base notes of cedarwood essence, citrus absolute and musks. listings.rawTitle: Maison Margiela Replica Bubble Bath Eau de Toilette - 100ml
listings.description: It’s 2005 in Beverly Hills. You light some candles and run the warm water before adding a decadent bath soak to the stream. Under the soft flicker of scented flames, a steaming mug is sat by the side of the bathtub, atop a book and next to a waiting glass of wine. This is your most intimate self-care ritual, a moment of ‘you’ time – of wellness and relaxation in a world of chaos. A soothing respite for limbs as you feel all tensions gently melt away… The Replica Bubble Bath Eau De Toilette is a snapshot in time – a bottled memory of ‘comforting, clean accords’ made with delicate, fresh top notes of crushed leaves and freesia. Smooth middle notes of Indian sambac jasmine and Egyptian jasmine delicately dance with tuberose and rose from Grasse – perfectly balanced by sharp, intense base notes of peach, cedar wood and oak moss. Beautifully androgynous and available in two different sizes – 100ml and an exclusive 30ml – you never have to be without your favourite fragrance or treasured memory.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Margiela Replica Coffee Break Eau de Toilette - 100ml
listings.description: Indulge in the cosy aromas of the Maison Margiela Coffee Break Eau de Toilette (100ml), a warm, spicy fragrance that conjures memories of stepping into a coffee shop in winter. A shot of pleasure, coffee and milk mousse accords invite you to relive the sensation of that first frothy sip. Top notes of red apple and lemon essence pour into a heart of lavender, spearmint and orange flower to add floral freshness. Complete with sandalwood and cedarwood essence for a creamy intensity, the fragrance captures the essence of a relaxing escape with each spritz.

listings.rawTitle: Oribe Côte d'Azur Eau de Parfum 75ml
listings.description: The next best thing to being in Cote D’Azur? Smelling like we’ve just been to the glorious location! The Cote D’Azur Eau de Parfum is holiday-ready with fruity notes of freshly-squeezed lemon, blackcurrant, bergamot and sicilian orange that gently soften into middle notes of tuberose and white butterfly jasmie, while staying grounded in sandalwood and crisp amber. The Oribe fragrance trio, much like their hair care range, is impactful without being overwhelming. The kind of head-turning scent that makes strangers stop and ask you what you’re wearing! Looking just as beautiful as they smell, give these minimal but intricate glass bottles pride of place in your must-have fragrance collection. Plus, you know those moments when your hair smells so good you wish you could bottle it up? Well, that’s the Cote D’Azur Eau de Parfum for you. Available in the original 75ml and a handy travel size (10ml), expect to impress with your new signature scent all day long, whether home or away.

listings.rawTitle: BYREDO Bal d'Afrique Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: A celebration of African culture, art, music and dance, BYREDO’s iconic Bal d'Afrique Eau de Parfum drenches you in rich history, euphoria, nostalgic longing and a touch of mystical allure. One of the brand's earliest fragrances, it perfectly bottles the founder's memories and translates them into scent, transporting you on a whimsical journey to Africa... With unique top notes of earthy bucchu, spicy-musky African marigold and zesty bergamot, lemon and neroli, the fragrance’s sweet heart of cyclamen, jasmine petals and violet is perfectly counterbalanced – dancing atop a heady base of black amber, Moroccan cedarwood, musk and vetiver. Decadent and romantic, intense but fresh, the Bal d'Afrique Eau de Parfum is a love letter to Africa.

listings.rawTitle: BYREDO Oud Immortel Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Inspired by the most traditional use of incense and perfume which is recorded in one of the world's olest written texts – the Sanskrit Vedas from India, the scent of BYREDO's Oud Immortel Eau de Parfum holds a complex yet humbling fragrance like no other. Housed in the brand's instantly recognisable (and incredibly lust-have) chic and simple – yet quintessentially luxe – monochrome bottles, BYREDO's Oud Immortel Eau de Parfum has quickly become a firm favourite in any respectable fragrance-ophile's collection and regular guest on their Instagram grid too. Created as a tribute to oud, which was used in the traditional incense and perfume from millennia ago, this perfume blends top notes of rich and warming cardamom and incense that settles down into a heart of Brazilian rosewood, papyrus and patchouli followed by a delicious medley of moss and tobacco leaves. Trust us, you're going to adore this.

Infused with notes of sandalwood, blooms of musk, peach, ambrette and coco accents, this transitional scent moves from gourmand to deep and mysterious. Blending sweetness with spice, this icon provides an inspiring twist on traditional note.

listings.rawTitle: D.S. & Durga Rose Atlantic Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Transport the senses to days spent by the sea with D.S & Durga's Rose Atlantic Eau de Parfum (50ml). This evocative scent will take you back to summer, where salt spray combines with a heady floral aroma to create the perfect bouquet. Top notes of bergamot, lemon oil, and petals make a vivid first impression. At its heart, rose accord, linden and dune grass evoke memories of perfect summer days. Finally, base notes of muscone, salt water and white moss afford a lasting aroma.

listings.rawTitle: Kilian Angels' Share Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Paying tribute to Kilian's heritage and upbringing, Angels Share is his most personal fragrance yet. In a first-time collaboration with French perfumer Benoit Lapouza, the delicious notes of Angels Share mimic the heady fragrance that comes as a by-product to the evaporation process within cognac cellars. This cocktail stars liquor-derived essence of cognac, cognac oil and oak absolute - all wrapped around sweeter notes of cinnamon essence and tonka bean absolute - finished with a delicate trio of sandalwood, praline and vanilla. A nod to the syrupy sweetness of alcohol and the heady wood of cognac barrels, this multifaceted and androgynous fragrance will enhance and intoxicate come day or night.

With notes of bergamot, plum, anise, leather, rum, vanilla, amber, patchouli and milk, this signature cocktail scent is a summer and winter must-try that will have everyone asking "what perfume are you wearing"? listings.description: Spritz Hermès' Eau de Citron Noir Eau de Cologne Natural Spray (50ml) to your heart's content and get ready to be transported far, far away. Inspired by a very flavourful ingredient often used in Middle Eastern cuisine, this fragrance's hero note is black lime (AKA dried lime), which adds a sour and even smoky tinge to the scent. This citrusy accord is then complemented by black tea and guaiac wood for a woody yet fresh perfume. The cherry on top? It's housed in an iconic lantern bottle, adorned with a radical deep blue hue.

listings.rawTitle: Byredo Blanche Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: Discover Byredo Blanche Eau de Parfum (100ml), a floral skin-scent that embodies the intimacy of human touch. Blanche explores the dynamic nature of the senses with an edge of floral freshness. Inspired by the delicacy of bodies slipping between fresh sheets, the crisp comfort of clean laundry, and the romantic whisper of heady florals. The scent opens with top notes of aldehydes and intoxicating rose centifolia. It then softens into vibrant peony and violet before settling into a base of soft musk accented with earthy sandalwood. A veil of scintillating scent awaits.

listings.rawTitle: Molton Brown Wild Mint & Lavandin Perfume 100ml
listings.description: Molton Brown's Wild Mint & Lavandin Perfume (100ml) captures the essence of a peaceful forest walk with its invigorating blend of fresh mint, herbal lavandin and warm, woody notes. Opening with a sharp, revitalising burst of wild mint, it's complemented by lush lavandin sourced sustainably from Provence, creating a sophisticated floral-herbal aroma. Subtle hints of orris root and creamy nutmeg add a modern elegance, while tonka bean provides a gentle warmth that lingers beautifully. This fresh, exhilarating fragrance evokes the serenity of nature's untouched beauty, making it perfect for uplifting your spirits and adding a touch of wild sophistication to your day.

listings.rawTitle: Tom Ford Café Rose Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Indulge in the seductive allure of TOM FORD Café Rose Eau de Parfum (100ml) , a luxurious fragrance that blends rich, velvety rose with unexpected gourmand warmth. At its heart, Turkish and Damask roses bloom alongside hints of smoky guaiac wood and spicy saffron, creating a complex, captivating scent. Accents of coffee and dried fruits add an irresistible depth, evoking the cozy intimacy of a Parisian café. The silky, long-lasting formula wraps you in sophistication and mystery, perfect for day or night.

listings.rawTitle: WHO IS ELIJAH Wall Street Eau de parfum 10ml
listings.description: Sophisticated, yet daring, WHO IS ELIJAH's Wall Street Eau de Parfum (10ml) lingers in the air, leaving a trail of undeniable allure. The opening is an unexpected dance of rose and raspberry, sweet yet sharp, like a secret whispered in the ear. It's an invitation, a promise of something more, full of intrigue and desire. As the scent evolves, the richness of oud, saffron, and smoky wood deepen, wrapping you in a warm, sensual embrace. It's intoxicating, without being overbearing.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Forte Rosa Palissandro Eau de Parfum 125ml
listings.description: Part of the Aqua Allegoria collection, which celebrates the wonders of the world, the Aqua Allegoria Forte Rosa Palissandro Eau de Parfum strikes the ultimate balance of floral and woody notes. Think sophistication meets strength. This evocative scent blends the spicy freshness of rosewood with the delicacy of rose and intensity of patchouli to create a finish that's utterly addictive. It's formulated with more than 90% natural origin ingredients, including French beetroot alcohol, which comes from a network committed to responsible farming. The pretty pink bottle deserves pride of place on your vanity, and you'll never have to worry about running out thanks to its refillable design.

This power-packed fragrance is a "surprising illumination of sacred and mysterious oud wood, shot through with the tangy freshness of yuzu", says Guerlain's Perfumer Delphine Jelk. It's formulated with more than 90% natural origin ingredients, including French beetroot alcohol, which comes from a network committed to responsible farming. Oh and you'll never have to worry about running out thanks to its refillable design.

Like a bouquet of fresh-cut roses, this perfume takes you on an olfactive journey. Opening with notes of rose, blackcurrant and violet leaf, it has a very fresh introduction. Then, it blooms into a heart of Bulgarian rose, peach blossom and freesia which gives a fruity, powdery and somewhat spicy feel to the scent. As for the base? It's sweetened with tones of white tea, amber and musk for a comforting touch. We almost think it's better than receiving a bunch of roses...

listings.rawTitle: Kilian Princess Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: A not-so-storybook scent, the Princess Eau de Parfum empowers your senses and aura with a boost of can-do confidence you can feel. One for the damsels who save themselves from distress, this fairytale fragrance rewrites what it means to be fierce and forthcoming. Likened to sipping on a green tea mocha with a tip of ginger on the nose, this gourmand perfume awakens senses with spicy accords softened by plush marshmallow notes. A head-turning, 'who-smells-so-good?' fragrance that entrances those privileged enough to experience it. Oh, and potentially force Prince Charming to retire...

Juliette Has a Gun Juliette Eau de Parfum 7.5ml

Led by the seductive dark cherry and vibrant pink berries, this fragrance is a bold statement of confidence. Heart notes of jasmine absolute add a fruity floral nuance, while cashmere weaves a mysterious, woody undertone. Perfect for those who want to stand out and command attention, this exudes a rebellious elegance with a hint of flirtation. It’s a captivating olfactory narrative, a modern ode to strength, allure and individuality that leaves a lasting trail.

listings.rawTitle: KAYALI Vanilla Candy Rock Sugar 42 Eau de Parfum 100ml

Sugary, delightful and tempting, this fragrance is a lighter, sprightly take on the brand's cult-fave, Vanilla 28. Bursting with notes of glazed candied pear, marshmallow, bubble gum and jellybeans, this perfume is like stepping into Willy Wonka's magical factory. At the heart, this scent opens into an explosion of vanilla cream and white caramel, which playfully enhances the fruity sweetness. As for the base? It stars a balancing blend of warm and woody accords with hints of tonka bean, rock sugar and patchouli. It's a truly delicious fragrance with an unforgettably intense, gourmand scent trail that'll no doubt leave you smelling good enough to eat.
