Uplifting and energising, it stars zesty citrus top notes and salty aquatic heart notes, while drawing on a base layer of sandalwood and musk. If this doesn't make you want to book a ski trip, we don't know what will!

listings.rawTitle: Creed Silver Mountain Water Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Searching for a new scent? Good news: the Silver Mountain Water Eau de Parfum is here to instantly upgrade your fragrance collection. Reminiscent of icy alpine air, sparkling streams and the snow-capped Alps, this special scent takes its inspiration from the picturesque snowy scenes of Switzerland and its breathtaking Alpine region. Uplifting and energising, it stars zesty citrus top notes and salty aquatic heart notes, while drawing on a base layer of sandalwood and musk. If this doesn't make you want to book a ski trip, we don't know what will!

listings.rawTitle: Byredo Blanche Eau de Parfum Spray 50ml
listings.description: Discover Byredo Blanche Eau de Parfum (50ml), a floral skin-scent that embodies the intimacy of human touch. Blanche explores the dynamic nature of the senses with an edge of floral freshness. Inspired by the delicacy of bodies slipping between fresh sheets, the crisp comfort of clean laundry, and the romantic whisper of heady florals. The scent opens with top notes of aldehydes and intoxicating rose centifolia. It then softens into vibrant peony and violet before settling into a base of soft musk accented with earthy sandalwood. A veil of scintillating scent awaits.

listings.rawTitle: Vyrao Witchy Woo Eau de Parfum 10ml
Frédéric Malle Musc Ravageur Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Introducing Fracdacric Malle's Musc Ravageur Eau de Parfum, an unapologetically sexy perfume that casued scandal when it first launched in 2001 for its sensuousness. When was the last time you caught the whiff of an intoxicating scent that you just had to have? Well, the next time you'll experience that is upon smelling Introducing Fracdacric Malle's Musc Ravageur Eau de Parfum. Blending the magnetic aromas of amber, vanilla, patchouli and sandalwood, you'll hold the collar of your clothes, wrist or any other accessory that gets peppered with the beguiling scent close to your nose as you inhale it's sensuousness. Prepare to become obsessed!

listings.rawTitle: Frédéric Malle Musc Ravageur Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Introducing Fracdacric Malle's Musc Ravageur Eau de Parfum, an unapologetically sexy perfume that casued scandal when it first launched in 2001 for its sensuousness. When was the last time you caught the whiff of an intoxicating scent that you just had to have? Well, the next time you'll experience that is upon smelling Introducing Fracdacric Malle's Musc Ravageur Eau de Parfum. Blending the magnetic aromas of amber, vanilla, patchouli and sandalwood, you'll hold the collar of your clothes, wrist or any other accessory that gets peppered with the beguiling scent close to your nose as you inhale it's sensuousness. Prepare to become obsessed!

listings.rawTitle: BYREDO Animalique Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: On the prowl for intricate fragrance that pays homage to every element of the natural world beyond the concrete jungle? Prey on Animalique Eau de Parfum (50ml), a primal and potent fusion of warm, fresh florals and atmospheric greenness. Creating an air of woodland wonder thanks to awakening top notes of bergamot and lemon which deepen into the floral heart of mimosa, violet and suede, this alluring fragrance will absolutely get you noticed with no room to hide. Plunging further into accords of tobacco leaves, sandalwood and amber, this ever-evolving scent mirrors the beauty within nature to mimic both the simplicity and sensuality of a world seemingly distant but not close enough.

listings.rawTitle: KAYALI Maui In A Bottle Sweet Banana 37 Eau de Parfum 10ml
listings.description: Transport your senses to a Hawaiian island with KAYALI's Maui in a Bottle Sweet Banana 37 Eau de Parfum (10ml). When you first spritz this fragrance, you'll be met with the super-sweet aroma of banana and fresh pear. It then blooms into a heart of creamy, milky coconut twisted with the white-floral tone of jasmine. As for the base? It lies on a bed of creamy, comforting sandalwood and warming vanilla. It's a delicious, solar scent you'll no doubt want to wrap yourself in...

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Magnolia Alba Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Fusing citrus hues with floral nuances, Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Magnolia Alba Eau de Parfum (50ml) opens like a sunlit bouquet. The scent blends creamy magnolia petals with zesty bergamot, lemon and mandarin. Rose and mahonial soften the heart for a fresh, springtime trail. Housed in Chloé's iconic ribbed glass bottle with an ivory cap and gold-toned accents, it makes a sleek addition to any perfume repertoire.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Santalum Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: One of the most coveted essences in perfumery, Chloé's Atelier des Fleurs Santalum Eau de Parfum (50ml) reimagines the rare profile of sandalwood. Standing out for its silky, almond-like nuances, this fragrance note lingers on the skin with an opulent intensity. To bring out its many facets, perfumer Marypierre Julien pairs it with bright bergamot, orange oil and mandarin, showcasing its fresh, lighter side. An aromatic blend of florals lends a delicate softness, before settling into the warm embrace of akigalawood and vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: NEST New York Indigo Travel Spray 8 mL/.27 fl oz.
Tom Ford Café Rose Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Indulge in the seductive allure of TOM FORD Café Rose Eau de Parfum (50ml) , a luxurious fragrance that blends rich, velvety rose with unexpected gourmand warmth. At its heart, Turkish and Damask roses bloom alongside hints of smoky guaiac wood and spicy saffron, creating a complex, captivating scent. Accents of coffee and dried fruits add an irresistible depth, evoking the cozy intimacy of a Parisian café. The silky, long-lasting formula wraps you in sophistication and mystery, perfect for day or night.

listings.rawTitle: Molton Brown Decadent Delights: The Advent Calendar (Worth £455.00)
listings.description: Molton Brown’s chocolate box-inspired Advent Calendar treats you to 24 indulgences behind every door. Nestled inside this sleek, spherical trove are a selection of full and travel-sized formulas, with favourites from the brand’s bath and body range to its fine fragrance collection. Expect iconic scents, products you know and love, and some new discoveries along the way… Contents: Mesmerising Oudh Accord & Gold Scented Candle (65g) Red Berry Revel Fine Liquid Hand Wash (100ml) Red Berry Revel Hand Lotion (100ml) Tea Ceremony Bath & Shower Gel (100ml) Tea Ceremony Eau de Parfum (7.5ml) Fragrance Travel Case Mesmerising Oudh Accord & Gold Bath & Shower Gel (100ml) Mesmerising Oudh Accord & Gold Eau de Parfum (7.5ml) Coastal Cypress & Sea Fennel Body Cream (50ml) Coastal Cypress & Sea Fennel Eau de Parfum (7.5ml) Vitamin Lipsaver (10ml) Orange & Bergamot Fine Liquid Hand Wash (100ml) Orange & Bergamot Hand Cream (40ml) Rose Dunes Eau de Parfum (7.5ml) Coastal Cypress & Sea Fennel Shampoo (100ml) Coastal Cypress & Sea Fennel Conditioner (100ml) Sunlit Clementine & Vetiver Eau de Parfum (7.5ml) Re-charge Black Pepper Bath & Shower Gel (100ml) Re-charge Black Pepper Eau de Parfum (7.5ml) Neon Amber Bath & Shower Gel (100ml) Neon Amber Eau de Parfum (7.5ml) Orange & Bergamot Scented Candle (65g) Fiery Pink Pepper Body Cream (50g) Fiery Pink Pepper Eau de Parfum (30ml)

listings.rawTitle: BORNTOSTANDOUT® Dirty Milk Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: The BORNTOSTANDOUT Dirty Milk Eau de Parfum (50ml) is a bold and indulgent fragrance that captures the essence of creamy sweetness with a spicy twist. This fragrance opens with luscious milk, caramel and a hint of black pepper, creating an inviting, slightly provocative first impression. The heart deepens with condensed milk, soft cashmere, iris and a touch of akigalawood, adding richness and complexity. A warm, comforting base of vanilla, musk and tonka bean envelop the scent, leaving a velvety, lingering finish. Perfect for those who want to make a statement with a daring yet irresistibly smooth scent, this blends gourmand decadence with a touch of spice.

listings.rawTitle: Charlotte Tilbury Collection of Emotions Magic Energy 10ml
listings.description: Enliven the senses with Charlotte Tilbury's Collection of Emotions Magic Energy Eau de Parfum (10ml). Opening with notes of earthy myrtle and citrusy bergamot, this scent cascades into accords of woody cypress, sweet jasmine and herbaceous seaweed absolute at the heart. As for the base? It stars a balancing blend of cashmere wood, minty palo santo and sensual ambergris tones. You'll want to embrace this fragrance, while its intense scent trail will no doubt leave people wondering what you're wearing.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Scarlet Poppy Cologne Intense 30ml
listings.description: Embark on a sensory journey through southwest Asia with Jo Malone London’s Scarlet Poppy Cologne Intense (30ml). This sweet fragrance opens with a whisper of musky ambrette, harmonised perfectly with a heart of floral scarlet poppy, delivering bold blooms of rich intensity. Warmed by soft, velvety iris and the sweet, inviting spice of tonka bean, transporting you to the wild, sun-soaked plains of Asia. Melting effortlessly into your skin, it leaves a lingering, moreish trail.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Lime Basil & Mandarin Body & Hand Lotion 250ml
listings.description: Jo Malone London’s zesty Lime Basil and Mandarin Body and Hand Lotion (250ml) is the ultimate treat for anyone who loves to nourish their skin from head to toe. You could gift it, but anything this dreamy is hard to give away. Marrying peppery basil with aromatic white thyme, this delectable formula puts an unexpected twist on traditional lime fragrances. As for the nourishing skin care benefits? It’s enriched with coconut oil and hyaluronic acid to instantly hydrate and condition your limbs and beyond, while enveloping your skin in its addictive scent.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Festive Cologne Duo
listings.description: Bringing together two bright, warming fragrances in travel-friendly sizes, Jo Malone London’s Limited Edition Seasonal Scents Cologne Duo is a festive pairing of citrus-enriched scents. It makes for an elegant gift and an effortless way to switch up your fragrance for the holiday season. Set Contents: Tangerine & Honey Cologne (9ml) Juicy tangerine takes centre stage in this vibrant citrus amber fragrance, softened by the rich sweetness of honey for a warm, inviting finish. Orange Bitters Cologne (9ml) A sophisticated take on a winter cocktail, combining bright orange and bitter orange with rich prune and a warm base of sensual sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Byredo Gypsy Water Absolu de Parfum Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: A captivating ode to freedom and adventure, Byredo's Gypsy Water Absolu de Parfum Eau de Parfum (100ml) is an intensified take on the beloved classic. This warm, woody fragrance is layered with spicy black pepper and hints of citrus, evoking the wild spirit of open landscapes and endless horizons. Inspired by nature's raw beauty, it weaves a story of liberation, an aromatic journey that's both sensual and invigorating. The rich, deep scent lingers with a sophisticated warmth, perfect for those who crave an adventurous, signature aroma.

listings.rawTitle: KAYALI Fleur Majesty Rose Royale | 31 Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Roll out the red carpet, KAYALI's Fleur Majesty Rose Royale 31 Eau de Parfum (50ml) has arrived. Crowned the 'Queen of Flowers' the heady and sweet scent of the humble rose is the hero of this fragrance, intertwined with citrusy splashes of sparking mandarin and sweet, juicy peach. For a flicker of majesty, it blooms into a bouquet of earthy violet wood, champagne-like magnolia and white peony, conjuring a sensual, yet powerful fragrance all captured in a suitably romantic, diamond-shaped bottle. In the court of fragrance, KAYALI holds the throne.

listings.rawTitle: BYREDO Alto Astral 100ml
listings.description: Elevate your scent collection with the Byredo Alto Astral Eau de Parfum (100ml), a sense-awakening fragrance that captures the essence of optimism and warmth. The fragrance opens with sparkling top notes of bergamot and bitter orange, delivering a fresh and vibrant introduction. At its heart, delicate jasmine petals and soft rose bring a floral elegance, while creamy sandalwood and musk provide a smooth, woody base. Inspired by the Brazilian Portuguese expression for positive mindset, this perfume is sure to uplift anyone lucky enough to be within its aura.

listings.rawTitle: Kilian Smoking Hot Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: With a contemporary take on the smoky essence, Kilian's Smoking Hot perfume redefines the genre for modern sensibilities. One spritz of this scent and you'll instantly be able to tell this fragrance opens with forbidden fruit: a round apple hookah flavour which is blended with warm cinnamon bark essence. Then, slowly over time, notes of fire-cured Kentucky tobacco absolute emerges before leading into a bourbon vanilla (the highest quality vanilla available, especially intense and textured, no less) with balsamic tonalities. As with all of the brand's creations, this perfume is, of course, housed in a refillable bottle that's adorned with a distinctive black lacquer and meticulously engraved on each side with the representation of the Achilles shield.

listings.rawTitle: The Nue Co. Us Pheromone+ Functional Fragrance 50ml
listings.description: Create your own signature scent with The Nue Co. US Pheromone+. Employing olfactory technology, this functional fragrance adapts to your body's chemistry to accentuate your natural pheromones and create a spellbinding effect that is unique to each person that applies it. Prepare to expect subtle notes of bergamot, patchouli, moss and musk lingering on the skin too, which will then blend with your natural pheromones and creates a truly unique aroma bespoke to you. We think your fragrance shelf just got an upgrade...

listings.rawTitle: Charlotte Tilbury Collection of Emotions Calm Bliss 10ml
listings.description: Transport yourself to a tranquil oasis with Charlotte Tilbury's Law of Attraction Calm Bliss Eau de Parfum (10ml). Bursting with top notes of fresh bergamot, sweet neroli and relaxing lavandin oil, this scent is like stepping into nature. At the heart, it opens with soothing orange flower and serene watery accord while the base stars a balancing blend of warm tonka bean accord, pure white musk and peaceful orris concrete. An aquatic and floral fragrance, it'll no doubt leave people wondering what you're wearing...

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Vanilla Scotch Cologne 30ml
listings.description: Jo Malone London’s Vanilla Scotch Cologne (30ml) evokes the warmth and character of a festive escape to the Scottish Highlands, with a rich, inviting scent designed for the season. A lively Scotch whisky accord leads into creamy vanilla, while roasted tonka bean and golden amber add depth and warmth to the fragrance. Presented in a limited-edition glass design, it captures the spirit of Scotland in an elegant, indulgent scent.

listings.rawTitle: D.S. & DURGA Debaser Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Taking its name from Pixies' 1989 track, D.S. & Durga's Debaser perfume is an ode to the crackle of car radios, band frontrunner Black Francis' wild shrill and the lurching change of rhythm; done so via contradictory accords, this humid and provocative scent plays with notes of deep purple fig, soft blond woods, wet white ethereal musk and the coumarin-vanillic note of tonka bean. With simple monochrome bottles that let the scents do the talking, D.S. & Durga’s gender-neutral perfumes make a fine addition to any vanity. Carefully crafted from vegan ingredients that are cherry-picked for aromatic payoff and quality, each scent is shaped in New York City but their stories span the world over. Capturing the spirit of adolescent defiance and discovery, this intoxicating scent is akin to listening to that formative album that fundamentally shaped your taste and style.

listings.rawTitle: KAYALI Freedom Musk Latte 41 Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Whether day or night, KAYALI’s Freedom Musk Latte 41 EDP (50ml) envelops you in a comforting, empowering aura that’s both alluring and effortlessly modern. It’s an indulgent, warm floral fragrance that combines zesty bergamot and pink pepper with the romantic scent of Turkish rose and rich café latte. Deep notes of cedarwood and smooth chocolate musk create a cozy, inviting aroma that balances freshness with sensuality. Designed for those who seek a comforting yet sophisticated scent, it offers a perfect blend of floral, gourmand and woody accords. The sleek 10ml bottle makes it ideal for on-the-go wear, allowing you to indulge in its luxurious, latte-inspired aroma anytime.

listings.rawTitle: LIIS Unseen Discovery Set 5x2ml
listings.description: Immerse yourself in the rich inner worlds of Liis with their Unseen Discovery Set (5 x 2ml) a captivating collection of five mini fragrances, designed to evoke deep, woody, resinous, and musky sensations. From the warm, spicy notes of Of True Minds to the fresh, bright hints of Ethereal Wave, these genderless scents are crafted with organic sugarcane alcohol for a clean, luminous experience. Each fragrance tells a story, whether it's the woody elegance of Studied, the incense-inspired warmth of Bo, or the fruity allure of Celestial Object. Perfect for exploring new depths of scent, this set invites you to discover your inner universe with every spritz. Contents: Studied Eau de Parfum (2ml) Bo Eau de Parfum (2ml) Of True Minds Eau de Parfum (2ml) Ethereal Wave Eau de Parfum (2ml) Celestial Object Eau de Parfum (2ml)

listings.rawTitle: Le Labo Travel Tube Eau de Parfum Set
listings.description: Dip into the world of Le Labo with the Travel Tube Set, featuring three of its highly acclaimed eau de parfums. Wrap yourself in the Another 13 fragrance. A unique blend of pear, apple, ambroxan, jasmine and musk, it's sure to have everyone asking what you're wearing. Up next, Thé Noir 29 is an olfactory ode to black tea that stars a warming cocktail of bergamot, fig, smoky cedarwood and rich tobacco. Or, why not transport your senses to the rugged, wide plains of the American West with Santal 33? It boasts crackling notes of cardamon, iris and violet, before falling onto a bed of leather and musk. Wear these alone or layer to enjoy all aromas. Contents: Another 13 Eau de Parfum (10ml) Thé Noir 29 Eau de Parfum (10ml) Santal 33 Eau de Parfum (10ml)

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Absolus Allegoria Rose Amira Eau de Parfum 125ml
listings.description: Turn heads with the Guerlain Absolus Allegoria Rose Amira Eau de Parfum (125ml), an enchanting scent designed to elevate your aura with floral freshness. Inspired by nature's beauty, this colourful combination of notes is blended with bright rose accents, warming patchouli and deep musks. Its floral profile has been inspired by the heart of a Persian garden, which makes this perfume a fitting addition to the Allegoria collection.

listings.rawTitle: Liis Floating Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Immerse yourself in untethered freedom and lightness with Liis' Floating Eau de Parfum (50ml), a fruity fragrance for the escapists at heart. Inspired by the airiness of a carefree day, this fragrance lifts the spirit with sparkling top notes of bergamot and ripe peach. As it settles, a heart of wild orchid and fresh flax wraps around you, lending a gentle warmth that feels both grounding and ethereal. The journey closes with the soft embrace of crisp linen and rich redwood, evoking a tranquil sense of boundless calm. It's a scent to savor the present moment.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Red Hibiscus Cologne Intense 9ml
listings.description: Picture yourself walking through a Hawaiian tropical forest, stopping to smell a beautiful and rare flower... that's the inspiration behind the Jo Malone London Red Hibiscus Cologne Intense (9ml). Exotic and enchanting, this sensual scent is warm and rich, thanks to heady red hibiscus (the rarer relative of the yellow hibiscus), sweet and musky jasmine sambac, cosy vanilla and spicy ylang ylang, which transports you to a paradisical world... so grab your plane ticket (or a bottle of this special scent), and stop to inhale its wonders... after all, taking a breather is always a good idea.

listings.rawTitle: BYREDO Blanche Absolu de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Discover the Byredo Blanche Absolu (100ml), an amplified interpretation of the Blanche's signature scent. This intense scent evokes the firm embrace of love, melting into the intimacy of skin-on-skin closeness and crisp, clean linens. With musky, corporeal and floral freshness, this fragrance pushes the boundaries to new extremes starring a stronger, heliotropic aldehydic composition, a more robust floral heart, and an intensified animalic musk. Sharply accented with piquant black pepper and grounded by warm amber woods, this complex fragrance captures the balance between quiet sensuality and elegance.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Care Collection Purify & Revitalise Duo
listings.description: From Jo Malone London’s Care Collection, the Purify & Revitalise Duo takes inspiration from the Roman Baths and its symbolic self-care rituals. Infused with aromatic scents, this wellness-focussed set stars a shower gel and body cream. Featuring hyssop, myrtle and juniper essential oils, lather up in the softening suds of the wash first, before gliding on the fluid, gel-like lotion, rich in lemon peel, bay laurel and verbena to uplift. Contents: Purify Shower Gel (50ml) Revitalise Body Gel-Cream (50ml)

listings.rawTitle: Juliette Has A Gun Powder Love Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Step into a dreamy haze of sweetness with the Juliette Has a Gun Powder Love Eau de Parfum (50ml), a soft, enveloping gourmand fragrance that captures the nostalgic charm of cotton candy and powdered skin. This delicate scent opens with playful notes of marshmallow and cotton candy, evoking childhood memories of pure innocence and comfort. The heart reveals sugared almond and orange blossom, adding a subtle floral warmth, while the base of tonka bean, ambroxan and powdery musk creates a smooth, sensual finish that lingers long after. Designed for those who love a refined yet cozy scent, it’s an airy cloud of sweetness and serenity, perfect for embracing a moment of quiet indulgence. Its soft, powdery aura makes every day feel like a gentle, fragrant dream.

listings.rawTitle: Juliette Has A Gun Powder Love Eau de Parfum 7.5ml
listings.description: Step into a dreamy haze of sweetness with the Juliette Has a Gun Powder Love Eau de Parfum (7.5ml), a soft, enveloping gourmand fragrance that captures the nostalgic charm of cotton candy and powdered skin. This delicate scent opens with playful notes of marshmallow and cotton candy, evoking childhood memories of pure innocence and comfort. The heart reveals sugared almond and orange blossom, adding a subtle floral warmth, while the base of tonka bean, ambroxan and powdery musk creates a smooth, sensual finish that lingers long after. Designed for those who love a refined yet cozy scent, it’s an airy cloud of sweetness and serenity, perfect for embracing a moment of quiet indulgence. Its soft, powdery aura makes every day feel like a gentle, fragrant dream.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Francis Kurkdjian OUD SATIN MOOD Eau de Parfum 70ml
listings.description: Transport yourself to a world of opulence with Maison Francis Kurkdijan's Oud Satin Mood Eau de Parfum (70ml) an amber-woody fragrance. Here, rare oud from Laos is wrapped in a luminous violet accord, Bulgarian rose and Turkish rose absolute. A soft, warm vanilla and amber base creates a sensual, enveloping aura that feels like silk against the skin. Inspired by the gentle draping of fine fabrics, it's a beautifully layered scent that balances the mystique of the East with a subtle floral finesse. Perfect for those seeking a sophisticated, radiant fragrance that suspends time and elevates the everyday into a moment of pure luxury.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN L’Heure Bleue - Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Evoking the deep blue of the sky at dusk, Geurlin's L'Heure Bleue Eau de Parfum (50ml) is a fresh, floral fragrance. This ambery scent opens with fresh notes of an ozonic accord, sweet pear and radiant neroli, before unfolding into an elegant heart of blooming iris, marshmallow accord and musky jasmine. It deepens into a rich base of vanilla, ambroxan and musk, leaving a powerful yet intimate trail. Encased in the iconic inverted heart bottle - a tribute to the original 1912 L'Heure Bleue design, created to be refilled and stand the test of time.

listings.rawTitle: Tom Ford Oud Minérale Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Turn heads and dive into the captivating allure of the TOM FORD Oud Minérale Eau de Parfum (50ml), where rich earthiness meets the fresh embrace of the sea. The fragrance opens with crisp, salty sea notes and zesty bergamot, evoking a coastal breeze. At its core, deep, smoky oud intertwines with aromatic patchouli and delicate lavender, creating an intoxicating balance of strength and serenity. Rounded out by warm, woody amber and musk, this scent is both bold and sophisticated. Perfect for those who crave an adventurous yet refined perfume that reels you in from the first spritz.

listings.rawTitle: Tom Ford Santal Blush Eau de Parfum 10ml
listings.description: Indulge your senses in the hypnotic allure of TOM FORD’s Santal Blush Eau de Parfum (10ml) an intoxicating woody-spicy fragrance that feels like a second skin. This textured fusion celebrates sandalwood’s diverse richness, enhanced with exotic spices, warm cinnamon and luxe ylang ylang. Hints of carrot seed oil, benzoin and cedarwood create a hypnotic, sensual trail that’s both heady and effortlessly sophisticated. Rich, softly spiced and subtly floral, this fragrance exudes modern warmth and seductive depth, perfect for those who crave a scent that’s as captivating as they are. Whether day or night, this hypnotic fragrance promises to leave an unforgettable impression, elevating every moment with its luxurious, layered aroma.

listings.rawTitle: Aesop Evoking Eidesis Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Aesop’s Evoking Eidesis Eau de Parfum (50ml) is a fragrant fable of intriguing contrasts, combining warm, ambery notes with woody, spicy complexity. Inspired by a timber-framed mirror, it’s a scent that encourages looking beyond surface reflections, challenging notions of authenticity. The rich blend features neroli, petitgrain and black pepper at the top, with earthy sandalwood, cedar and vetiver grounding the experience. This evocative perfume captures the essence of a contemplative mind; bold-yet-subtle, familiar-yet-mysterious. Housed in a sleek amber bottle with a textured basalt-inspired cap, it’s perfect for deep thinkers, visionaries and those unafraid to explore the depths of their own story.

listings.rawTitle: Balenciaga Cristóbal Parfum Travel Spray 15ml
listings.description: The master of all haute couture, Cristóbal Parfum (15ml) celebrates the mind behind fashion’s most influential creations. Reflecting the duality of Cristóbal Balenciaga, the most treasured name of the House, this scent is crafted around the richness of oud oil — one of modern perfumery’s most precious ingredients. Rare Assafi oud essence is entwined with sensual patchouli and oakmoss, unfolding into a composition of shadow, warmth and depth. Encased in an archive-exact bottle inspired by Balenciaga's 1947 perfumery, it threads together the fashion house’s past and present.

listings.rawTitle: NEST New York Santa Barbara Strawberry Oil 6ml
listings.description: Let NEST New York's fruity floral Santa Barbara Strawberry Perfume Oil (6ml) transport you to the beautiful vibrancy of a ripe strawberry picked along the stunning California coastline. Honoring Californian coast picked strawberries nurtured by gentle breezes and abundant sunshine with this highly concentrated expression of exquisite fragrance. Through a natural extraction process, the berry's true expression is revealed. The essence is artfully blended with nourishing baobab oil for a sensuous formula that melts into your skin while leaving behind a long lasting fragrance. Delicate and lightweight it glides effortlessly over arms, legs, décolletés or anywhere on your body that you want to indulge. It quickly absorbs into skin without residue or causing problems to clothing. Throughout the day strawberry scent trails spiral the body with every move and gesture.

listings.rawTitle: Kilian Apple Brandy, On The Rocks Eau de Parfum Spray 50ml
listings.description: Part of Kilian’s ‘The Liquors’ collection, the Apple Brandy on the Rocks eau de parfum pays tribute to the founder’s eighth-generation heritage as heir to his legendary family’s cognac-making savoir faire. This particular scent is inspired by the ever-vibrant nightlife of New York City, calling to mind its longstanding speakeasy culture. Just like the drink it’s named after, this rich and modern fragrance has an ice-cold opening with apple brandy at its core, blended with top and middle notes of pineapple, bergamot, rum and vanilla. Underneath, you’ll find a woody base of cedar and ambroxan. Be sure to keep the art deco-inspired bottle after – ideal for creating your own speakeasy ambience at home.

listings.rawTitle: KAYALI Freedom Musk Matcha 45 Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Frothy, milky bubbles of matcha, expertly whisked, set the scene for KAYALI Freedom Musk Matcha 45 (50ml). The scent opens with crisp matcha and bright bergamot, unfolding into a creamy heart of oat milk and praline. A gentle trail of sandalwood and sweet musk lingers, wrapping the skin in long lasting warmth. Lightweight and easy to layer, this EDP slips into your bag or desk drawer for a quick, sweet spritz wherever you are.

listings.rawTitle: KAYALI Freedom Musk Latte 41 Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Whether day or night, KAYALI’s Freedom Musk Latte 41 EDP (100ml) envelops you in a comforting, empowering aura that’s both alluring and effortlessly modern. It’s an indulgent, warm floral fragrance that combines zesty bergamot and pink pepper with the romantic scent of Turkish rose and rich café latte. Deep notes of cedarwood and smooth chocolate musk create a cozy, inviting aroma that balances freshness with sensuality. Designed for those who seek a comforting yet sophisticated scent, it offers a perfect blend of floral, gourmand and woody accords. The sleek 10ml bottle makes it ideal for on-the-go wear, allowing you to indulge in its luxurious, latte-inspired aroma anytime.

listings.rawTitle: BYREDO Black Saffron Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Inspired by the vivid smell, taste and colour of spices used within Indian culture, BYREDO's Black Saffron Eau de Parfum pays homage to the founder's Indian upbringing as well as representing unity and inclusion. Housed in the brand's instantly recognisable and incredibly lust-have monochrome bottles, this spicy scent has quickly become a firm favourite in any respectable fragrance-ophile's collection . Prepare to fall for the scent's spellbinding blend of juniper berries, pomelo, saffron and vetiver that envelope you in warmth and harmony. We're sold; are you?

listings.rawTitle: KAYALI Freedom Musk Bouquet 27 Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Designed for those who desire a vibrant yet sophisticated aura, KAYALI’s Freedom Musk Bouquet 27 EDP (50ml) offers a luxurious, floral musk experience that’s both captivating and effortless to wear. This luminous, floral fragrance combines radiant solar jasmine and ylang-ylang with the romantic warmth of Turkish rose and creamy vanilla musk. Accents of praline and sandalwood add a sweet, woody depth, creating a beautifully balanced scent full of elegance and sensuality. Perfect for day or night, it envelops you in a radiant, comforting embrace that exudes confidence and grace.

listings.rawTitle: Juliette Has a Gun Not A Superdose Eau de Parfum 7.5ml
listings.description: Elevate your scent game with Juliette Has a Gun Not A Superdose (7.5ml) a more intense, powerful take on the iconic minimalist fragrance. This ultra-concentrated version (20%) amplifies the signature of the brands Not a Perfume, delivering an even more potent, long-lasting trail. Centred entirely around cetalox, a molecule that seamlessly adapts to your skin’s chemistry, it creates a clean, musky and woody aura that feels both modern and timeless. Perfect for those who love the original but crave an added dose of intensity, this exudes purity and sophistication on steroids. Its minimalist design conceals an explosive, unique scent that leaves a captivating, personalized impression with every wear.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London English Pear & Sweet Pea Cologne 30ml
listings.description: Capture the essence of a sun-drenched orchard with Jo Malone London’s English Pear & Sweet Pea Cologne (30ml)a fresh, playful scent that feels like a gentle summer breeze. Juicy Williams pear offers a mellow sweetness and vibrant freshness, evoking sun-warmed branches bursting with fruit. Delicate sweet pea adds a soft floral touch, balancing the fruity brightness with a garden-fresh softness. A base of white musk leaves a powdery, clean trail, ensuring the scent lingers with an elegant, enduring softness. Effortlessly uplifting and subtly sophisticated, this cologne is perfect for adding a touch of sunshine to your day; playful, refined and utterly intoxicating.

listings.rawTitle: WHO IS ELIJAH Wall Street 10ml
listings.description: WHO IS ELIJAH’s Wall Street Eau de Parfum (10ml) is a commanding scent that leaves a lasting impression. Opening with a bold blend of rose and raspberry, it offers a fresh, slightly sweet-yet-sharp introduction. As it develops, rich oud, saffron and smoky woods create a warm, sensual core that feels luxurious and powerful. The base notes of amberwood, benzoin and leather add depth and persistence, lingering softly on the skin. Designed for those who exude confidence and control, this fragrance is about presence, bold, sophisticated and impossible to ignore. It’s the scent of quiet strength, made to leave a mark without shouting.

listings.rawTitle: D.S. & Durga Ain't That Sweet 50ml
listings.description: Indulge your senses in the unapologetic sweetness of Ain’t That Sweet Eau de Parfum (50ml) by D.S & Durga. This nostalgic fragrance captures the comforting warmth of a freshly sliced piece of cake. It opens with a spicy dusting of cinnamon, elevated by a heart of fresh, floral lily and finished with a base of creamy, decadent vanilla. This balanced blend melts effortlessly into the skin, leaving a captivating and long-lasting trail of sweetness.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Enrich Body Balm 200ml
listings.description: The Jo Malone London Enrich Body Balm (200ml) offers an intensely nourishing, luxurious experience, leaving skin feeling silky, conditioned and beautifully scented. This rich, buttery emulsion quickly absorbs into the skin, providing intense hydration with shea butter and hyaluronic acid to enhance moisture and elasticity. Infused with a warm floral blend of rose, camomileand cedarwood essential oils, it delivers a soothing aroma inspired by Roman traditions. Part of the Care Collection, this body balm is designed to comfort and indulge, supported by neurosensorial research that explores emotional responses. Ideal for those seeking a nourishing, opulent treatment, it envelops the skin in moisture and a warm floral scent, leaving it feeling velvety and refreshed.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN L’Homme Idéal Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Guerlain's L'Homme Idéal Eau de Parfum (50ml) is a woody (and addictive) eau du parfum that's set to become your new favourite. A woody meets ambery aroma, this fragrance combines three ingredients and three accords to boost your powers of seduction. It's designed to awaken the ideal lover within you. Think: captivating and mysterious.

listings.rawTitle: Balenciaga To Be Confirmed Parfum Travel Spray 15ml
listings.description: A kaleidoscope of floral notes, Balenciaga’s To Be Confirmed Parfum (15ml) is all romanticism and mystery. Unfolding like a time-lapse of a blooming flower, capturing the fleeting moment just before it unfurls, this luminous scent celebrates the allure of ambiguity. With a kimono tulip accord, crafted from night-blooming flower extracts, it translates Cristóbal Balenciaga's groundbreaking ‘Tulip’ silhouette into fragrance. Encased in an archive-exact bottle inspired by the house's 1947 perfumery, it embodies a legacy of fine craftsmanship and artistic restraint.

listings.rawTitle: Molton Brown Coastal Cypress & Sea Fennel Eau De Parfum
listings.description: Immerse yourself in the freshness of Molton Brown’s Coastal Cypress & Sea Fennel Eau de Parfum (30ml). Inspired by salt-sprayed skin and crashing waves, this fragrance opens with fresh fig leaves and ginger before cascading into a heart of crisp cypress and sweet jasmine. The base reveals an uncharted twist of smooth leather and smoky cedarwood, creating a radiant, adventurous trail that is utterly addictive.

listings.rawTitle: Molton Brown Delicious Rhubarb & Rose Eau De Parfum
listings.description: Indulge in Molton Brown’s Delicious Rhubarb & Rose Eau de Parfum (30ml), an irresistibly sweet fragrance that captures the essence of summer. This scent opens with vibrant notes of exotic lychee and crisp rhubarb leaf, before blossoming into a warming heart of fresh peony, delicate rose and pink pepper. As it settles, a rich base of cedarwood and heavenly vanilla emerges, melting softly into the skin to leave a tempting trail of floral sweetness.

listings.rawTitle: Molton Brown Rose Dunes Eau De Parfum
listings.description: Travel on an olfactory journey through the Arabian desert with Molten Brown’s Rose Dunes Eau de Parfum (30ml). This fragrance opens with blooming notes of saffron, violet leaf and sweet bergamot, before revealing a floral heart of velvety rose and geranium, wrapped up in earthy patchouli. Mimicking dusty-pink sand dunes at sunset, a warm base of rich oud, leather, and sandalwood add depth to its hypnotic trail.

listings.rawTitle: Molton Brown Mesmerising Oudh Accord & Gold Eau De Parfum
listings.description: Explore the steamy depths of Molton Brown’s Mesmerising Oudh Accord & Gold Eau de Parfum (30ml). Opening with vibrant notes of cinnamon leaf, bergamot and warm nutmeg, it ignites an intense, spicy allure. Unfolding into a sophisticated heart of deep saffron, black tea and creamy vanilla, it evokes the warm, sun-drenched landscapes of Assam. As it develops, a rich base of Oudh, golden honey, and vetiver creates a dark, resinous depth that lingers beautifully.

listings.rawTitle: NEST New York Lychee Rose Perfume Oil 30ml
listings.description: If you love fresh fragrances, you're in for a treat: the NEST New York Lychee Rose Oil (30ml) is an enticing scent that will leave you wanting more. Blending a vibrant combination of rose absolute and fresh lychee, this fruity floral scent is accentuated with the sparkling essence of pink champagne and a hint of raspberry. It doesn't stop there... it's also artfully melded with luxurious baobab oil for a heightened fragrance experience that nourishes the skin.

listings.rawTitle: Balenciaga Le Dix Parfum Travel Spray 15ml
listings.description: A reconstruction of M. Balenciaga’s 1947 icon, the House’s first perfume, Le Dix Parfum (15ml) is an olfactory time capsule. Its name, meaning “The 10” in French, refers to 10 Avenue George V, the historical address of the original Balenciaga Couture salon, ateliers, and perfume store in Paris, where the House’s couture shows are still held today. Reimagined through a modern lens, precious iris absolute is illuminated by iris aldehydes, while violet leaf absolute and incense essential oils lend depth and grace.

listings.rawTitle: Le Labo Hand Lotion Hinoki 250ml
listings.description: Caught yourself neglecting your palms recently? Not to worry... the Hand Lotion (250ml) works to restore moisture and comfort when you need it most. Starring sweet almond and safflower oil, further complemented by hinoki, an alluring scent (inspired by the resinous wood from temples of Mount Koya in Japan), this featherlight formula lightly perfumes the skin. Whether you find yourself braving cold winter winds or scorching climates, this moisture-locking must-have rushes to the rescue to save palms from the brink of dryness. Classically minimal on the outside (but never basic on the inside), this household staple makes the perfect addition to your kitchen or bathroom.

listings.rawTitle: Balenciaga No Comment Parfum 100ml
listings.description: A tribute to the power of silence, Balenciaga’s No Comment Parfum (100ml) needs no introduction. Exuding quiet confidence, this verdant fragrance intertwines resinous woods with the crisp, pine-like freshness of Spanish cypress oil. Understated yet unmistakable, it echoes Cristóbal Balenciaga's belief that true creations speak for themselves. Encased in an archive-exact bottle inspired by the house's 1947 perfumery, it embodies a legacy of fine craftsmanship and artistic precision.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Revitalise Body Gel-Cream 200ml
listings.description: The Jo Malone London Revitalise Body Gel-Cream (200ml) offers a sensorially uplifting experience, leaving skin feeling refreshed, hydrated and beautifully scented. Its lightweight, fluid texture effortlessly glides over the skin, delivering a dewy, revitalised glow. Enriched with hyaluronic acid and glycerine, it provides optimal hydration while maintaining a non-greasy finish. Infused with an aromatic citrus blend of lemon peel, bay laurel and verbena essential oils, the scent is energising and inspired by Roman purification rituals. Part of the Care Collection, this gel-cream is designed to elevate your daily wellness routine, supported by neurosensorial research that explores emotional responses, making every application a moment of renewal and vitality.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Peony & Blush Suede Body and Hand Lotion 250ml
listings.description: You could Transporting you to an English ballroom decadently dressed with fragrant peonies, this evocative scent is laced with juicy red apples and a decadent mix of jasmine, rose, and gillyflower. The base? A soft yet sensual blend of blush suede. Enriched with coconut oil and hyaluronic acid, this luxurious lotion instantly hydrates and conditions the skin, enveloping it in its addictive scent. Prepare to become obsessed.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Lime Basil and Mandarin Body and Hand Lotion - 100ml
listings.description: Jo Malone London's zesty Lime Basil and Mandarin Body and Hand Lotion (100ml) is the ultimate treat for anyone who loves to nourish their skin from head to toe. You could Marrying peppery basil with aromatic white thyme, this delectable formula puts an unexpected twist on traditional lime fragrances. As for the nourishing skin care benefits? It's enriched with coconut oil and hyaluronic acid to instantly hydrate and condition your limbs and beyond, while enveloping your skin in its addictive scent. Prepare to become obsessed.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Vanilla Scotch Cologne 100ml
listings.description: Jo Malone London’s Vanilla Scotch Cologne (100ml) evokes the warmth and character of a festive escape to the Scottish Highlands, with a rich, inviting scent designed for the season. A lively Scotch whisky accord leads into creamy vanilla, while roasted tonka bean and golden amber add depth and warmth to the fragrance. Presented in a limited-edition glass design, it captures the spirit of Scotland in an elegant, indulgent scent.

listings.rawTitle: Sol de Janeiro Cheirosa 90ml Fragrance Duo
listings.description: Experience the bright notes of Sol de Janeiro's Cheirosa Fragrance Duo, a scent sational set reminiscent of summer's day on the luscious coast of Rio. Journey through sweet notes of lychee essence and pink dragon fruit with the Cheirosa '68 Perfume Mist, a refreshing scent inspired by the energy of Brazil's Tropicália Movement. Boasting a surge of fresh ocean air, hibiscus and Brazilian jasmine, it then blends with summer notes of sheer vanilla and a sun musk base. As for the Cheirosa '62 Perfume Mist, expect warming notes of pistachio and almond with a floral bloom of jasmine petals that's inspired by sultry beaches. Did someone say holiday in a bottle? Contents: Cheirosa '68 Perfume Mist (90ml) Cheirosa '62 Perfume Mist (90ml)

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Jasminum Sambac Eau de Parfum 150ml
listings.description: Reminiscent of a springtime sunrise, Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Jasminum Sambac Eau de Parfum (150ml) delivers a bouquet of rich florals. Notes of fresh jasmine petals are lifted by morning dew accord and green gardenia leaf notes. The heart blooms with jasminum sambac softened by hedione, while a subtle base of vetiver, ambrox and white musk adds a lingering warmth. Crafted for layering or solo wear, this floral Eau de Parfum leaves a soft, evocative trail.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Magnolia Alba Eau de Parfum 150ml
listings.description: Fusing citrus hues with floral nuances, Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Magnolia Alba Eau de Parfum (150ml) opens like a sunlit bouquet. The scent blends creamy magnolia petals with zesty bergamot, lemon and mandarin. Rose and mahonial soften the heart for a fresh, springtime trail. Housed in Chloé's iconic ribbed glass bottle with an ivory cap and gold-toned accents, it makes a sleek addition to any perfume repertoire.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Cologne Collection – Festive Edition
listings.description: Five signatures in one beautifully festive set. Jo Malone London’s Christmas Edition Bestsellers Cologne Collection brings together a selection of the house’s most-loved scents in miniature, finished with a seasonal tartan bow. Wear them solo or layer to create your own signature scent. Set Contents: Lime Basil & Mandarin Cologne (9ml) A bright, modern classic where zesty lime meets peppery basil and aromatic white thyme, creating a fresh, unexpected take on citrus. English Pear & Freesia Cologne (9ml) Juicy, just-ripe pear meets a delicate bouquet of white freesia in this elegant fruity-floral fragrance, with amber, patchouli and woods adding warmth and depth. Peony & Blush Suede Cologne 9ml Lush peony and crisp red apple are layered with jasmine, rose and gillyflower, softened by the sensuality of blush suede for a beautifully polished floral scent. Wood Sage & Sea Salt Cologne (9ml) Mineral-rich sea salt and earthy sage capture the character of a windswept shore, balanced by the woody warmth of rugged coastal landscapes. Pomegranate Noir Cologne (9ml) Rich pomegranate, raspberry and plum are given a spicy edge with pink pepper, lily and warm woods, creating a deep, distinctive fragrance with a smoky finish.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Orange Bitters Cologne 100ml
listings.description: Meet your new festive favourite with Jo Malone London's Orange Bitters Cologne (100ml). Jo Malone London invites you to discover its delectable winter's cocktail as you enjoy the festive season. Take two dashes of citrus brightness, juicy sweet orange and a burst of fresh mandarin, then blend it with bitter orange and prune, before shaking (or stirring, you choose) to reveal a base of rich sandalwood and amber. Wear yours solo, or try layering it with another fragrance to create your own unique blend.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Twilly d'Hermès Eau Ginger Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Drench yourself in spicy and floral accords with Hermès' Twilly d'Hermès Eau Ginger Eau de Parfum (50ml). To begin your olfactive journey, this fragrance opens with a floral burst of peony, which makes for a fresh introduction. As you make your way through, a heart of zesty ginger and sweet, candied ginger tones are introduced. Plus, when it dries, you'll experience a creamy, soft base of cedarwood which unsurprisingly adds a woody tone. The cherry on top? It's housed in a playful lantern-shaped bottle finished with a hand-tied silk ribbon.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Barenia Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Hermès' Barénia Eau de Parfum (30ml) is a captivating blend of woody and lightly floral notes. At the heart of its fragrance profile sits subtle accords of butterfly lily and miracle berry, which give way to rich base notes of oak and patchouli that linger on the skin long after you've spritzed. The elegant aroma has an equally sophisticated bottle to match (inspired by some of the house's most famous fine jewellery), balancing elliptical glass curves with a stud-adorned metal plate. Plus, it's refillable too, so you never have to be without your new signature scent again...

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Black Orchid Reserve Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Indulge in the luxurious allure of TOM FORD Black Orchid Reserve (50ml), a captivating fragrance housed in a sleek bottle. This sophisticated scent features a complex blend of contrasting notes, starting with bright ylang ylang and citrusy timut pepper, layered over a rich foundation of roasted tonka bean and black truffle that evoke earthy, nutty aromas. Hints of patchouli and amber add warm, woody depth, creating a sensual and long-lasting signature scent perfect for special occasions or evening wear. With its elegant presentation, Black Orchid Reserve makes an exquisite gift for someone special, offering a bold, floral-chypre experience that embodies mystery, elegance and timeless sophistication.

listings.rawTitle: BORNTOSTANDOUT® Drunk Saffron Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: The scent of luxurious indulgence, BORNTOSTANDOUT's Drunk Saffron Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a liquid gold elixir. Assertive in its conquest to seduce the senses, this refined fragrance opens with velvety plum accord, dipped into warming cognac. Heady saffron emerges in the heart, both luminous and deeply seductive, before a base of supple leather and roasted coffee add a touch of sophistication. Settling onto an intoxicating base of vanilla, patchouli and musk, this scent -sory delight promises to capture the attention of those in your surroundings.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua Di Parma Signatures of the Sun Oud Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Housed in an eternally chic black bottle, the Signatures Of The Sun Oud Eau de Parfum is available in two sizes (100ml and 180ml), which is ideal given you'll almost certainly want one for at home and away. For anyone that considers perfumery as an art, Acqua di Parma's fragrance certainly has artistic flair. Sending you an invigorating journey through the senses, it opens with zesty citrus notes of bergamot and orange, before revealing a heart of Haitian amyris, Russian coriander and agarwood. Defined by its warming, woody undertones, it's grounded with cedarwood and leather accord, as well as patchouli, musk and sandalwood. The signature black bottle is almost as iconic as the aroma itself, so keep it pride of place in your bathroom to receive instant kudos from guests.

listings.rawTitle: Balenciaga To Be Confirmed Parfum Refill 200ml
listings.description: A kaleidoscope of floral notes, Balenciaga’s To Be Confirmed Parfum Refill (200ml) is all romanticism and mystery. Unfolding like a time-lapse of a blooming flower, capturing the fleeting moment just before it unfurls, this luminous scent celebrates the allure of ambiguity. With a kimono tulip accord, crafted from night-blooming flower extracts, it translates Cristóbal Balenciaga's groundbreaking ‘Tulip’ silhouette into fragrance. Encased in an archive-exact bottle inspired by the house's 1947 perfumery, it embodies a legacy of fine craftsmanship and artistic restraint.

listings.rawTitle: Tom Ford Soleil Blanc Eau de Parfum 10ml
listings.description: Picture sun-soaked sands and salt-warmed air with TOM FORD’s Soleil Blanc Eau de Parfum Spray (10ml). Solar florals and burning ambers conjure a sensorial escape to paradise in this sultry scent. Sunny radiance shines through with bergamot and ylang ylang, mingling with creamy coco der mer and pistachio for addictive indulgence. Warmth touches the skin with cardamon and benzoin, evoking the essence of an endless summer.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Francis Kurkdjian KURKY Eau de Parfum 70ml
listings.description: Named after Maison Francis Kurkdijan's childhood nickname, Kurky Eau de Parfum (70ml) captured the freedom of youth in all its vitality. Encouraging you to embrace childlike wonder once again, the scent combines rich gourmands and sweetened fruits. Reminiscent of childhood treats, tutti frutti accord blends together a sweet cocktail of orange, raspberry, pear and peach. Clean white musks compliment creamy vanilla in a mouthwatering display of gourmands. This fragrance is for the adults who "dare to dream like kids".

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN La Petite Robe Noire Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Inspired by inimitable Parisian style, La Petite Robe Noire Eau de Parfum (30ml) is a fruity-floral scent that provides a sensual trail built around the beauty and power of its hero ingredient: the rose. Opening with black cherry, this irresistible fragrance boasts an enigmatic blend of almond, berries and bergamot. The second twirl takes place as rose enters the stage. Finally, tonka bean appears, leading you into almond seduction, highlighted by black tea for a smoky concoction. Prepare to become obsessed as you celebrate la joie de vivre and irreverence.

listings.rawTitle: Vyrao The Sixth Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Connect your wellbeing to your fragrance wardrobe with Vyrao The Sixth (30ml), an olfactory creation bursting with notes of positivity. Top notes of angelica root and juniper berry envelop a calming green heart of apple, fennel and peppermint, layered over grounding base notes of cedarwood, patchouli and oakwood. Its fresh, airy profile is thoughtfully designed to uplift your energy and spark a better outlook on days ahead.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Orchidée de Minuit Eau de Parfum for Women 150ml
listings.description: Enriched with sweet, honeyed florals, the Atelier des Fleurs Orchidée de Minuit Eau de Parfum (150ml) pays homage to night-blooming botanicals. Taking on a captivating shade of blue, this bottle is brimming with enigmatic flowers, amber accords and gourmand accents. Inspired by the orchid plant and its ability to unfold in the dark and exhale a sweet smell, this eau de parfum combines orchid, jasmine, rum and benzoin in a heady blend. Drying down on a creamy base of vanilla and musk, it warms into a sensual, elegant scent with wear, guaranteeing a long-lasting impression.

listings.rawTitle: Charlotte Tilbury Joyphoria Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Transport yourself to a tropical, sunlit beach with Charlotte Tilbury's Joyphoria Eau de Parfum (50ml). Like a ray of golden sunshine, this fragrance opens with notes of refreshing coconut water, uplifting neroli and citrus petitgrain. At the heart, it bursts into a floral explosion of intoxicating tuberose, warm jasmine and bright ylang ylang. As for the base? It stars a balancing blend of vanilla bean extract, velvety cashmere wood and powdery musk accords. It's a charming fragrance with an intense scent trail that'll no doubt make heads turn...

listings.rawTitle: Le Labo Hand Pomade Hinoki 55ml
listings.description: Starring sweet almond, shea and peony root extract to deeply replenish, repair and condition, Le Labo’s incredibly rich (but not greasy) Pomade softens even the gnarliest palms (and looks good on your desk or your nightstand). With two beautiful perfumes to choose from – Basil, a fresh verdant scent with a hint of verbena to lend a crisp, citrus-y edge or Hinoki, which conjures the mystical warmth and hypnotic allure of the resinous wood that suffuses the temples of Japan’s Mount Koya – we recommend one for your handbag, your drawer and your glovebox.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Atelier Des Fleurs Cedrus de Nuit Eau De Parfum 150ml
listings.description: Take a night-time stroll along La Seine with Chloé’s Atelier des Fleurs Cedrus Eau de Parfum (150ml), a woody scent that combines creativity and confidence. This fragrance opens with smoky cedrus beautifully entwined with Queen of the Night, a rare flower with a sweet, spiced scent. As it settles into your skin, its enhanced by dark, creamy vanilla and rich, resinous benzoin, adding a layer of captivating warmth. A deep, grounding base of cedarwood leaves a sophisticated trail that transports you to the cobbled streets of Paris.

listings.rawTitle: Tom Ford Oud Minérale Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Turn heads and dive into the captivating allure of the TOM FORD Oud Minérale Eau de Parfum (100ml), where rich earthiness meets the fresh embrace of the sea. The fragrance opens with crisp, salty sea notes and zesty bergamot, evoking a coastal breeze. At its core, deep, smoky oud intertwines with aromatic patchouli and delicate lavender, creating an intoxicating balance of strength and serenity. Rounded out by warm, woody amber and musk, this scent is both bold and sophisticated. Perfect for those who crave an adventurous yet refined perfume that reels you in from the first spritz.

listings.rawTitle: KAYALI Lychee Lemonade 10ml (Eden Sparkling Lychee | 39 + Capri in a Bottle Lemon Sugar | 14)
listings.description: Refresh your scent wardrobe with the KAYALI Lychee Lemonade 10ml Duo, a vibrant pairing that’s as energizing as a sip of summer. This duo features Eden Sparkling Lychee, a radiant, fruity fragrance bursting with juicy lychee, blackcurrant and candied violet, like a sparkling fruit cocktail for the skin. Paired with Capri in a Bottle Lemon Sugar, a zesty, citrus-infused scent that transports you straight to sun-drenched Italian shores, with bright lemon, tart raspberry and creamy vanilla. Together, they create a playful, refreshing experience, ideal for layering or wearing solo; bringing joy and sunshine to every moment. Contents: Eden Sparkling Lychee|39 Eau de Parfum (10ml) Capri in a Bottle Lemon Sugar|14 Eau de Parfum (10ml)

listings.rawTitle: KAYALI Fresh Fruit Tart 10ml ((Yum Boujee Marshmallow | 81 + Eden Juicy Apple | 01 + Capri in a Bottle Lemon Sugar | 14)
listings.description: Treat yourself to the irresistible sweetness of the KAYALI Fresh Fruit Tart 10ml Trio, a curated collection of playful, gourmand fragrances that feel like a dessert for the senses. This trio features Yum Boujee Marshmallow, a decadent blend of fluffy marshmallow, strawberry, coconut and vanilla; it’s like biting into a luxurious confection. Eden Juicy Apple offers a fresh burst of crisp apple, juicy berries and exotic florals, perfect for adding a lively, fruity twist to your day. Capri in a Bottle Lemon Sugar captures the zest of Italian lemons and sugared florals, transporting you straight to sun-kissed shores. Together, these scents create a delicious, layered experience; bright, sweet and utterly addictive. Contents: Yum Boujee Marshmallow|81 Eau de Parfum (10ml) Eden Juicy Apple|01 Eau de Parfum (10ml) Capri in a Bottle Lemon Sugar|14 Eau de Parfum (10ml)

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Atelier Des Fleurs Sable Lavande Eau De Parfum 150ml
listings.description: Escape to the sun-drenched shores of the French Riviera with Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Sable Lavande Eau de Parfum (150ml). Celebrating the iconic fig, perfumer Ane Ayo captures its fleshy, pulpy richness, inspired by Gaby Aghion's beloved Ramatuelle and Saint-Tropez. Bright top notes of bergamot and eucalyptus evoke the invigorating sea breeze, while a heart of orange blossom and black fig accord reveals a luminous, floral-woody essence. Warm cedarwood, fir balsam and ambrox create a sensual, enveloping base reminiscent of sun-warmed sand and coastal landscapes. Housed in the brand's signature undulating glass bottle with a sand-coloured cap, this embodies effortless elegance and the radiance of a Mediterranean summer.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Vanilla Planifolia Eau de Parfum 150ml
listings.description: Experience the floral freshness of Chloé's Atelier des Fleurs Vanilla Planifolia Eau de Parfum (150ml). Infused with delectable gourmands, the fragrance reveals luminous notes of the rare Vanilla planifolia orchid. The tempting aroma is layered with enticing spices and grounding woods to extend its sensual charm.

listings.rawTitle: Creed Iris Debonair Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Creed’s Iris Debonair Eau De Parfum (50ml) is an elegantly turned-out fragrance that mixes the precision of couture fashion with the fine art of French haute perfumery. Luminous bergamot, infused with absinthe leaves opens with intentional charm. Next, the finest lavender from Kent brings crisp, herbaceous clarity. Deeper in the palette, French iris pallida from Les Landes, grown over three years, casts magnetic shades of pale blue. Born of Creed’s outstanding Franco-British heritage, this elegant, self-assured Eau De Parfum is debonair in every sense.

listings.rawTitle: D.S. & Durga Pistachio Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Introducing the Pistachio Eau de Parfum, unabashedly sweet and fun, this fragrance has sent the fragrance-obsessed nutty over its surprising aroma. Evolving from their Brooklyn roots (it all started in D.S.'s Bushwick apartment...), today D.S. & Durga's luxury line is lauded by tastemakers - or should we say, scent makers - and fragrance-ophiles around the world. Bottling a universe within each perfume and candle, each scent has a story, the brand's Pistachio fragrance is elegant, fun and somewhat surprising. A stark contrast to D.S. & Durga's usual scent creations, this cult classic fragrance is sure to delight your senses. A top note combo of pistachio and cardamom meld together before heart notes of even more pistachio and sweet roasted almond reveal themselves. As this settles onto your pulse points - you guessed it - another infusion of pistachio makes itself know, mixed with heady patchouli and sweetly inviting vanilla crème. Prepare to break the rules of fragrance and mix up your scent wardrobe with this delightfully unexpected aroma...

listings.rawTitle: Vyrao SunRae Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: There are so many things to love about Vyrao's Sun Rae Fragrance, not least the fact that the brand dubs it 'sunshine bottled'. You'll raise your vibrations with just one spritz. An invigorating treat for both the senses and the mind, Vyrao's Sun Rae has been formulated to encapsulate joy and happiness through its uplifting (and addictive) scent. Top notes of turmeric, lemon, bergamot and ginger create a confidence- and clarity-boosting aura, layered with calming black pepper and cardamom - an aphrodisiac often included in 'love potions' in ancient India. It's grounded with a sensual base of amber, sandalwood and vetiver for a tranquil finish. Think: a little complex, very sexy, and sure to become your new favourite. Oh, and don't miss the supercharged Herkimer diamond sitting pretty within the bottle - it's been energised by the brand's healer, Louise Mita. Good vibrations, incoming.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London English Pear & Sweet Pea Cologne 100ml
listings.description: Meet your new olfactory obsession, Jo Malone London's English Pear and Sweet Pea Cologne (100ml). Think of it as a fresh and optimistic spring day, bottled. Bringing sun-warmed orchards to your vanity, this delicate and joyful fragrance is bursting with notes of tempting and deliciously juicy green pears before revealing a soft floral heart of sweet pea. The base is powdery and clean, enhancing the trail of the scent with soft white musk. Wear yours solo, or try layering it with another fragrance to create your own unique blend.

listings.rawTitle: BORNTOSTANDOUT® FUGAZZI 50ml Eau De Parfum
listings.description: BORNTOSTANDOUT FUGAZZI Eau De Parfum (50ml) is the scent of secret encounters and stolen moments. This scent opens with a daring blend of zesty grapefruit, mandarin and cumin, topped with the unexpected nuances of milk Flowing into a heart of soft suede, warm iris, and earthy vetiver, as it settles, smooth vanilla intertwines with moss and musk, leaving behind an alluring magnetic trail. Evoking forbidden love and heady moments, this fragrance wraps you in an embrace that lingers long after the night ends.

listings.rawTitle: BORNTOSTANDOUT Dirty Duo: Dirty Heaven 15ml & Dirty Rice 15ml (Worth £158.00)
listings.description: Subversive, seductive, and irresistibly addictive, experience BORNTOSTANDOUT's essence with the Dirty Duo set. Dirty Heaven opens with the soft luminosity of white florals, unfolding into a decadent heart of jasmine and neroli before melting into tonka bean, saffron, and ambroxan, leaving a warm trail of vanilla and white musk that feels both delicate and provocative. In contrast, Dirty Rice is the wildcard in your fragrance wardrobe - comforting yet quietly daring - with a creamy blend of almond, peony, and milk that evokes the intimacy of a candlelit evening, wrapping the skin in a soft, nostalgic warmth. Contents: Dirty Heaven Eau De Parfum (15ml) Dirty Rice Eau De Parfum (15ml)

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Salty Scents Travel Set
listings.description: Embark on a sensory journey to the windswept British coast with the Jo Malone London Salty Scents Travel Set, a curated duo that captures the invigorating spirit of sea air and coastal woods. The Sea Salt & Bergamot Cologne blends fresh bergamot with crunchy sea salt, transporting you to rugged cliffs and crashing waves. Its airy, citrusy notes are anchored by driftwood, evoking the endless horizon of the Celtic Sea. Complementing the fragrance is the Wood Sage & Sea Salt Hand Cream, which delivers fast-absorbing, non-greasy hydration infused with the same fresh, woody aroma. Perfect for on-the-go refreshment, this set transforms everyday moments into an escape; bringing the invigorating essence of the coast wherever you are. Contents: Sea Salt & Bergamot Cologne (30ml) Wood Sage & Sea Salt Hand Cream (30ml)

listings.rawTitle: Balenciaga Le Dix Parfum Refill 200ml
listings.description: A reconstruction of M. Balenciaga’s 1947 icon, the House’s first perfume, Le Dix Parfum Refill (200ml) is an olfactory time capsule. Its name, meaning “The 10” in French, refers to 10 Avenue George V, the historical address of the original Balenciaga Couture salon, ateliers, and perfume store in Paris, where the House’s couture shows are still held today. Reimagined through a modern lens, precious iris absolute is illuminated by iris aldehydes, while violet leaf absolute and incense essential oils lend depth and grace.

listings.rawTitle: BYREDO La Tulipe Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Celebrate the arrival of spring with BYREDO’s La Tulipe Eau de Parfum (100ml), a vibrant floral scent that captures the essence of blooming gardens. Encased in the brand’s sleek, minimalist bottle, this fragrance opens with lively notes of cyclamen, freesia and rhubarb, evoking the crisp freshness of early spring. At its heart, the delicate tulip adds a soft floral depth, while warm blonde woods and vetiver ground the scent with a subtle, earthy allure. Featuring a gentle, enchanting presence, this scent radiates the joyful energy of spring’s first blooms, transforming every moment into a celebration of renewal.

listings.rawTitle: Frédéric Malle Contre-Jour Eau De Parfum 10ml
listings.description: The Frédéric Malle Contre-Jour Eau De Parfum (10ml) opens with the bright, golden aroma of Mediterranean Everlasting Flower. At its heart, spicy rose absolute and almond notes add depth and warmth, while sandalwood oil provides a soft, lingering base that carries the scent through the day. Crafted by Annick Ménardo, this scent leaves a distinctive trail, for a fragrance that feels intriguing and memorable without demanding attention.

listings.rawTitle: The Nue Co. Mind Energy, Energizing Fragrance 50ml
listings.description: Are your productivity levels on the floor at the moment? You’re not the only one… Good thing The Nue Co.’s Mind Energy is here to help; formulated using sustainable and upcycled extracts, this vegan fragrance harnesses patented neuroscience technology to stimulate neural pathways and invigorate your focus. The formula itself is centred around the knowledge that our sense of smell has a direct line to the three most important areas of the brain: the orbitofrontal cortex, which signifies awareness; the hippocampus, which is linked to memory; and the amygdala, which is directly associated with our emotions and mood. By stimulating these areas, this fragrance supplement helps to cut through mental fog and hone your focus. In consumer trials after 30 days of use, 86% of people felt they had more focus and 76% felt their productivity levels improved.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Chêne Eau de Parfum for Women, 150ml (5oz)
listings.description: Magnifying the facets of well-known flowers and plants, Chloé's Atelier des Fleurs collection spotlights the majestic oak tree in the woody Chêne Eau de Parfum (150ml). Exploring each of the tree's different elements, this thoughtfully crafted fragrance takes the senses on an olfactive journey from the leaves and branches to the trunk. To open, laurel oil is paired with vibrant mandarin and bergamot to capture a green aroma, while oakwood exudes a powerful presence. Sandalwood, vanilla and cedar ground the composition with an earthy depth, rooting it in its warm, woody scent family.

listings.rawTitle: Frédéric Malle Contre-Jour Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: The Frédéric Malle Contre-Jour Eau De Parfum (50ml) opens with the bright, golden aroma of Mediterranean Everlasting Flower. At its heart, spicy rose absolute and almond notes add depth and warmth, while sandalwood oil provides a soft, lingering base that carries the scent through the day. Crafted by Annick Ménardo, this scent leaves a distinctive trail, for a fragrance that feels intriguing and memorable without demanding attention.

listings.rawTitle: Sisley Paris L'Eau Revee d'Eliya 50ml
listings.description: Drawing inspiration from the different generations of SISLEY-PARIS’ creators — the d’Ornano family — Les Eaux Rêvées fragrance collection is a must for anyone who dares to dream. The Eliya stars exotic flowers harmonised with tuberose and violet to create a truly alluring addition to your scent lineup. Described by SISLEY-PARIS as a ‘tropical bouquet after the rain’, L’eau Rêvée d’Eliya depicts a utopian jungle with mythical creatures and sounds. Opening with bergamot, lemon and exotic florals, it reveals a tantalising heart of violet leaf, tuberose and jasmine. The base is both warm and woody, adding to the atmospheric nature of this unique fragrance. When you’ve spritzed the final drop, be sure to keep the recyclable glass bottle — which celebrates the works of artist Elżbieta Radziwiłł and sculptor Bronisław Krzysztof.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Hysope Eau de Parfum for Women, 150ml (5oz)
listings.description: The Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Hysope Eau de Parfum (150ml) captures the freshness of a floral bouquet, blending crisp citrus and delicate blooms. Bright bergamot, petitgrain and neroli open the scent, leading to a heart of hyssop, rosewater and a hint of violet. Raspberry, tonka bean and ambrox form a soft, lingering base that leaves a subtle trail. Housed in the brands signature pleated bottle, this luminous Eau de Parfum can be worn alone or layered with other Atelier des Fleurs fragrances to create a personal scent story.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Tuberosa 1974 Eau de Parfum 150ml
listings.description: The Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Tuberosa 1974 (150ml) is bold, velvety and floral, reinterpreting the House's first fragrance with a contemporary twist. Opening with zesty lemon, mandarin and petitgrain oils, it unfolds into a creamy, honeyed heart of tuberose, mimosa and ylang ylang. Warm patchouli, tolu balsam and oakmoss linger at the base for a rich finish. Encased in a sculpted Atelier des Fleurs bottle, this floral fragrance feels timeless and radiant.

listings.rawTitle: RMS Beauty RMS x Heretic: Scarlet Moon 50ml
listings.description: Want to know what happens when a world renowned make up artist collaborates with an expert perfume house? They welcome a fresh fragrance into the world; introducing the RMS Beauty x Heretic Parfum Scarlet Moon (50ml). Inspired by the midnight walks MUA Rose-Marie often takes in her favourite city of Savannah, Georgia, this perfume bottles the feeling of strolling under canopies of Spanish Moss Trees illuminated by the moon. Let's get into the scent... it opens with citrusy notes of bright blood orange, bitter petitgrain and Italian mandarin before blooming into a heart of herbaceous galbanum, spicy black pepper and earthy fir needle. As for the base? It lies on a woody bed with accords of hinoki, cedar leaf and Virginia cedarwood. Get ready to transport yourself to blissful tranquillity...

listings.rawTitle: Maison Francis Kurkdjian APOM Eau De Parfum 70ml
listings.description: The Maison Francis Kurkdjian APOM Eau de Parfum (70ml) stands for A Part Of Me, leaving a trace of your own story with everyone you meet, blending bright, inviting nuances that feels effortlessly wearable from the first spray. Designed to sit close to the skin, the floral, ambery scent opens with fresh citrus tones before moving into orange blossom and aromatic lavender, creating a profile that feels clean and warm. As it settles, ylang ylang and smooth vanilla melt into musks, leaving a subtle trail from morning through evening.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Francis Kurkdjian OUD SILK MOOD Eau de Parfum 35ml
listings.description: Building on the precious oud from Laos, Maison Francis Kurkdijan's Oud Silk Mood Eau de Parfum (35ml) weaves a spellbinding story of East meets West. Top notes of saffron, chamomile and bergamot spark a golden glow, while the heart blooms with guaiac wood and delicate hedione. The base reveals the iconic oud, enriched with patchouli and papyrus, creating a spicy, ambery trail that's both soothing and magnetic. Inspired by a marble palace under a star-studded sky, this fragrance is a sensual voyage into mystery and elegance, an intoxicating harmony of warmth, spice and floral finesse that envelops the wearer like the finest silk.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Francis Kurkdjian OUD Eau de Parfum 70ml
listings.description: Meet Maison Francis Kurkdijan's Oud Eau de Parfum (70ml), a mysterious, unisex scent with exceptional depth and elegance. This luxurious fragrance combines the smoky, musky allure of sustainably sourced oud with fresh Damascena rose and bright bergamot, creating a harmonious balance of East and West. Heart notes of guaiac wood deepen its woody richness, while base notes of patchouli, saffron and elami add warmth and intrigue. Inspired by a marble palace under a midnight sky, this is an enigmatic, sensual perfume that is both soothing and spellbinding.

listings.rawTitle: Balenciaga Extra Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Balenciaga Extra Parfum (100ml) is a rich, golden elixir that ignites the senses with an electric, effervescent energy. Opening with pink pepper and heated black pepper oil, its vibrant, spice-led profile is softened by an everlasting flower accord that radiates crackling warmth intertwined with hints of leather. Both flamboyant and dynamic, it evokes a world where myth meets modernity. Encased in an archive-exact bottle inspired by Balenciaga's 1947 perfumery, it threads together the iconic fashion house’s past and present.

listings.rawTitle: Creed Women's Discovery Set (Aventus for Her, Eladaria, Silver Mountain Water)
listings.description: Bringing together three bestselling scents, treat the senses to Creed’s Women's Discovery Set. From the bold floral-fruity elegance of Aventus for Her and the soft, radiant beauty of Eladaria to the crisp freshness of Silver Mountain Water, this curated set offers a scent for every mood and occasion. Perfect for fragrance enthusiasts and Creed devotees alike, it invites you to experience the brand’s signature craftsmanship through three distinctive and captivating creations. Contents: Aventus for Her Eau de Parfum (10ml) Eladaria Eau de Parfum (10ml) Silver Mountain Water Eau de Parfum (10ml)

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Terre d'Hermès Eau de Parfum Intense Refill 200ml
listings.description: Ready to meet your new signature scent? Cue Hermès Terre d'Hermès Eau De Parfum Intense Refill (200ml). Inspired by one's relationship with nature, this earthy fragrance was created by Christine Nagel, Hermès' perfumer, and combines fiery bergamot with burning wood, underpinned by the mineral notes of intense lava stone. What's more, this luxury scent deserves pride of place on your vanity thanks to its thoughtful design. At its base, the bottle rests on an 'H' leaving its imprint on the earth, while at the top the light is reflected by metal shoulders. Ready, set, spritz...

listings.rawTitle: Le Labo Rose 31 Liquid Balm 9ml
listings.description: Top up your signature scent wherever you go with Le Labo's Rose 31 Liquid Balm (9ml). Enriched with a blend of Centifolia roses mingled with warm and spicy cedar, vetiver, musk and guaiac wood accords, this addictive fragrance is sure to attract admirers. Plus, its formula features moisture-locking safflower oil to nourish the skin it meets. Take the rollerball with you and apply the perfume balm onto the body where fragrance is wanted. We suggest keeping it in your bag at all times.

listings.rawTitle: D.S. & Durga Black Magenta Pocket Perfume Spray 10ml
listings.description: Unleash the electric allure of New York nights with D.S. & Durga’s Black Magenta (10ml) a bold fragrance that captures the city’s vibrant chaos. Opening with juicy pink pineapple and spicy black pepper, it transitions into a smoky heart of iris, magenta dianthus and orange blossom, adding a floral twist. The deep base of black amber, Balkan tobacco and sandalwood grounds the scent in warmth and darkness, evoking city lights, twilight hues and neon fumes. Brash, sophisticated and a little rebellious, it is a statement perfume for those who want to leave a lasting impression. Perfect for nights when you want to feel powerful, intriguing, and unforgettable.

listings.rawTitle: Tom Ford Black Orchid 150ml
listings.description: Where glamour meets darkness, TOM FORD's Black Orchid Eau de Parfum Spray (150ml) rewrites the rules of florals. This is a scent that makes a statement. Roasted black truffle and luminous bergamot set the tone, while rum absolute and patchouli deepen the intrigue. At its heart, nocturnal black orchid and darkened plum entwine in alluring mystery, for a fragrance that owns the night.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua Di Parma Colonia Il Profumo Millesimato Eau de Parfum 100ml
